[h3]12. End of ongoing Attendance Event[/h3]
The current Attendance Event in progress will be deleted due to changes and removal of items rewarded in the event. 
Please make sure to claim any unclaimed items in the current Attendance Event. Once the update is implemented, players will no longer be able to claim any unclaimed attendance rewards. 

We have plans to continue improving the non-PVP aspects of KurtzPel through reinforcing new and varied content. We are currently looking at improvements to Story Mode as well as the Affinity System next. We had to put Karma balance changes on hold while we were working on these updates, but we will also continue to work on Karma balance through subsequent patches. 
Thank you for your patience and continued support of KurtzPel.  

[i]※ The videos and/or images in this announcement are pulled from development in progress and may be different from the final results in-game. [/i]

tags.feature: We will remove barriers to entry for PVP including PVP stat related items, skill acquisition based off levels, and randomized stat options.

As a revamp to reward systems, in addition to existing reward structure for PVP based on rankings, we will also add the Progression System to reward players who prefer to play with their favorite Karmas.
To ease new users into PVP, we will add a Tutorial Mode and various difficulty of AI battle modes to help them build their skills and confidence.
To address the issue where the PVE player base is divided by level and to avoid tediously repetitive gameplay, we will remove character levels and structure of level-based dungeon gameplay entirely.
Progression System will be an account-wide system that allows players to earn rewards as they gain levels from in-game activities for the account.
Karma Level cap will be removed to allow repetitive leveling and rewards through the Progression System.
Tutorial Mode will give new and returning KurtzPel players unfamiliar with the game a chance to learn and practice the battle systems before jumping into matches against other players.
Road to Grand Chase is a 1v1 Deathmatch mode where players will be able to face AI of varying difficulties as their opponent.
Character levels will be removed for PVE.
Level restrictions for dungeons will also be removed.
A new system called <Invasion Dungeons> where Abyss monsters appear in normal dungeons will be added.
Players will be able to work together to challenge even higher difficulty in the ‘Abyss Dungeon’ as players will be able to descend down to a maximum of 15th floor of the Abyss.
The all-new collection system will be added.
This system will allow players to check costumes & accessories that currently exist in KurtzPel.
The collection system will reward players with new collection items including Title, Profile, and a new accessory slot.
To ‘normal unlock’ a Karma, what previously required CP will now require a certain amount of gameplay to unlock.
When a Karma is unlocked, players will start from Karma Level 0.
Unlocking a Karma will also give the player access to all skills (active and passive) from the start.
The skill tree system will be removed to eliminate the impact it may give to match results based on whether someone had certain skills or not.
All players will have access to the same active and passive skills acquired from unlocking their respective Karmas.
Any skills that gave bonus stats will be removed completely.
Awakening Skills served to bring a lot of changes to gameplay, but acquiring it required a lot of play time.
Normal awakening skills will be provided upon unlocking the Karma.
Awakening bonuses such as Increase Karma Slot, Increase Stats, and Rage Awakening skills will be removed from the game.
Daily and Weekly Challenges from before will be merged into the Quest System.
Following this merge, Quest Log will have a ‘Daily’ category in which players can do quests and receive rewards on a daily basis.
Quests used to be on a per character basis but after the system update, quests will be account-wide.
Previously existing magic stone stat system will be changed for Karma, Costume Weapon, Costume Outfit, and Costume Accessories.
Magic Stone stats will be removed from Karmas.
Number of stats per costume part will be reduced from 2 to 1.
The system that forced using different magic stones for different costume parts will be changed to use the same magic stones for all costume parts.
Magic Stones will no longer randomize stats.
Using a magic stone will now allow a selection of desired stat from a list of available stats.
If new costumes are acquired after the system update, each piece will be given a fixed stat that can be changed by using magic stones.
Magic stones from before the system update will be available for conversion to the revamped ‘Radiant Magic Stone’ after the system update.
Due to changes to Karma progression, DP will be removed.
CP will also be removed.
CP will be converted to the new currency GP.
Everything that used to cost CP will now cost GP instead.
The current Attendance Event in progress will be deleted due to changes and removal of items rewarded in the event.

notes.title: End of Sale for KP Shop Items affected by System Revamp Update
notes.content:
Hello Chasers,

We are currently preparing for a system revamp to make changes to KurtzPel’s game systems not directly related to gameplay starting mid-October. 

With this revamp, KurtzPel will undergo changes and improvements to systems, which we received much feedback about, including the randomized magic stone system, awakening, as well as overall game progression. 

As a result, certain items will be changed or removed. The items listed below will no longer be available for sale at the KP Shop after the maintenance on 2021-09-29. Those who have purchased/used items listed below will be compensated with KP and/or items.  

(Compensations will be issued with the system revamp update. The exact date of compensation as well as the details of the upcoming changes will be announced at a later date.)

[b]End of Sale Items[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ed78cc5b1166fbabd35af7bd730197ffb4f82d56.png[/img]

[b]1. AP+100% Booster (1 Day)[/b]
- [b]Reason for End of Sale:[/b] Pre-existing Karma level will be maintained but Karma levels will be expanded, and as a result of changes to related systems, AP’s usage will change. Sale of this item will end to control value and effectiveness of AP. 
- [b]Compensation for used items:[/b] None because previously earned Karma levels will be maintained
- [b]Compensation for unused items: [/b]1x AP+50% Booster (1 Day) per unused AP Booster 
- [b]Note:[/b] Same Booster compensation regardless of whether you have [[Eltheca]AP+100% Booster] or [AP+100% Booster] 

[b]2. CP+100% Booster (1 Day)[/b]
- [b]Reason for End of Sale: [/b]CP will be removed. New currency called GP will replace it. 
- [b]Compensation for used items: [/b]Allow conversion of CP to GP
- [b]Compensation for unused items:[/b] 1x GP+50% Booster (1 Day) per unused CP Booster
- [b]Note: [/b]Same Booster compensation regardless of whether you have [[Eltheca]CP+100% Booster] or [CP+100% Booster] 

[b]3. EXP+100% Booster (1 Day)[/b]
- [b]Reason for End of Sale: [/b]the concept of EXP will no longer be relevant as character levels will be removed as part of the PVE changes.
- [b]Compensation for used items:[/b] Compensation based on the amount of EXP earned (Will be announced at a later date)
- [b]Compensation for unused items:[/b] 1x [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] per unused EXP Booster
- [b]Note:[/b] Same Booster compensation regardless of whether you have [[Eltheca]EXP+100% Booster] or [EXP+100% Booster] / [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] Contents: Choose 1 of [AP+50% Booster (1 Day)] or [GP+50% Booster (1 Day)]

[b]4. 7 Days, 30 Days Boosters[/b]
- [b]Compensation for unused items:[/b] AP and GP Boosters corresponding to number of days on unused boosters
- [b]Compensation for remaining period on already used items:[/b] If there is a remaining period on a booster already used and in effect, then based on the booster used, 7 Days or 30 Days Booster will be issued.
 
[b]5. Boosters (Hours)[/b]
- [b]Compensation for used items: [/b]None
- [b]Compensation for unused items in Inventory, Trading Post, or Mailbox:[/b] AP +50% Booster (1 Day) or GP +50% Booster (1 Day) for each applicable Booster. 

[b]6. Booster Package (1 Day)[/b]
- [b]Reason for End of Sale:[/b] Package will no longer be sold due to changes in contents of the package.
- [b]Compensation for used items: [/b]Follows compensations listed above for each component booster
- [b]Compensation for unused items:[/b] Since unused packages can only be located in KP Shop Inventory, each unused package in KP Shop Inventory will be replaced with 3x [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube]
- [b]Note:[/b] [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] Contents: Choose 1 of [AP+50% Booster (1 Day)] or [GP+50% Booster (1 Day)]

[b]7. DP Coin (300)[/b]
- [b]Reason for End of Sale:[/b] DP Points will be removed due to changes, so the related item will be removed from the shop. 
- [b]Compensation for used items: [/b][500 Bonus KP] equal to number of DP Coin (300) used 
- [b]Compensation for unused items: [/b][500 Bonus KP] per unused DP Coin (300)
- [b]Note:[/b] Compensation excludes DP Coins bought from the KP Shop then traded for CP at the Trading Post

[b]8. Radiant Magic Stone (Karma, Weapon, Outfit, Accessory)[/b]
- [b]Reason for End of Sale:[/b] Magic Stones will now allow selection of a stat instead of rolling a random stat.
- [b]Compensation for used items: [/b][Radiant Magic Stone] equal to the number of Radiant Magic Stones purchased and used from the KP Shop
- [b]Compensation for unused items:[/b] [Radiant Magic Stone] per unused Radiant Magic Stone
- [b]Note: [/b]
[list]
[*] [Radiant Magic Stone] will be given as compensation regardless of whether you had or used [Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone or Radiant Magic Stone
[*] [Radiant Magic Stone] is a material item that allows the player to choose the stat option they want on their costume
[*] For normal magic stones, we plan on providing a way to synthesize them into [Radiant Magic Stone]
[/list]
[b]9. Awakening Tome[/b]
- [b]Reason for End of Sale: [/b]Awakening system will be removed as part of the upcoming changes. Related skills will be reassigned to not require awakening to obtain. 
- [b]Compensation for used items: [/b]
Awakening Tome = 1,000 KP
[Eltheca] Awakening Tome = [Supply Box Select Cube] x3 + [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] x1
- [b]Compensation for unused items: [/b]
For each Awakening Tome = 1,000 KP
[Eltheca] Awakening Tome = [Supply Box Select Cube] x3 + [+50% Booster (1 Day) Select Cube] x1
- [b]Note:[/b] 
[list]
[*] [Supply Box Select Cube] Contents: Choose 1 of [Supply Box (Dark Knight)], [Supply Box (Nightmare)], or [Supply Box (Seraphim)]
[*] Compensation excludes Awakening Tomes bought from the KP Shop then traded for CP at the Trading Post
[/list]

notes.title: September 1st 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.content:
Karma Balance
[Crimson Lily]
- Pure Evil: Changed to apply cooldown reduction effects only to the current Karma’s normal skills. 
- Fixed last hit of basic combo to recover stamina instead of consuming stamina. 
- Removed stamina cost from switch attacks.
- Improved awkward flow of damage using Crimson Lily against a target located in front at a higher elevation. (Reduced knock-up distance of Basic Combo, Air Combo, Chase Attack.)
- Reduced Rage gauge recharge rate from HP consumed by skills by 50%. 
- Blood Storm Rage Skill’s aura effect is generated faster. 

[Lightning Fang]
- Blink Kunai’s skill damage reduced by 30%.
- Dimension Slash’s skill damage reduced by 30%. 
- Lightning Storm’s skill damage reduced by 50%.


[Diabolic Witch]
- Improved visuals for Mana Ray 

Bug Fixes
1) Fixed the bug where using Bloodthirst as Crimson Lily would not display the Bloodthirst effect in PVE
2) Removed stamina costs for switching from Crimson Lily to other Karmas
3) Fixed the bug where HP recovery from Blood Rush would apply to skills from other Karma that are not Crimson Lily
4) Fixed the bug where Dash – LMB with Dual Soul would occasionally only register 1 attack 
5) Fixed the bug where using double jump – RMB as Lightning Fang in certain terrain would move its user away
6) Fixed the bug where if the player switches to Lightning Fang and uses Lightning Ambush after initiating chase with a different Karma, the target would be dropped.
7) Fixed the issue where if Ruler of Darkness's Demonic Beast Glove (L) (Female) is equipped, some of the effects would be situated incorrectly. 
8) Fixed the bug where Training Grounds Slayer AI incorrectly had the defense of a Breaker instead of that of a Slayer.

notes.title: August 19th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Karma - Crimson Lily
Name: Crimson LIly
Weapon: Double Glaive
Type: Melee, Breaker
Crimson Lily is a Breaker that uses Double Glaive as its weapon. 
Crimson Lily can sustain its attacks by freely changing forms of Double Glaive. Its skills consume HP in return for higher attack and even lifesteal depending on the situation. How long you sustain yourself off this lifesteal is entirely up to you and how you handle it. With high damage and sustain from lifesteal, Crimson Lily poses a new threat on the battlefield.  

Improvement to maximum party size
Following the 4vs4 Normal Match update, we changed maximum party size to 4 players. 

Bug Fix
1) Fixed the bug where if karma was switched quickly while dashing, dash would activate again after the switch 
2) Fixed the bug where Sacred Guardian would occasionally drop straight to the ground when using Crusade in the air. 
3) Fixed the bug where the debuff duration increase passive did not apply to stun from Sacred Guardian’s ‘Crusade’ 
4) Fixed the bug where after dying from Dual Soul’s ‘Rend’, debuff icon would remain after reviving
5) Fixed the bug where if Lightning Fang’s ‘Tomb of Blades’ is used, the effects of it would also be shown to other characters.  
6) Fixed the bug where Lightning Fang would sometimes not be able to combo after chase depending on what action speed the Lightning Fang user has. 
7) Fixed issues with PVP skill balance adjustments affecting PVE
[Sword Taliah]
Spinning Rising Slash: Damage and break damage reduced 30% (PVP)
[Blazing Fist]
Blazing Strike: Damage reduced 30% (PVP)
[Sacred Guardian]
Judgment: Damage reduced 30% (PVP)
[Ruler of Darkness]
Death Blossom: Damage reduced 30% (PVP)

notes.title: August 4th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.content:
PVP Season 9
Pre-season has ended and Season 9 will begin. Your Season 9 Rank will depend on your rank from Season 8. All ranks will go down by 3. The highest rank you can get from the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1. However, all E ranks will be reset to E1

Season Pass and Season Points and their associated rewards you acquired during the Pre-season will be maintained into the regular season. You can use them until end of Season 9.

Karma Balance
[Sword Taliah]
• Spinning Rising Slash: Reduced damage and break damage (PVP)
[Diabolic Witch]
• Mana Ray: Fixed to not let it penetrate through terrain
[Blazing Fist]
• Blazing Strike: Reduced damage (PVP)
• Reduced break damage of first LMB attack from charging RMB
- Fixed break damage to properly scale based on how long RMB was charged
• Ultimate Heat: Fixed to register the attack even if you are in the same position as the enemy.
[Sacred Guardian]
• Judgment: Reduced damage (PVP)
[Ruler of Darkness]
• Death Blossom: Reduced damage (PVP)

Skill Icon Improvements
Improved the appearance of skill icons for each Karma so that they are easier to distinguish.

Season 9 Event
Duration: UTC+0 2021-08-04 After Maintenance - 2021-08-18 (05:00)

Bug Fixes
• Fixed the bug where certain weapons’ effects were taking place in abnormal positions
• Fixed the bug where weapon size would scale based on character’s Body Fat and/or Body Style during character customization.
• Fixed the bug where If a character’s Maturity was lowered, certain attacks and skill effects became bigger.
• Fixed the bug where Blazing Fist RMB charge grab followed by chase attack would drop the target if the target character had a specific Maturity.
• Fixed the occasional bug where if you quickly rotated through multiple characters in character select, the currently selected character’s hair would be changed to a different character’s hair.
• Fixed the bug where certain head accessories and gauntlet items would trail behind a moving character in Eltheca.
• Fixed the bug where breakfall animation would occasionally happen twice.
• Fixed the bug where if dash was repeated periodically, stamina would be used without activating dash.
• Fixed the bug where if Blazing Fist user grabbed and started attacking a Bellatos Claymore Soldier, the monster would disappear or the monster’s gauge bar would disappear.
• Fixed the bug where if Blazing Fist user used Blazing Strike in the opposite direction from where they were holding RMB, the character would slide first before activating the skill.
• Fixed the bug where at 120 fps, if Dance of Wind user uses certain skills while attacking with Cover Fire, the character would sometimes slide.

notes.title: [Announcement] End of ‘Pre-Season 9’
notes.content:
Hello, Chasers!
Pre-Season 9 is coming to an end.
Please see below for the Pre-Season 9 end date.

[h3]Pre-Season 9 End Date[/h3]
UTC+0 2021 August 4th (Wed) Maintenance

[h3]Season Pass - Season 9[/h3]
You can purchase the ‘Season 9 Pass Bundle’, which has been on sale since the UTC+0 2021 July 7th (Wed) maintenance.
Season points you have accumulated from the pre-season will carry over into Season 9 and be effective until the end of Season 9. 

[h3]Season 9[/h3]

notes.title: July 21st 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Awakening
1.	Lightning Fang Awakening

Improvements
1 Mission Card Improvements
- We have removed 5 vs 5 Destruction. 
- Instead, we have added it to 4 vs 4 Normal Match. One of Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Conquest, or Destruction modes will be randomly chosen for normal matchmaking. All Normal Matches will have no effect on rankings or ratings regardless of match results. 
- 4 vs 4 Capture the Flag rules have changed. Because this mode was previously meant for 3 vs 3, with the change in number of players, we decided to increase the number of flags that spawn from 1 to 2 at a time and increased points needed to win to 1000 as well. 

2.Mana Restored 
After testing and community feedback from Beta Mode and Pre-season, we have decided to revert the mana removal changes. For the players who changed their option stats from 7/7 to 7/21 will once again be allowed change stat options by using ‘Selective Magic Stones’ that will be provided after this maintenance on July 21st. Please remember to use this item before it expires on UTC+0 2021-08-04 05:00. Because mana will be re-added to the game, the event that allowed you to change away from mana related option stat will end earlier than initially planned with the 7/21 update.

3.Attacks will now use Stamina 
To limit the potential of infinite combos, we decided to make attacks consume stamina. 
Previously, in return for reducing the difficulty of resource management and combo execution, we implemented a ‘Combo Limit System’ to try and control combo duration. From what we have learned over the past several seasons, we determined that the Combo Limit System was awkward and reduced opportunities for skillful combo executions. We plan on emphasizing skillful combo executions that takes controls and resource management into account as we go forward. 

4.Karma Balance Changes
[All Karmas]
- Reduced break damage on certain Rage Skills (cannot interrupt skills any more) 
* We reduced break damage because it was not our intention to have this be used as a way to counter enemies who get close. 
* This change only applies to certain Slayer Rage Skills that applies buffs and have no immediate direct damage component. The intended targets for this change include Great Archer’s Soul and Demonic Awakening.
- Attacks now consume Stamina
 * We plan on applying combo mechanics that must utilize both command attacks that use stamina and skill attacks that recover stamina in order to make use of its full potential.
We made this change to reduce infinite combos that were possible from repeating basic command attacks, which reduced the need to learn any combos, and to address the frustration that anyone feels, regardless of gameplay experience, when they are on the receiving end of a seemingly endless combo.  
- Reduced Stamina needed to use Dash (33%)
 * Stamina consumption was increased unintentionally, so we decided to reduce the stamina needed to dash. 
- All Karma Movement Speeds increased
　	Melee Breaker	Melee Slayer	Ranged Slayer 
Movement Speed Increase %	4.5%	4.3%	5.0%

[Sword Taliah]
- Removed Fortitude’s effect that increases endurance and replaced it with effect that increases defense (50%)

[Dance of Wind]
- Reduced endurance damage by Raining Arrows (25%)
- Reduced charged LMB range (16%)
- Removed break damage increase from Great Archer’s Soul 

[Fallen Light]
- Reduced radius of Lightning Trap (25%)

[Lightning Fang]
- Changed to make blink effect more obvious
- Reduced knockback distance from last hit of air attack sequence 
- Right click after landing from aerial attacks will consume more stamina 

[Diabolic Witch]
- You cannot move until Circle of Elements completes activation 
- Reduced initial endurance damage of Circle of Elements 
- Reduced flinching after activating Demon Awakening (0.6 second)

[Aegis Knight]
- Reduced knockback distance from aerial right click to allow combos to continue (Stamina consumption increased)
- Changed it so that enemy doesn’t fall too fast after doing aerial LMB attacks (after 3 LMBs in a row while in the air, it should be easier to continue a combo) 

[Sacred Guardian]
- Reduced knockback from last attack of aerial attacks so that combos can continue. (Stamina consumption increased)

[Soul of Magus]
- Increased action speed for LMB-LMB-LMB-RMB attack.

5.Bug fixes 
1) Fixed the bug where if you slammed down while holding on to a monster with Blazing Fist, the HP bar would change locations.
2) Fixed the bug where it was possible to grab an enemy while they were knocked down (i.e., Blazing Fist – Grab, Reckless Charge/ Lightning Fang - Lightning Drop, etc.)
3) Fixed the bug where some items from the Supply Box (Seraphim) would not be listed on the Trading Post (i.e., Lire’s Eryuell Archer Dress, Kien's Trinity Outfit Top Piece, etc.) 
4) Fixed the bug where Skill Cooldown option stat affected Evasion cooldown.

This pre-season will give us an opportunity to reevaluate the changes tested through the Beta Mode one last time and serve as a transition period as rankings and other matters are sorted for Destruction to become a proper Ranked Match mode.
Your Pre-season and Season 9 rank will depend on your rank from Season 8.
Destruction will have no effect on your Pre-season 9 rankings. 
All ranks will go down by 3.
The highest rank you can get after reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1. 

PVP Season 9 Pre-season Mission Card
For Season 9, starting from the Pre-season, we are planning on improving matchmaking and modes that see less play. 
From the Mission list, the following modes will be removed:
  - Capture the Flag
  - Conquest
  - 3vs3 Deathmatch
  - Survival (Beta Mode)
Normal Match Destruction as well as Ranked Match 2v2 Deathmatch and AI Deathmatch will remain. 

PVP Season 9 Pre-season Changes
  - Improvements to Battle UI
  - Removed mana resource from PVP
Because mana is getting removed from PVP, we will hold an event that gives an opportunity for you to replace purple and golden magic stones with “Max Mana” or “Mana Recovery (Sec.)” options to another option. 
  - Removed Natural Recovery
  - Removed Blow System
  - Removed Invincibility during knockdown
  - Removed combo limit system
  - Added Invincibility during Breakfall
  - Movement speed adjusted for all Karmas
  - Changed Fallen Light’s dash attack and chase attack
  - QoL improvements for Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, and Diabolic Witch RMB expansion attack

  - Removed HP Recovery from set of buffs received from defeating Chaos. (Recharge Rage Gauge /Increase Attack +100%/Increase Action Speed +10%/Increase Movement Speed +30%)
  - Teammates who didn’t participate in defeating the Golem or Chaos will no longer receive experience from the defeated Golem or Chaos.
  - Reduced experience needed to level up after Lv. 11 to accelerate leveling.

[Fallen Light]
  - Reduced Rapid Shot range by 50%
  - Reduced damage of Lightning Shot in PVP by 50% and removed endurance damage in PVP

[Blazing Fist]
  - Reduced range of Instant Chase (29%)
  - Reduced max duration of Falling Star in the air (40%)
  - Reduced endurance damage from Blazing Strike hits (45%); Cannot interrupt Storm Slash

[Dance of Wind]

  - Non-Aiming skills can now be used while aiming

[Diabolic Witch]
  - RMB Hold on Ground to regen mana is removed
  - RMB Expansion > When you hold RMB, it will now automatically change attack attributes
  - RMB Expansion > Dashing can be done while holding RMB

  - Circle of Elements: Reduced PVP damage (30%), reduced knock up height of damaged enemy and added knockback

notes.title: June 23rd 2021 Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.content:
Destruction (Beta Mode) Changes
- Karma Switching Allowed (2 Karmas only)
- Removed restrictions on duplicate Karma selections within same team
- Limited Matchmaking Periods (18:00 – 23:00 (5 hours) for each Server’s Time Zone)
- Increased Rewards
- Changed character nickname text color for neutral monster kill notification 

Reduced Soul Scythe size while equipped
We reduced the size of Soul Scythe to make it easier to view it in various UIs. In both PVE and PVP, size and attack range remain unchanged while using the weapon. The size is only changed for when you have it equipped and resting on your back. 

Improved Training Grounds Command and Skill Guide
We changed formal expressions of some commands and skills in Training Grounds.
Changes are centered around what ‘Launch’ and ‘Knocked Down’ means.
Previously, we used ‘Launch’ to note the situations where an enemy would be knocked up high into the air.  From now on, regardless of the height to which enemies are sent, if the end result knocks enemy down on the ground, then that will be referred to as ‘Knocked Down’.
We will only use ‘Launch’ when the enemy is flung into the air without being knocked down.

AI Change
In AI PVP, we determined that ‘Sacred Guardian’ AI is more aggressive and has bigger influence on outcome of the match than other AIs and as a result, we decided to remove it. 
We also added the new ‘Dual Soul’ AI. 
We also made improvements to all remaining AI to move more naturally overall.  

Bug Fixes
- Fixed the bug where the character would have its eyes closed during victory pose screen If the mission ended while the character was dead.
- Fixed the bug with special key input not registering if Karma switch key was changed from the default Tab. 
- Fixed the bug where the AI Diabolic Witch character passed through its own ‘Ice Wall’ 
- Fixed the bug with the wrong roll cooldown showing on UI when switching to a karma with a different roll cooldown. 
- Fixed the bug where you move too far when doing LMB + Evade with Kunai
- Fixed the bug where AI attack effect wasn’t showing while AI was attacking (red flickering)
- Fixed the bug where AI’s invincibility effect (white flickering) wasn’t showing

notes.title: June 9th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) June 9th,2021 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/327dd4b302cf524225c861cc4da3467940bfd61f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Beta Mode[/h3]
[b]1. 2 vs 2 Deathmatch (Beta Mode)[/b]
The Deathmatch (Beta Mode) will come to an end. We would like to thank every single one of you for testing and providing your feedback via the survey. We do our best to take your feedback and continue to improve KurtzPel.

[b]2. Destruction – Beta Mode[/b]
Press (M) then select ‘Destruction’ on the ‘Battle’ tab to play the new 5v5 PVP mode. 
To play Destruction, you must have 5 or more Karmas and you must choose 1 Karma that you want to play with for the entire match.  
It is not an official mode yet so this mode can be enjoyed without worrying about win/loss records affecting your ranking. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1b25b7f680317223a5a6e9114e999c4a707ec955.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3bb6eb24d06d0183e190a2cbb8c728ea2c089e0e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ac6686eed04ea844822833b061437c93d87cdf23.png[/img]

[b]Game Rules [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/91325e96265eeda8a8b8a5ad80b0c695e218d3a0.png[/img]
- Players: 5 vs 5
- Win Condition: Destroy the last tower in the enemy base
- Play Time Limit: None
- Special Rules
1) You must choose 1 Karma to play (You cannot switch Karmas while playing Destruction.) / Allies cannot use the same Karma
2) Equipment, Costume, Set Items, Karma Passives, and all other stat effects do not apply. All players will start the game with the same stats. 
3) All characters will have the same set of motions and will not be adjusted to individual character features. 
4) Combo limit has been removed for Destruction mode.

[b]How to Play[/b]
1) Defeat enemy characters, monsters, and neutral monsters to increase your level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/514f9961fa409e90b60b9bac93c484bf6836a40f.jpg[/img]
2) When you level up, your stats will increase and you will unlock a skill or increase a level on a skill. 
(When you level up, select the desired skill to level it up (default: number keys 1-4)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9b9e2cdec85c15282fe8f050febeaff0f92380c6.jpg[/img]
3)Defeat neutral monsters to gain buffs or summon monsters to your side. 
- [b]Golem[/b]: Defeat the Golem to have it become your ally for a set duration. Fight with it to destroy the enemy towers. 
(A much stronger Golem will spawn after it is defeated for the 3rd time.)
- [b]Chaos[/b]: Defeat the Chaos to grant your allies with powerful Hero Buffs for a set duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/71fa6379f9adba349eacc6b0c9f301602dcf5f7c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a155b554862095ffa65dc2a11a3822650312c4b0.jpg[/img]
4)Make use of your character progression and neutral monsters to destroy enemy towers all the way to their final base tower to win.

[b]Tip[/b]
1) Press the (G) key on your keyboard to see information about the current match. 
2) Press the (B) key on your keyboard to recall to your base.
3) Go to designated region in your base to recover your HP. 
4) Neutral monsters will start recovering HP if they leave their territory. 
5) When you die, you will be respawned at the start point. Your respawn timer will increase with your levels. 

[b]Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/815c1ff0eec52e72c69a426137df1e02a3805bb7.jpg[/img]

[b]Karma Balance Changes (Limited to Destruction)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5d71171dcace23c88181b75dccf16938dd71445c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Control Revamp (Limited to Destruction – Beta Mode)[/h3]
You can experience the control revamp in ‘Destruction’ – Beta Mode. 
We limited the changes to Destruction so that you can play and test these changes for yourself before they are applied to the rest of the game. 

[b]1) Mana still Removed but Stamina is Restored[/b]
Mana will continue to be removed and skills will solely depend on cooldowns.
Stamina has been restored and Dash Spheres are removed. 

[b]2) Changes due to Stamina being Restored[/b]
Because stamina is restored the below will be changed. 
- Dual Soul’s RMB command will consume stamina
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will consume stamina
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will consume stamina
- Lightning Fang’s RMB will consume stamina. 
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will consume stamina

[b]3) Blow System removed[/b]
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 

[b]4) Combining Dash & Evade has been Removed[/b]
We heard your feedback loud and clear and we decided to remove the decision to combine dash & evade as many of you pointed out that it actually took away the uniqueness and combo mechanics of individual Karmas. The dash & evade system has been restored to its original system.

[b]5) Natural Recovery removed[/b]
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result.
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times.

[b]6) Movement Speed Adjustment[/b]
We received many feedbacks that the current movement speed was too slow so we've made it a bit faster than before.
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 15% faster movement speed.

[b]7) Knockdown, Breakfall Changes[/b]
- Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 
- Breakfall
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage!

[b]8) Difficult Control Improvements[/b]
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a0b0ef3465ba987297477747f56f7ef7f23172e8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Destruction (Beta Mode) Improvements[/h3]
[b]1) Ping System[/b]
While playing Destruction (Beta Mode), you will be able to communicate and strategize with your teammate with ease with the new Ping system.
- While playing, hold down the ALT key to switch to 'Ping Mode' which will make your mouse cursor appear on top of the minimap.
- When you are in Ping Mode (hold ALT), you can still use your other keys and Ping Mode can be activated while you are incapacitated as well.
- You can ping your teammates on the minimap with LMB and RMB.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a47d643203b8b407f591537d49290dc4fa1253a3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ff19be0059b7f68e52d86444dbaca1bf930f60b6.png[/img]

[b]2) Spectator System[/b]
When you are incapacitated by the enemy, you will be able spectate your living teammates with the new Spectator System.
While you are incapacitated, press the A & D key on your keyboard to spectate your living teammates.
- A Key: Previous Teammate
- D Key: Next Teammate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4b2eba8c9d0d2651a23f792a73f7f06906dc8aa8.png[/img]

[h3]New Awakening[/h3]
[b]• Aegis Knight Awakening[/b]
- Awakening is coming for Aegis Knight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/87baff7835342abf93631c650d2a7a616eb0da0f.png[/img]

- How to unlock Awakening
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/581cfdfd5422508777767704dd8793acae5ce371.png[/img]

- Karma Skill Tree Expansion
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

[b]Expanded Aegis Knight Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e9375932c9987531a67a6713648cd7fa54d17691.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/96cdfe5b19ff2d49d2f9217451c5dcb68ec224fa.jpg[/img]

[b]Aegis Knight New Awakening Skill – Thunderous Charge[/b]
Charge forward and crash into an enemy with great force. If your charge is successful, the target hit will become airborne.
[previewyoutube=YFNF-HI3QCo;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Aegis Knight New Awakening Rage Skill – Grand Cross EX[/b]
Trap enemies in front of you then slash them in large, sweeping motion.
[previewyoutube=tD5hF3VEiwM;full][/previewyoutube]
With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, Sacred Guardian, Fallen Light, Ruler of Darkness, Soul of Magus, and Aegis Knight will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

[b]- Awakening Gauge[/b]
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg[/img]
When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg[/img]
When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

[b]- Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE[/b]
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1d944aff3a28c39d2ee9773d6ed6d493b343c18f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
[b]• Eltheca Lighting Improvement[/b]
- Lighting intensity in Eltheca has been adjusted to make the character's skin tone and costume color to be most accurate to the actual color
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4aa92d306919e035f6d41d4ca83f89c4e9462abb.jpg[/img]
Left - Before | Right - After

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[b]• General[/b]
- Fixed the bug where tooltip UI wouldn't show up while matchmaking as a party in certain situations
- Fixed the bug where semi-transparent costumes didn't have any shadow
- Fixed the bug where the Release Sky Lantern Emote would be tilted

notes.title: June 2nd 2021 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) June 2nd,2021 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a1e3b652841c04f113854cac8b38a1af1ae5756e.jpg[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]Content[/h3]
[b]End of 3 vs 3 Deathmatch (Beta Mode)[/b]
3 vs 3 Deathmatch (Beta Mode) will be removed. 
Instead, we will be implementing the 2 vs 2 Deathmatch (Beta) Mode with minor tweaks from the previous control revamp.

[b]2 vs 2 Deathmatch (Beta Mode)[/b]
Deathmatch (Beta Mode) will take the place of Destruction (Beta Mode)
- Map: Abandoned Ruins Outskirt
- Players: 2 vs 2
- Win Condition: Score 7 kills against enemies (Same as normal 2 vs 2 Deathmatch rules)
- Rewards: AP, CP, DP, Probatio Mark, Energy of Harmony, Resurrection Stone, Magic Stone (Karma), Magic Stone (Costume Weapon), Magic Stone (Outfit), Magic Stone (Costume Accessory) (Same as normal 3 vs 3 Deathmatch)
- Mission Queue Requirement: D Rank or Above / Must not be in a party
- Rules
1) All stat effects do not apply.
2) Win/loss records in this mode will not affect rating (However, matchmaking will consider your current PVP rating to make matches).
3) Select 2 Karmas to use for each match. 

[b]Control Revamp (Limited to 2 vs 2 Deathmatch (Beta Mode))[/b]
You can experience the control revamp in Deathmatch (Beta Mode).
We limited the changes to Deathmatch (Beta Mode) so that you can play and test these changes for yourself before they are applied to the rest of the game. 

[b]1) Mana still Removed but Stamina is Restored[/b]
Mana will continue to be removed and skills will solely depend on cooldowns.
Stamina has been restored and Dash Spheres are removed. 

[b]2) Changes due to Stamina being Restored[/b]
Because stamina is restored the below will be changed. 
- Dual Soul’s RMB command will consume stamina
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will consume stamina
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will consume stamina
- Lightning Fang’s RMB will consume stamina.
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will consume stamina

[b]3) Blow System removed[/b]
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 

[b]4) Combining Dash & Evade has been Removed[/b]
We heard your feedback loud and clear and we decided to remove the decision to combine dash & evade as many of you pointed out that it actually took away the uniqueness and combo mechanics of individual Karmas. The dash & evade system has been restored to its original system.

[b]5) Natural Recovery removed[/b]
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result.
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times.

[b]6) Movement Speed Adjustment[/b]
We received many feedbacks that the current movement speed was too slow so we've made it a bit faster than before.
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 10% faster movement speed.

[b]7) Knockdown, Breakfall Changes[/b]
- Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 
- Breakfall
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage!

[b]8) Difficult Control Improvements[/b]
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/d0e0de761769eac657d03e546719a6f8814f3a0b.png[/img]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
•	Fixed the bug where certain spots in Eltheca and Ruins Map would make the shadows flicker

[h3]Content[/h3]
[b]End of Destruction (Beta Mode)[/b]
Destruction (Beta Mode) will be removed. 
We will take all of your testing and feedback in the last few weeks into consideration and come back with a better version. Thank you for playing!

[b]Deathmatch (Beta Mode)[/b]
Deathmatch (Beta Mode) will take the place of Destruction (Beta Mode)
- Map: Abandoned Ruins Outskirt
- Players: 3 vs 3
- Win Condition: Score 10 kills against enemies (Same as normal 3v3 Deathmatch rules)
- Rewards: AP, CP, DP, Probatio Mark, Energy of Harmony, Resurrection Stone, Magic Stone (Karma), Magic Stone (Costume Weapon), Magic Stone (Outfit), Magic Stone (Costume Accessory) (Same as normal 3v3 Deathmatch)
- Mission Queue Requirement: D Rank or Above / Must not be in a party
- Rules
1) All stat effects do not apply.
2) Win/loss records in this mode will not affect rating (However, matchmaking will consider your current PVP rating to make matches).
3) Select 2 Karmas to use for each match. 

[b]Control Revamp (Limited to Deathmatch (Beta Mode))[/b]
You can experience the control revamp in Deathmatch (Beta Mode).
We limited the changes to Deathmatch (Beta Mode) so that you can play and test these changes for yourself before they are applied to the rest of the game. 

[b]1) Stamina & Mana removed[/b]
We simplified resource management so that you can better focus on the battle itself. 

[b]2) Changes due to Stamina Removal[/b]
Because stamina is removed some command skills had to be adjusted. 
- Dual Soul’s RMB movement distance reduced.
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will now use Dash Spheres.
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will now use Dash Spheres.
- Lightning Fang’s RMB reflect will now use Dash Spheres when reflect is successful.
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will now use Dash Spheres.

[b]3) Blow System removed[/b]
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 

[b]4) Combining Dash & Evade[/b]
We combined Dash & Evade because they serve a similar purpose and to make it easier to manage. The new dash moves a greater distance than when these skills were used consecutively. Just spamming this skill can now put you at a disadvantage and allow enemies to punish you.
However, to minimize drastic changes from pre-existing play patterns, both the dash key and the evade key can be used to activate the new Dash.
- Max 3 Dash Spheres (New resource consumed from activating Dash)
- At the start of the game, all players start with 3 Dash Spheres.
- Invincibility during Dash (Evade)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/07d45277344a3007f191db2ee10bc3273e54e97e.jpg[/img]

[b]5) Natural Recovery removed[/b]
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result.
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times.

[b]6) Movement Speed reduced[/b]
To control the speed of the game overall, we reduced basic movement speed and movement speed increase from Dash Sprint.
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 10% faster movement speed.

[b]7) Knockdown, Breakfall Changes[/b]
- Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 
- Breakfall
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage!

[b]8) Difficult Control Improvements[/b]
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4078fd1da9ee631e62af3b83ad30e2971671a0c0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Etc.[/h3]
[b]Eltheca Background Music will be changed.[/b]
New background music will play for Eltheca. 1 of 2 new music pieces will be randomly selected to play at any given time. 

[b]Improved Preview of KP Shop Basic Motions[/b]
You can now preview all motions individually on the KP Shop (Idle, Habit, Battle Idle, Start, Running, and Jump)

Surprise bonus event for everyone over this weekend!

notes.title: May 12th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) May 12th,2021 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/98105b075066aa64964d3ea4c5d12c585dda7d95.jpg[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]New PVP Mode[/h3]
Destruction – Beta Mode
Press (M) then select ‘Destruction’ on the ‘Battle’ tab to play the new 5v5 PVP mode. 
To play Destruction, you must have 5 or more Karmas and you must choose 1 Karma that you want to play with for the entire match.  
It is not an official mode yet so this mode can be enjoyed without worrying about win/loss records affecting your ranking. 

[b]New Map – Edilwood Forest[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1b25b7f680317223a5a6e9114e999c4a707ec955.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3bb6eb24d06d0183e190a2cbb8c728ea2c089e0e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ac6686eed04ea844822833b061437c93d87cdf23.png[/img]

[b]Game Rules [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/91325e96265eeda8a8b8a5ad80b0c695e218d3a0.png[/img]

-	Players: 5 vs 5
-	Win Condition: Destroy the last tower in the enemy base
-	Play Time Limit: None
-	Special Rules
1)	You must choose 1 Karma to play (You cannot switch Karmas while playing Destruction.) / Allies cannot use the same Karma
2)	Equipment, Costume, Set Items, Karma Passives, and all other stat effects do not apply. All players will start the game with the same stats. 
3)	All characters will have the same set of motions and will not be adjusted to individual character features. 
4)	Combo limit has been removed for Destruction mode.

[b]-	How to Play[/b]
1)	Defeat enemy characters, monsters, and neutral monsters to increase your level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f565ac2748c7dab6455150c6c61baf33329a9546.jpg[/img]

2)	When you level up, your stats will increase and you will unlock a skill or increase a level on a skill. 
(When you level up, select the desired skill to level it up (default: number keys 1-4)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9b9e2cdec85c15282fe8f050febeaff0f92380c6.jpg[/img]

3)	Defeat neutral monsters to gain buffs or summon monsters to your side. 

- [b]Golem[/b]: Defeat the Golem to have it become your ally for a set duration. Fight with it to destroy the enemy towers. 
(A much stronger Golem will spawn after it is defeated for the 3rd time.)
- [b]Chaos[/b]: Defeat the Chaos to grant your allies with powerful Hero Buffs for a set duration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c844ce9f644f238302f8a42a0e58f3066cbf3be5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a155b554862095ffa65dc2a11a3822650312c4b0.jpg[/img]

4)	Make use of your character progression and neutral monsters to destroy enemy towers all the way to their final base tower to win.
Tip
1)	Press [Tab] to see information about the current match. 
2)	Press (B) on keyboard to recall to your base.  
3)	Go to designated region in your base to recover your HP. 
4)	Neutral monsters will start recovering HP if they leave their territory. 
5)	When you die, you will be respawned at the start point. Your respawn timer will increase with your levels. 

[b]Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/815c1ff0eec52e72c69a426137df1e02a3805bb7.jpg[/img]

[b]Control Revamp (Limited to Destruction – Beta Mode)[/b]
You can experience the control revamp in ‘Destruction’ – Beta Mode. 
We limited the changes to Destruction so that you can play and test these changes for yourself before they are applied to the rest of the game. 

[b]1)	Stamina/Mana removed[/b]
We simplified resource management so that you can better focus on the battle itself. 

[b]2)	Changes due to Stamina Removal[/b]
Because stamina is removed some command skills had to be adjusted. 
- Dual Soul’s RMB movement distance reduced.
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will now use Dash Spheres.
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will now use Dash Spheres.
- Lightning Fang’s RMB reflect will now use Dash Spheres when reflect is successful.
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will now use Dash Spheres.

[b]3)	Blow System removed[/b]
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 

[b]4)	Combining Dash & Evade[/b]
We combined Dash & Evade because they serve a similar purpose and to make it easier to manage. The new dash moves a greater distance than when these skills were used consecutively. Just spamming this skill can now put you at a disadvantage and allow enemies to punish you.
However, to minimize drastic changes from pre-existing play patterns, both the dash key and the evade key can be used to activate the new Dash.
-	Max 3 Dash Spheres (New resource consumed from activating Dash)
-	At the start of the game, all players start with 3 Dash Spheres.
-	Invincibility during Dash (Evade)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/07d45277344a3007f191db2ee10bc3273e54e97e.jpg[/img]

[b]5)	Natural Recovery removed[/b]
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result.
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times.

[b]6)	Movement Speed reduced[/b]
To control the speed of the game overall, we reduced basic movement speed and movement speed increase from Dash Sprint.
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 10% faster movement speed.

[b]7)	Knockdown, Breakfall Changes[/b]
-	Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 
-	Breakfall
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage!

[b]8)	Difficult Control Improvements[/b]
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/8aee54bae5355ba358c937a70be665e27d7a7484.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Awakening[/h3]
•	[b]Soul of Magus Awakening[/b]
-	Awakening is coming for Soul of Magus!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/98583809ef880c45002552c845f4564bcc7f6a0e.png[/img]

-	[b]How to unlock Awakening[/b]
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/7d0373f340230db83a7c530c456eec6108eab2c6.png[/img]

-	[b]Karma Skill Tree Expansion[/b]
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

[b]Expanded Soul of Magus Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/264df9425b1a689d8edbf772e0bf2279ea6dc171.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/673fd8eac00f20a38be1dcd2dfd0b6019671b8a1.jpg[/img]

[b]Soul of Magus New Awakening Skill – Lingering Souls[/b]
Leave multiple souls at a designated area. The lingering souls will explode when they come in contact with an enemy or after a set duration.
[previewyoutube=_aA0a-e4ZJ0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Soul of Magus New Awakening Rage Skill – Soul Stream[/b]
Release an intense and continuous soul stream that shoots forward. (Can move while casting)
[previewyoutube=YnvqajR4AAE;full][/previewyoutube]

With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, Sacred Guardian, Fallen Light, Ruler of Darkness, and Soul of Magus will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

-	[b]Awakening Gauge[/b]
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg[/img]

When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg[/img]

When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

-	[b]Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE[/b]
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6af593c6b5d0025f9d0d3d3608d4877609e9e1ff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: May 12th 2021 Update Pre-Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Chasers,

The upcoming update on May 12th will bring an all-new PVP mode called “Destruction” to the game. 
“Destruction” will not be part of the official PVP modes yet and will be tested in Beta Mode, where it will have no effect on Rating.
 
Please check the detail below for more on how to get started in Destruction. 

We hope to test parts of our previously planned Control Revamp with Destruction Beta Mode update.
So, go ahead and try some of these changes in the Destruction mode and compare it to what you’re used to in the official modes. 

Don’t stress about your rank as Destruction Beta Mode will not count towards it and tells us what you think about it! 

Help us by playing this new mode and also by giving us some detailed feedback through a survey.
(The survey will be available after the UTC+0 2021-05-12 maintenance.)


[h3][Destruction Mode Info][/h3]

-	Name: Destruction
-	Players: 5 vs 5
-	Victory Condition: Destroy the last tower in the enemy base
-	Play Time Limit: None
-	Special Rules
1)	You must choose 1 main Karma to play (You cannot switch your Karma during Destruction) / Allies cannot use the same Karma
2)	Equipment, Costume, Set Items, Karma Passives and all other stat effects do not apply. All players will start the game with the same stats.
3)	All characters will have the same set of motions and will not be adjusted to individual character features.

-	How to Play
1)	Defeat enemy characters, monsters, and neutral monsters to gain levels. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/514f9961fa409e90b60b9bac93c484bf6836a40f.jpg[/img]

2)	When you level up, your stats will increase and you will unlock a skill or gain a level on a skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9b9e2cdec85c15282fe8f050febeaff0f92380c6.jpg[/img]

3)	If you defeat a neutral monster, you can gain buffs or summon monsters on your side. 
[b]- Golem: [/b]Defeat the Golem to have it become your ally for a set duration and fight on your side to destroy enemy towers.
[b]- Chaos:[/b] Defeat the Chaos to grant your allies with powerful Hero Buffs for a set duration. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a155b554862095ffa65dc2a11a3822650312c4b0.jpg[/img]

4)	Progress your character and use the neutral monsters to destroy enemy towers all the way to their final base tower to win

This mode’s rules will apply alongside some control changes as we mentioned earlier. 
Check out the details below!

[h3][Control Change Details] [/h3]

1.	Stamina/Mana removed
We simplified resource management so that you can better focus on the battle itself. 

2.	Changes due to Stamina removal
Because stamina is removed, some command skills had to be adjusted.  
- Dual Soul’s RMB movement distance reduced. 
- Blazing Fist’s Dash RMB will now use Dash Spheres.  
- Soul of Magus’ Aerial RMB will now use Dash Spheres. 
- Lightning Fang’s RMB reflect will now use Dash Spheres when reflect is successful. 
- Ruler of Darkness’ Aerial Flight will now use Dash Spheres. 

3.	Blow System removed
We decided to remove the Blow System because it was hard to recognize and also, it was frustrating to be stuck in a combo for so long. 


4.	Combining Dash & Evade
We combined Dash & Evade because they serve a similar purpose and to make it easier to manage. The new dash moves a greater distance than when these skills were used consecutively. Just spamming this skill can now put you at a disadvantage and allow enemies to punish you.
However, to minimize drastic changes from pre-existing play patterns, both the dash key and the evade key can be used to activate the new Dash. 
-	Max 3 Dash Spheres (New resource consumed from activating Dash)
-	At the start of the game, all players start with 3 Dash Spheres. 
-	Invincibility during Dash (Evade)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ed454e76daa8df0bbf5eac747fad73da59c8c2d3.png[/img]

5.	Natural Recovery removed
This was removed due to giving winning players an advantage by encouraging them to run away with the lead and making the games boring as a result. 
Also with this change, we removed restriction on healing skills healing only to specific amounts, so healing skills can now be 100% effective at all times. 

6.	Movement Speed reduced
To control the speed of the game overall, we reduced basic movement speed and movement speed increase from Dash Sprint. 
To account for kiting by ranged Karmas against melee Karmas, we gave melee Karmas 10% faster movement speed. 


7.	Knockdown, Breakfall changes
-	Knockdown State
Removed invincibility from Knockdown state. You can now take damage from attacks during Knockdown. 

-	Breakfall 
Breakfall is used to get out of Knockdown quickly but follow-up attacks from enemies made this maneuver less effective than intended. Therefore, we added invincibility during Breakfall so that you can stand up from knockdown without taking damage! 

8.	Difficult Control Improvements
We made the following changes to address difficulties in Dash during Charging, using skills while Aiming, and recovering Special Resources. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5402833cb4fbf3feb3a6a6eeec55a09ecc750d5d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6105afb04fdfbc0f6915a6b5717cb557a398643b.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]PVP Season 8[/h3]
Your Season 8 Rank will depend on your rank from Season 7. 
All ranks will go down by 3.
The highest rank you can get from the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5dc2e8e3cb20295da4abaf7a4ff539654f84b4df.png[/img]

[h3]Karma Balance[/h3]
[b]•	Blazing Fist[/b]
-	Dash Attack:  Dash Attack's tracking range decreased and RMB + Dash movement speed decreased by 30%

[b]•	Soul of Magus[/b]
-	Dash Attack: Damage decreased by 25% and Break Damage decreased by 50%

[b]•	Aegis Knight[/b]

[h3]New Awakening[/h3]
[b]•	Fallen Light & Ruler of Darkness Awakening[/b]
-	Awakening is coming for Fallen Light & Ruler of Darkness!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/53a13bb8794c8217db753d5c4a8b453e9e11b9ec.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/98c41062a4ea05bd0f51fa44eeb9d4b881ca3928.png[/img]

[b]-	How to unlock Awakening[/b]
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/8e2db3dbb7777571f3b163e82c09c20bfd105d97.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3ea0995478872117467122520b9281980ea0ef6c.png[/img]

[b]-	Karma Skill Tree Expansion[/b]
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

[b]Expanded Fallen Light Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f1a487875a49229cfec8bc8e1674a43ee5cb9884.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0c787b80416966b67ecea30f8d6a76b5311fe45d.png[/img]

[b]Fallen Light New Awakening Skill - Lightning Trap[/b]
Lay a Lightning Trap that deals constant damage. Each hit will decrease the movement speed for a short duration.
[previewyoutube=JouvHi6IP8w;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Fallen Light New Awakening Rage Skill - Burning Punisher[/b]
Fire a giant bullet that explodes at a designated area.
[previewyoutube=5d6P7okfwd4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Expanded Ruler of Darkness Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/adb0a6b61bd0731666ff3e6a84ba75d7db2dcc22.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c9a6d6cb3c07d277b3d8a914af32c4add33cdfd9.png[/img]

[b]Ruler of Darkness New Awakening Skill - Death Blossom[/b]
Spread the blade of the reaper to slash and pull in the attacked enemies.
[previewyoutube=2m9xIB9rOs8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Ruler of Darkness New Awakening Rage Skill - Summon Darkness[/b]
The Reaper creates a zone of darkness that attacks multiple times.
[previewyoutube=8UGjqQt9TEU;full][/previewyoutube]

With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, Sacred Guardian, Fallen Light, and Ruler of Darkness will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

[b]-	Awakening Gauge[/b]
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg[/img]

When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg[/img]

When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

[b]-	Awakening Activation[/b]
You will no longer be able to activate awakening while using rage skills

[b]-	Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE[/b]
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f4195ebf1d73854069b7fb920b59a1b7a47aa73b.png[/img]

[h3]PVE Matchmaking System Revamp[/h3]
[b]•	PVE (Excluding Abyss)[/b]
Starting with Dungeon 4 in the 1st Region you will have the follow 2 methods of matchmaking.
-	Start with Current Members: You can enter a dungeon right away by yourself or with your current party members.
-	Queue Auto Party: After entering the queue, if there are other players, you can start the dungeon with 2 or 3 players. If there are no players found for a set duration, the minimum required player will drop to 1 and you can enter the dungeon by yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4f600cadc99010b293ecea973908d66d2f4c7dbd.png[/img]

[h3]PVE Growth Revamp[/h3]
The difficulty of PVE dungeons (excluding Abyss) have been lowered and overall, the time required to level up your character have been shortened.
You will now be able to level up a lot quicker and the rewards have also been adjusted to meet the new growth speed.

notes.title: [Announcement] April 14th 2021 Control Revamp
notes.content:
Hello Chasers,

In order to decrease the stress and the difficulty of the gameplay of KurtzPel, we are revamping the controls in time for the new season. We are still in the process of fine-tuning the details and what is written here may also change at the time of launch. 
We also have Karma Balance Change planned, and this will be announced with the patch notes. 

[b]1.	Removal of Stamina & Mana (PVP Only)[/b]
In PVP, there are many resources to manage like HP, Stamina, Mana, Skill Cooldowns, and special resources for certain Karmas. We wanted to reduce the stress of managing multiple resources in PVP and decided to remove Stamina and Mana from it. 

[b]2.	Changes made due to the removal of Stamina[/b]
Due to the removal of stamina in PVP, certain commands had to re-balanced to fit the new system. 
- Dual Soul's RMB Movement Distance Decreased
- Blazing Fist's Dash RMB will now consume Dash Spheres
- Soul of Magus's Aerial RMB will now consume Dash Spheres
- Lightning Fang's RMB reflect will now consume Dash Spheres when you successfully reflect an attack at close range
- Ruler of Darkness's Aerial Flight will now consume Dash Spheres

[b]3.	Removal of the Blow System[/b]
Due to the Blow System making the combos too long and also being hard to recognize, we decided to remove the blow system. 

[b]4.	Combining Dash & Dodge[/b]
We decided to combine Dash & Dodge and they serve a similar purpose. When you use the new Dash, it will now move further distance when used consecutively and could also be penalized for using it all at once. However, in order to stop the confusion of suddenly changing hotkeys, we decided to keep the existing keys to perform the same action. The new Dash can be used with either double tapping W or pressing Shift 
-	You can have maximum of 3 Dash Spheres (New Resource that is consumed with activation of Dash)
-	You start off with 3 Dash Spheres at the start of the game
-	When using Dash, you will be invincible
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ce8e41d551c4ae0658d1f5b591cb720f397320e0.png[/img]

[b]5.	Removal of Natural Recovery[/b]
In order to discourage the boring running meta, we are removing the natural recovery system. 
Due to this change, the limitation of heal skills only being able to heal up to the gray bar has been removed. Gray bar will no longer exist.

[b]6.	Movement Speed Decrease[/b]
In order to control the overall speed of the game, we decreased the basic movement speed and the movement speed increase from Dash Sprint. 
Also, in order to prevent a situation where a melee Karma can be kited by ranged Karmas when having the same movement speed, melee Karmas movement speed will be 10% faster than ranged Karmas. 

[b]7.	Knockdown & Breakfall Status Improvement[/b]
-	Knockdown
When you are completely knocked down on the ground, you will no longer be invincible and will take damage when you are attacked while knocked down.

-	Breakfall
Breakfall was used mostly to get out of being in knocked down status for too long but you were vulnerable to being attacked while doing it. You will now be invincible while using Breakfall, meaning you will no longer be attacked while you are quickly recovering from knockdown position.

[b]8.	Improving Difficult Controls[/b]
In order to improve the control difficulty during situations like Dashing while using Charge Commands, Using Certain Skills while Aiming, Recovering Special Resources, we have made the following changes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2e84f0cb5de57269963f04b835cffd26fe215354.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]New Awakening[/h3]
[b]•	Dual Soul & Sacred Guardian Awakening[/b]
-	Awakening is coming for Dual Soul & Sacred Guardian!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b00c3ddd00e33f2052d86a13b313742728549d53.jpg[/img]

[b]-	How to unlock Awakening[/b]
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/378dc4f83a344edaace4880ea29df891d9b09625.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/43aad1a29a644cca23ebfd8264236c195dd83d0b.png[/img]

[b]-	Karma Skill Tree Expansion[/b]
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

[b]Expanded Dual Soul Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6e8711c276715f75af8896223be0cdac64dd4dfa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/70ece009681e0051d1bf020d29b61d46787ebca5.png[/img]

[b]Dual Soul New Awakening Skill - Beast Fang[/b]
Swing the dual sword multiple times to cause the enemies to bleed. (Bleed can stack)
[previewyoutube=SAv2wuEmRCI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Dual Soul New Awakening Rage Skill - Guillotine[/b]
Lift all nearby enemies in the air and slash them to cause devastating damage.
[previewyoutube=P2WJO7wikZw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Expanded Sacred Guardian Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2d0e80d3cff6cd84c4651db4fc5b57fa75529618.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/073cabfdab6ccbb0cd1f45fa635d62f5039b33e2.png[/img]

[b]Sacred Guardian New Awakening Skill - Judgment[/b]
Smash the ground forward and cause a stun. 
[previewyoutube=7_xw2NB3jbU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Sacred Guardian New Awakening Rage Skill - Hammer of God[/b]
Summon the Hammer of God to create an earthquake.
[previewyoutube=1ESKU0YCXuw;full][/previewyoutube]

With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, and Sacred Guardian will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

[b]-	Awakening Gauge[/b]
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg[/img]

When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg[/img]

When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

[b]-	Awakening Activation[/b]
You will no longer be able to activate awakening while using rage skills

[b]-	Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE[/b]
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/868eb1fa5f0d0cb42aaa7992fb0c93eb03b686cc.png[/img]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
•	Fixed the visual bug where some new players weren't able to see the progress of their attendance event even though it was working properly
•	Fixed the bug where you couldn't change your Karma if you were matched up while looking at your inventory
•	Fixed the bug where item slot won't be available after items were sold in bulk
•	Fixed the bug where you were able to equip items by right-clicking while selling items in bulk
•	Fixed the visual bug where the inspecting player's icon would show the gender for your own character instead of the inspecting character
•	Fixed the bug where Lightning Fang's Dimension Slash & Lightning Drop wouldn't cost mana or trigger cooldown at times
•	Fixed the bug where using Rider Emotes would be canceled by using Skills or Evade
