notes.title: February 9th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) February 9th,2021 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3ae76641d7dd770d192edfb3509ac5f52dd0629b.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]New Awakening[/h3]
[b]•	Diabolic Witch & Blazing Fist Awakening[/b]
-	Awakening is coming for Diabolic Witch & Blazing Fist!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/92d644dec0a3e10ebd222550a40dd0772c2a25f3.png[/img]

[b]-	How to unlock Awakening[/b]
Reach Lv.20 and Karma Lv.6 on your character, then you will be able to talk to the NPC inside Eltheca to receive the Awakening Quest. Once complete, you will receive an item that will unlock your awakening. These awakening quests can be complete by playing dungeons within your level range or can be unlocked by purchasing Awakening Tomes in the KP Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/921c19e26efc2376c51d0239aa73c1c003aa8fd2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/d5263109a6510ccf94dba36ac214a144bf4f1daf.png[/img]

[b]-	Karma Skill Tree Expansion[/b]
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

[b]Expanded Diabolic Witch Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/cd62f7b3a978bb355799e309890032982319c8ea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5ac2abffcd5ba0d6277332ee117c3b26ce5a4faa.png[/img]

[b]Diabolic Witch New Awakening Skill - Circle of Elements[/b]
Summon a sphere of multiple elements that circles the caster that hits multiple times.
[previewyoutube=NNY56J1zYrY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Diabolic Witch New Awakening Rage Skill - Catastrophe[/b]
In a large area around the caster, create numerous volcano, blizzard, and lightning strikes.
[previewyoutube=LkeNnEVvTdE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Expanded Blazing Fist Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2a175d8accd83b20b12ad493713feab8e534e7d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/fd0f12a54056fa391d0b1a25613f4c47cde5c58d.png[/img]

[b]Blazing Fist New Awakening Skill - Blazing Strike[/b]
Surround yourself with fire and charge forward. When an enemy gets in contact with the caster, residual embers will explode after a set duration.
[previewyoutube=wsnIUdNYsv4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Blazing Fist New Awakening Rage Skill - Nuclear Punch[/b]
Awaken the God of Combat within you and punch with all your might to create a giant shockwave that shoots forward.
[previewyoutube=-y8mNNmSG0Q;full][/previewyoutube]


With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, and Blazing Fist will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

[b]-	Awakening Gauge[/b]
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg[/img]

When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg[/img]

When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

[b]-	Awakening Activation[/b]
You will no longer be able to activate awakening while using rage skills

[b]-	Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE[/b]
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f4195ebf1d73854069b7fb920b59a1b7a47aa73b.png[/img]

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
[b]•	Challenge UI Improvement[/b]
-	Challenge UI has been added to the main screen to increase its visibility.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/68c2849f239eddc088062ae1276a77d8c6334e33.png[/img]

[b]•	Supply Box Visual Improvement & Change[/b]
-	Icon has been changed for certain items from the Supply Box and the Supply Box itself will no longer be tradable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2c60a1bb8d6857bc527fd2c06dfea641a05a63d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c25735465458a6b84f5d83e56400d6ac4de19275.png[/img]

[b]•	'New Karma' Quest Removed[/b]
-	As the quest 'New Karma' can no longer be completed, it has been removed from the game

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
•	Fixed the issue when after dying and being resurrected, dashing and skill activation wouldn't work until the Karma was switched
•	Fixed the issue where Justice Bellatos Costume from the KP shop were untradable
•	Fixed the issue when switching your Karma after using Fallen Light's Mist Trap would remove the invisibility effect
•	Fixed the issue when using the Diabolic Witch's Command Fireball would make it stuck on the ground
•	Fixed the issue where Diabolic Witch's Ice Wall would make the Abyss Dungeon's trap appear in the air
•	Fixed the issue with Lightning Fang's RMB + LMB command's elemental shuriken not switching to random elements

notes.title: January 27th 2021 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]EDIT: Due to technical issues, the maintenance has been extended by 1 more hour. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/h3]

Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) January 27th,2021 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2f075ed6d06dfc2bfa06e854e79d49a03fd2bc8e.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]PVP Season 7[/h3]
Your Season 7 Rank will depend on your rank from Season 6. 
All ranks will go down by 3.
The highest rank you can get from the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/76004d6c7f14eaeffece436e2d69eb66afc0c671.png[/img]

[h3]Karma Balance[/h3]
[b]•	General[/b]
-	Barrier will start decreasing at 3 min instead of 6 min
-	All Slayer Karma's idle endurance is increased from 100% to 400% (Skill endurance remains unchanged)
-	Magic Stone stat HP Increase will now apply only up to 6000 in PVP (Players who already have this HP increase stat will be able to change the HP stat to a different stat of their choice) (Another announcement will follow)
https://steamcommunity.com/games/844870/announcements/detail/3014565822045535972

[b]•	Sword Taliah[/b]
-	Spinning Rising Slash - Endurance decreased by 27%, damage decreased by 20% and break damage decreased by 45%

[b]•	Dance of Wind[/b]
-	LMB RMB RMB Attack - 2nd arrow's break damage decreased by 50% and 3rd arrow's fully charged break damage decreased by 50%
-	Salvo Arrow - Mana cost for each arrow decreased by 50% (15/10/10/10/10)
-	Binding Arrow - Damage increased by 20% and break damage decreased by 10%
-	Raining Arrows - Duration decreased by 60%, damage increase over time effect increased by 165%, and break damage increase over time effect increased by 150%
-	Siege Mode - Break damage decreased by 57%

[b]•	Diabolic Witch[/b]
-	Mana Ray - Mana cost required to get to 3rd charge is decreased by 30%
-	Fireball - Will start casting as soon as the skill is activated and casting time decreased from 2 sec. to 1 sec. Also, canceling the cast will no longer consume mana
-	Meteor - Damage increased by 35%
-	RMB Hold Lightning - Damage increased by 50%
-	Aerial RMB Hold Meditation - Initial usage stamina cost increased by 20%

[b]•	Blazing Fist[/b]
-	Great Retaliation - Endurance decreased by 40%, break damage decreased by 29%
-	RMB during Dash - Endurance will no longer increase
-	Ultimate Heat - Stun duration increased from 1.5 sec. to 1.8 sec.

[b]•	Sacred Guardian[/b]
-	RMB Charge - 2nd & 3rd Charge movement speed decreased by 15%, endurance increase during charge decreased by 25%
-	RMB Attack - 1st hit attack activation has been slowed by 0.1 sec. and 1st hit attack's attack radius has been decreased by 10%

[b]•	Lightning Fang[/b]
-	Command Attack - Damage decreased by 10%
-	Flame Strike - Endurance decreased by 33%
-	Thunder Wolf - Damage and Break decreased by 20%
-	Demon Blade Unleashed - Attack range decreased by 30%, endurance will no longer increase
-	Tomb of Blades - Damage decreased by 10%

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
[b]•	Leveling EXP[/b]
-	Required EXP to level up from Lv.7 - 28 has been decreased.
-	PVE 3rd Region will now award more EXP

[b]•	Weapon Icon Change[/b]
-	All weapon icon's shape will change from hexagon to square shape

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
•	Fixed the bug with Blink Kunai not working properly
•	Fixed the bug with Chaos Energy accessory effect not disappearing when using Dual Soul's Demon Mode skill
•	Fixed the visual bug with Resurrection UI not disappearing when the matchmaking UI pops up
•	Fixed the bug where Sword Taliah Aether & Dance of Wind Aether were acquired from PVP under certain conditions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6a906e705ba4904d430c6c5020d9b76978dbd3ca.jpg[/img]

[b]-	Karma Skill Tree Expansion[/b]
When you unlock your awakening, you can level up your karma up to Lv.11 and you can become stronger with each level by acquiring passives or new skills.

[b]Expanded Sword Taliah Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/541f4e3ee4792f5319eaf12365df2d5ec872678c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/45e7a32006ed16852bacf31f17ec2eb961789f6d.png[/img]

[b]Expanded Dance of Wind Skill Tree[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/18b1f4c8a61a8e6a74dd98e6691e3657415a90e0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/7b002a3fc030e201a8255f3322248d0d89f4cccd.png[/img]

With this update, all Karma's max level will be increased from 5 to 6 but only Sword Taliah & Dance of Wind will be able to reach Lv.11 through Awakening.

[b]-	Awakening Gauge[/b]
Once you unlock your Awakening, you will be able to use the Awakening Gauge in dungeons.
Your awakening gauge will increase by dealing damage to monsters and the amount of gauge increased will depend on your damage. Once you have filled up your awakening gauge, you will be able to activate it with L-Alt key. When the Awakening Gauge is active, your movement speed, attack power, stamina recovery, and mana recovery will be increased for a set duration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b41e61d4d15ef945c6499ba599587de803c7b0ca.jpg[/img]

When your Awakening is active, you can perfectly dodge an enemy's attack to slow everything around you and gain additional movement speed, action speed, mana/stamina/hp recovery increase buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ea7c511140451504e0a37a89c6f679d70435698.jpg[/img]

When you acquire the Awakening Rage Skill by hitting Lv.10 on your Karma, you will be able to use the Awakening Rage Skill by awakening with a full rage bar. The awakening rage skill must be used before the Awakening effect expires.

[b]-	Effect of Awakening Skills on PVP & PVE[/b]
Certain awakening system and skills will only be usable in dungeons. We are still reviewing the possibility of allowing awakening skills in PVP but only after awakening for all karmas are released.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f4195ebf1d73854069b7fb920b59a1b7a47aa73b.png[/img]

[b]•	Costume Set Effect System[/b]
-	Set effects for costumes will be added. Set options are additional effects that you can gain by having certain number of pieces equipped on your character. 
You can check the set effect by looking at the tooltip of costumes that has set effects.

[b]Set Option Tooltip[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4b7cdf9fc80a91c6c54dbcfe33c5ed20f39ce788.png[/img]

[b]9-Piece Set Effect Activated[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2d9681edad8cbe10ee92f8a7f222161dfa4f28ff.png[/img]

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
[b]•	Supply Box Usage Improvement[/b]
-	Before, you would have to walk towards the Supply Box in Eltheca in order to use the Supply Boxes you had. Now, you can simply right-click the supply box in your inventory to use it right away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/50572439ac95f9bd2769fc71012211d7a8cf2f6a.png[/img]

You can also preview the content of the Supply Box from the KP Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/16103eb86a1cd62b0671a464e894436c683a12b2.png[/img]

[h3]Event[/h3]
[b]•	New & Returning Chaser Attendance Event (Duration Until Further Notice)[/b]
-	New attendance event will categorize players in to two groups, new and returning.

o	[b]New Chaser:[/b] Players who logged in to the game for the first time after the January 13th Update (Existing players who does not fall under the returning Chaser category will also fall under the New Chaser category for this event)
o	[b]Returning:[/b] Existing Chasers who hasn't logged in to the game for more than 30 days

-	This attendance event will contain items such as [Eltheca] AP + 100% Boost (1 Day), [Eltheca] CP + 100% Boost (1 Day), [Eltheca] EXP + 100% Boost (1 Day), [Eltheca] Heroic Karma Token Select Cube, [Eltheca] Advanced Dye, [Eltheca] Resurrection Stone, Settia Outfit & Accessory Cube (Limited Time), [Eltheca] Item Sealing Scroll, [Eltheca] Character Appearance Change Ticket, [Eltheca] Inventory Expansion Ticket Selection Cube, and more!

[h3]Etc[/h3]
[b]•	Key Customization[/b]
-	Due to the release of the awakening system, your current keyboard customization will be reset. We suggest players take a screenshot of their current key binding to make resetting your key binding easy.


[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
•	Fixed the issue where Sealing Scrolls weren't showing up in the Special - Etc category in the Trading Post

- Before, you would have to walk towards the Supply Box in Eltheca in order to use the Supply Boxes you had. Now, you can simply right-click the supply box in your inventory to use it right away.

notes.title: December 16th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) December 16th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/7d9a4925fed651404b78583e336a3ad6530f8e91.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)
[h3]
New Content[/h3]
[b]•	Abyss Dungeon[/b]
-	Abyss is a special dungeon that opens up once your character reaches Lv.15 and can only be entered when you have an entry ticket. The monsters in the Abyss are powerful so you won't be able to enter yourself, you must enter with a party of 3 or go through matchmaking to meet other 2 players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/578fecbd1a3dc0ebf62cb697e467f5f37d218210.png[/img]

(Abyss Map (Entry Ticket) can be acquired from normal dungeons in Kagor (2nd Region) or higher)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2376bc8b2324385d991f27467f4f873542ee2ef7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b7d6e182b5b6bcc33f32c2706767c58e9f62d058.png[/img][/url]

-	There are 10 stages to the Abyss Dungeons and each floor has its own mechanic. As you progress through the stages, the monsters will become stronger.
-	The abyss dungeon will drop Soul Stones which will make your character stronger and Refiners which are used to strengthen your soul stones.

[b]•	Soul Stone System[/b]
-	Soul Stones are items that can be added to your equipment that gives extra boost in stats. These soul stones can be extracted or equipped to different equipment so it will grow with your character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3fda4a774d55815c2c4d42c612ca3b1a768e9216.png[/img]
[Opened Soul Stone Socket]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b6864691226a2518a9dafc8d072acfc29d88e56e.png[/img]
[Socketing Soul Stone to Equipment]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/28aaf50ecf8b2c4bf276c8cc5c8267a75872a1e9.png[/img]
[Refining Soul Stone with Equipment]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/fb09ba612310583e60894c5eb7d091b60416aaee.png[/img]
[Combining Soul Stones]

[b]o	Soul Stone:[/b] Can be socketed to your equipment will increase stats based on the refinement of your soul stone. It can also be extracted and socketed to new equipment you acquire
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5c0ba2bf4b61ec8ecaf4d7c4225cf7ae07b154c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3e7d5728f0d12e7fc9c68d3c3700cce9ae5aa228.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2ea2f5b62bf6f8e6c2f1c573052d528fcd100e86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b4211058e0e16cd81ed5b646d8f81301852c8c8e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2d12a737f2416010a4060c8de10d44ce6fe94c40.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/eaff40d398c2f1ec8e4b5e0d65df9d3d63af0091.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/bb39fd51130fba196a5696851397940c22fa403f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1ad26ebaffb555839f32cbf0bdb02dfd0fff55c5.png[/img][/url]

o	Refiner: Can be used to refine your soul stone and only drops from Abyss Dungeons. (You can also acquire these by extracting your equipment at a later date)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/fbcbbfc3c94a420423859bb0661f4cbd6ceaa24c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/dbf2d54a0b6530cbb0a09378a1ef2600e70945c9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/792ad31c1de88c0b60e331fde317f2d6411eb9dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/d72eb60f6ad60fe5f679f478bea1d7f7c88810db.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/96f626a7b2a0d7099d757174f0cc6262365f1914.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a2ec5b2a7019618c56cbdd91070b957240c9926f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ee638113488102dc45a9a0190e434d74011ca126.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/dd371080bd924530b1d858cda010457b170e1dee.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
[b]•	Quest System Improvement[/b]
-	More categories for quests will be added. Also, new daily and weekly quests will be added that can be done repeatedly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5596d443d9bb9f0434c662be65fb790a05c84854.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/07b5780a25072a39333c685de796776a82379c2c.png[/img]

[b]•	Mass Sell Function[/b]
-	You can now sell multiple items at once instead of selling it one by one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4f6ba6a678d2fb8e91b2a85a3529746c97bb4474.png[/img]

[b]•	Resurrect with KP Function[/b]
-	You can now resurrect with KP even if you run out of resurrection stones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2e8996eb80b4d1f6892bfdd5e20809349515c035.png[/img]

[b]•	Quick Slot Expansion[/b]
-	You can now expand the number of unlocked quick slots. 2 Quick Slots will be unlocked by default and you can open 3 additional slots by purchasing Quick Slot Open Ticket from the KP Shop

[b]•	Equipment Special Inventory Added[/b]
-	New Equipment Special Inventory will be added. This inventory will hold items that are required to enhance your equipment, soul stones, and etc. This inventory can also be expanded by using an item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a19bc1a4f6ac47bdf00211069d64130a18e4e9d2.png[/img]

[b]•	Expired Supply Box[/b]
-	Expired Supply Boxes that were available during events will now become untradable.

[h3]Event[/h3]
[b]•	Christmas in Eltheca[/b]
-	Snow and Christmas is coming to Eltheca! Check out the giant Christmas tree, decorations, and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/72af0bb1a08be7d37818bcfe1b0c4273a79bb89c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/84a95a0ee6749e9351e0dbc328f7762c62bc716a.png[/img]

notes.title: November 19th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) November 19th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5bb8543de13083dffd0eb5d497620ac50a4d2d8d.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]New System[/h3]
[b]•	Character Leveling System Added[/b]
-	You can now level up your characters by acquiring EXP. EXP can be acquired by completing Quests and PVE Dungeon Missions.

[b]•	Equipment System Added[/b]
-	You can now acquire equipment that affects your PVE stats. Equipment will be strictly for PVE and will not affect PVP in no shape or form. There are difference item grades for equipment and you can acquire these from the CP Shop, Quests, and PVE Dungeon Missions.

[b]•	Equipment Enhancement System Added[/b]
-	You can enhance your PVE equipment by acquiring enhancement stones from Quests & PVE Dungeon Missions. Enhancing your equipment will increase the stats and help your character become stronger in PVE.

[b]•	Quest System Added[/b]
-	The new quest system will assist you with your PVE progress and provide guidance. Quests will provide useful items for your adventure and also provide some background on what the Chasers are up to.

[b]•	Story System Added[/b]
-	You will now be able to find out what Bellatos was up to and how the Chase is trying to stop them to save Eltheca.  More story will come at a later date.

[h3]Revamp[/h3]
[b]•	PVE Revamp[/b]
-	KurtzPel's PVE will be revamped to include dungeons, quests, equipment and character leveling. Please note that all these new PVE revamps will not affect the current PVP at all. You will also get HP and MP potions that you can use in dungeons and not feeling forced to bring a healer or conserving on mana during combat.
o	Movement will no longer cost Stamina (Dash & Evade)
o	Blazing Fist can now grab multiple enemies at once
o	Karma Switching attack will not have any cooldown
o	Chase Attack can now hit multiple targets (Lift up multiple enemies at once)
o	Cooldown on skills will be decreased

[b]•	Stats Revamp[/b]
-	Base Attack Power Adjusted
Base Attack Power for Slayers and Breakers will be changed.
Karmas with the same role will have the same attack power
Breaker: 400 | Slayer: 600
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/402aab4cf52e767c9676a3df243b86a0317ee133.png[/img]

-	Base Critical Rate Adjusted
Base critical rate for each role will become the same
Breaker: 25% | Slayer: 30%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/cba4dfc1ffa8577956b76335b23d38337753487a.png[/img]

-	Base Movement Speed Adjusted
Base movement speed for all Karmas will be adjusted
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c71c511d7d8977ebea05951223275e1d6415041c.png[/img]

-	Base Defense Adjusted
Base Defense for all role will become the same
Breaker: 58% | Slayer: 41%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2fcd31bb157255f62a7915d42dabdb1eb4d20331.png[/img]

-	Physical and Magical Stats Combined
o	Physical and Magical Attack Power will be combined to Attack Power
o	Physical and Magical Critical Rate will be combined to Critical Rate
o	Physical and Magical Defense will be combined to Defense
o	Action Speed and Casting Speed will be combined to Action Speed
o	This applies to all pre-existing Magic Stones

-	Base MP and Stamina Adjusted
Base MP will be adjusted to 250 and Stamina to 150 for all Karmas

[b]•	Resurrection System Revamp[/b]
-	You will now be able to resurrect not only yourself but your teammates as well using resurrection stones.

[b]•	PVE Only Camera Shake System Added[/b]
-	When playing the game, you'll be able to adjust the camera shake applied for PVP and PVE separately.
-	You can adjust them according to your preference
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ef3b3e48547811f6ca8bcd62602a3df51bbbec48.png[/img]

[h3]Karma Balance[/h3]
[b]•	Sword Taliah[/b]
-	Common
o	Leap hits will now pull enemy towards the center of the casting circle
o	If RMB hold is charging for too long, it will automatically switch to the 2nd Charge Attack
-	PVE
o	RMB 2 Stage Hold Attack's Damage and Break Damage decreased by 30%

[b]•	Dance of Wind[/b]
-	Common
o	Dash Attack, LMB LMB RMB, LMB RMB RMB charge chase attack will become AOE
-	PVE
o	Projectile Attacks will now become piercing attacks (LMB LMB LMB, LMB LMB LMB Hold, LMB RMB RMB, when in the air LMB LMB LMB, Evade Attack, RMB Hold Attack, Siege Mode, Storming Arrow, Salvo Arrow)
o	Siege Mode each projectile damage and break damage decreased by 40%

[b]•	Diabolic Witch[/b]
-	Common
o	Black Hole hit will no longer push back enemies
o	Channeling mana cost for Blizzard and Mana Ray decreased by 50%
-	PVE
o	 Projectile Attacks will now become piercing attacks (LMB LMB LMB, LMB LMB LMB Hold, when in the air LMB LMB LMB, when in the air LMB LMB LMB Hold, RMB Hold)

[b]•	Dual Soul[/b]
-	PVE
o	Moon Slash damage and break damage is decreased by 30%
o	Wolf Fang each projectile damage and break damage increased by 70%

[b]•	Sacred Guardian[/b]
-	Common
o	Rage Skill Faith is removed and replaced with Ultimate Swing
	Ultimate swing draws in all nearby enemies toward the caster and swing at them with a Giant Holy Hammer
o	Crusade can now pin multiple enemies at once

[b]•	Fallen Light[/b]
-	PVE
o	Dragon Breath damage is decreased by 50%
o	Projectile Attacks will now become piercing attacks (LMB LMB LMB, LMB LMB LMB Hold)
o	LMB LMB LMB Hold's projectile damage decreased by 50%

[b]•	Soul of Magus[/b]
-	PVE
o	Spirit Rain's damage decreased by 30%
o	Projectile Attacks will now become piercing attacks (LMB LMB LMB LMB, LMB LMB RMB, Additional Attacks from Communion)

[b]•	Aegis Knight[/b]
-	Common
o	Battlecry's last hit will now pull the enemy toward the caster
-	PVE
o	Charge Attack's additional hits after the first hit damage and break damage increased up to 100%

[b]•	Lightning Fang[/b]
-	PVE
o	Projectile Attacks will now become piercing attacks (RMB LMB Charge - Wind)

[h3]ETC[/h3]
[b]•	Supply Box[/b]
-	Resurrection Stone quantity and rate increased

[b]•	Trading Post[/b]
-	After this maintenance, all items up on the trading post will be returned to the original poster. The fee that was deducted will also be returned.

You can also check out our previous announcement regarding the PVE Revamp here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/844870/announcements/detail/2896339356354737354

notes.title: KurtzPel Upcoming Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Chasers

It's been a long time coming but we are finally here with some exciting news for the future of KurtzPel.

We have been hard at work to bring you a content update that would be impactful and meaningful to KurtzPel and we are finally here to tell you all about it.


[b]New PVE Dungeons[/b]
We are changing the way you play PVE in KurtzPel with the all new PVE dungeons. You will go through sections of a dungeon and fight countless monsters along the way before fighting the boss at the end. 
[previewyoutube=cXHLeLW7-bM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]PVE Character Progression & PVE Equipment[/b]
Your character will now level up from gaining EXP from PVE dungeons and you will also receive PVE equipment from clearing dungeons or completing quests. PVE equipment will have different item grades with stats so you'll be able to optimize the perfect gear for your playstyle. Lastly, these new PVE equipment will not affect PVP in any way shape or form so you won't have to worry about feeling like you are forced to play either PVP or PVE.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/98165218679b7de5ce0b4f7c679d95eea70bc106.png[/img]

[b]PVE Combat Mechanic Change[/b]
The combat mechanic and system in PVP will remain untouched but in order to make the PVE experience more fun and exciting, we are making some changes to how some of them work in PVE.
•	Movement will no longer cost Stamina (Dash & Evade)
•	Blazing Fist can now grab multiple enemies at once
•	Karma Switching attack will not have any cooldown
•	Chase Attack can now hit multiple targets (Lift up multiple enemies at once)
•	Cooldown on skills will be decreased
[previewyoutube=MITuDpdHXyY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Potion System[/b]
Potions will be added to PVE. These potions will only work in PVE and can restore HP and MP. This will increase the amount of skill you can use during combat without feeling helpless once your HP or MP runs out.

[b]Resurrection System[/b]
You will now be able to resurrect not only yourself but your allies using your resurrection stones. This is also a PVE only feature.

[b]Quest System[/b]
We are adding a Quest System to share the lore and story of KurtzPel to our fellow Chasers. The quest system will not only serve as a mean to expand the story of KurtzPel but also to work as a guide for players to continue their PVE progression. There will also be helpful items provided as a reward for completing certain quests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/da7b4dddf9cd816ae23120fddf35f7fec1ce9ac2.png[/img]

[b]Story[/b]
You can now discover the story of KurtzPel by playing through the new PVE dungeons. As you clear more dungeons, you will find more about the dungeons and the region they are in.
[previewyoutube=qanpxZVV7D0;full][/previewyoutube]

We will also work on the following for the future:
•	Challenging PVE Content
•	Continued update of dungeons & Karma
•	Continued update of Character and Equipment growth
•	New PVP Modes
•	Updates that impact the stale PVP meta

Please note that the video and screenshot shown above is not final and can differ from the final product.

We hope you are excited about the upcoming changes and we hope to bring it to you as soon as possible. Please continue to support us and send us your valuable feedback.
We will continue to update everyone as soon as we have more news about KurtzPel's future contents.

Lastly, the above content will be coming to KurtzPel before the end of November 2020.

Thank you.

notes.title: September 23rd 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) September 23rd,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9186d5ed0fe10e5ff398022c9b6dbf022f347aa4.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)


[h3]New Karma - Lightning Fang[/h3]

Name: Lightning Fang
Weapon: Kunai
Type: Mid-Range, Slayer

Lightning Fang is a magic slayer that uses a Kunai as its main weapon.
Lightning Fang can use the Kunai to distract the enemy from afar and can dish out big damage when the enemy becomes vulnerable. Due to Lightning Fang's mobility and the ability to blink a certain distance, this Karma will be a biggest threat to long-ranged Karmas.

[h3]PVP Season 6[/h3]
Ranks for Season 6 will be based on your rank from Season 5.
All ranks will be decreased by 3.
The highest rank at the start of the season is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, all E ranks will be reset to E1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f20a338a4aa8020189e70a4d0de47f545f173547.png[/img]

[h3]New System - Decks[/h3]
You can now preset your load-out with the all-new Deck system.
The deck system will be applied for Karma / Equipment / Emote can there can be a total of 3 Decks each.
In order to open additional deck slots, you need to have an item that unlocks the slots. (Can be purchased from the KP Shop)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ffd981830f83dd57e3015b8e218dd0dbbc56e2f7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/8eb7495475684ef318abe1cf6fd253389072130f.jpg[/img]
<Karma, Equipment, and Emote Deck Item>

[b]Opening the Deck Slot[/b]
Method A - Click the locked slot to open it. (If you don't have the required item, you will be moved to the KP Shop)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/64ba008382ae6e0031a5a9ad866bb3ea5bcb8478.jpg[/img]

Method B - Use the Deck Open Ticket item in your inventory
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a971c8a3faf3f57b6c34231ff6d12cf757755080.jpg[/img]

[b]Opened Deck Example (Equipment)[/b]
After opening your deck slot, set the equipment you would like to use.
The items you selected will be the items that will be used when you select your deck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f415ae2496ca50fc0672ef3c24b2e6ff882ee145.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Customization - Face Shape[/h3]
In the character customization, you can now select the shape of your face. It can go from chubby to slim depending on your preference.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/62b68a8a63358b8c46c2b427eaedca4279178f1c.png[/img]

notes.title: July 15th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) July 15th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0ff330d9fcb2908d1e7ad95793ac2bcc63a0b803.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]New Karma[/h3]
[b]Name: [/b]Aegis Knight
[b]Weapon:[/b] Sword & Shield
[b]Type: [/b]Melee, Physical, Breaker

Aegis Knight uses a Sword & Shield as its weapon of choice and is a physical based Breaker.
This Karma can use the Sword & Shield to be aggressive or defensive with ease. Aegis Knight can also apply a buff to their teammates to fortify them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/978039b8a0dbe3d7172e4fd0337b0fb3ddae9612.png[/img]

[h3]PVP Season 5[/h3]
Season 5's starting ranks will depend on your rank from Season 4.
All ranks will be decreased by 3 and the highest rank possible at the start of Season 5 is B1 and the lowest is D1.
However, E Ranks will all be reset to E1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3301dd7348f57f8edae1af3be99397cb71e3b50b.png[/img]

[b]New Rank[/b]
The point of the rank system is to give a goal for the players to work towards and also to give them a sense of accomplishment. We also wanted the rank to be an indicator of a player's skill.
In Season 1, we felt the ranks gave players more despair than accomplishments due to rank decreases from losses and made players lose interest in the PVP of KurtzPel. Because of that, we decided to not let ranks fall until a player has reached a certain rank.
In Season 4, we hoped to have made the queue times shorter than with the increased number of players in S Rank.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/eb585471fab53b32d7fb14325caa82f75a0d1592.jpg[/img]

Due to the increase of S and G rank players, we wanted to improve the ranks by adding a new M Rank to the system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/30447902dd901c141cf2cd45dd074733a8c1e21c.jpg[/img]

•	M Rank will allow players to understand the proper skill level of a high-ranking player.
•	For players that were having a hard time going from S to G, M rank will give them a shorter-term goal to work towards on their path to G rank

[b]Rating Placement Segment Increase[/b]
Due to the presence of Promo Matches, there were a lot of players having a hard time ranking up due to losing their Promo Matches constantly. Many players stopped climbing at a certain point due to the stress of ranking down.

•	From S1 ~ G3 Rank, your ranking will now be reflected by your rating placement.
•	For Ranks S1 and higher, your rating will decrease if you don't play any matches for a certain period
•	Your character info and leaderboard placement will be shown starting from A Rank

[b]AI Matchmaking for Certain Ranks[/b]
In low rating area, if your matchmaking takes too long, you will be matched with AI bots with the skill appropriate for your current rank.

[b]Rank Related Feedback Increase[/b]
•	You will now be able to see your rank and progress while inside Eltheca
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/db48b232b6860e9de9febf9582f0b2df243b5ea6.jpg[/img]

•	If your next match is your promo match, it will be shown inside the Mission Map window
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f2879a622506e2eb45db68b844e41d55401eba3b.jpg[/img]

•	At the start of your promo match, your promo info will be shown
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/efd707e273e21ad33aa04ec9abae88b61e2fdbac.jpg[/img]

•	When your rank is changed, the presentation in the result screen will be improved[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/9f265d196e4fe843fc7307647fe3891cc6bfbece.jpg[/img]

[h3]Karma Balance[/h3]
[b]General[/b]
Combo Damage Limit Increased

Removed the system multiple Chase prevention system where it makes the attacked player get knocked down when they are attacked by Chase attack too often in a set duration

Fixed the error with Siege Mode and Salvo Arrow not activating immediately after casting at certain times

Basic Movement Speed Changed for Karmas
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/90aa6ea2e0a7ef852533647af03fd96ca00700a4.png[/img]

[b]Sacred Guardian[/b]
While charging RMB, LMB attack damage will be decreased by 50% (Break Damage will remain the same)
RMB Attack's first attack timing will be activated at the time of smashing the hammer. (Slower by 0.4 sec.)

Gigantic Swing
-	Damage Decreased by 30% (Break Damage Unchanged)
-	Stun Duration Decreased from 2 sec. to 1 sec.
-	Break Damage decreased by 30%

Crusade Endurance Increased by 50%
Movement Speed decreased by 35% while holding down RMB

[b]Dance of Wind[/b]
Binding Arrow
-	Break Damage decreased by 30%
-	Won't be able to break the Breakers normal endurance

LMB Command Attack's Break Damage decreased by 50%
RMB Charge Attack's Break Damage Removed
LMB RMB RMB attack won't have increased break damage even if it is charged
LMB RMB RMB attack's final projectile distance decreased
LMB LMB RMB attack's final projectile distance decreased

Salvo Arrow
-	Follow-Up Arrow's mana cost is decreased by 35%

[b]Fallen Light[/b]
LMB and RMB Command attack's Break Damage decreased by 50%

Slug Shot
-	Projectile's distance and knockback distance decreased

Atomic Blast
-	You will no longer be able to Rage Break while being attacked

[b]Soul of Magus[/b]
LMB and RMB Command attack's Break Damage decreased by 50%

[b]Sword Taliah[/b]
Leap
-	Break Damage increased by 20%

[b]Blazing Fist[/b]
Instant Chase
-	Break Damage increased by 30%

[b]Ruler of Darkness[/b]
Decreased the strength of pull by 50%

Rising Wings
-	Endurance increased by 50%

Death Hold
-	Endurance decreased by 50%

Demon Rush
-	Endurance decreased by 50%

[h3]Etc.[/h3]
•	Season Pass can now be progressed using PVE
-	Daily and Weekly Challenges for the Season Pass will no longer solely depend on playing PVP. You will now be able to complete your challenges using PVP or PVE. 
Starting from Season 5, you will be able to complete your Daily and Weekly Challenges by only playing PVE missions.

•	Capture The Crystal (CTC) will be removed from Beta

•	Exchange CP option will be removed while you are inside the Trading Post window.
-	We felt the function to Exchange an item to CP while you are inside the Trading Post window was not necessary and decided to remove it. You can still exchange your items for CP in your normal item window.

[h3]Events[/h3]
[b]•	Aegis Knight is Here! (UTC+0 2020-07-15 05:00 - 2020-07-29 05:00)[/b]
-	During the Event Period, play using the Aegis Knight Karma to receive 30% additional AP, CP, and DP.

[b]•	Attendance Event (UTC+0 2020-07-15 05:00 - 2020-08-26 05:00)[/b]
-	Log in to the game during the Event Period to receive items such as Radiant Magic Stone, Advanced Dye, Advanced Supply Box, Salute Emote and more!

notes.title: July 9th 2020 Additional Balance Change
notes.content:
Hello Chasers!

Thank you everyone for sending in your valuable feedback about the Combat Revamp.
We realized that the changes that were made to the game on July 8th Patch strengthened the run and gun and poke meta in KurtzPel.
We wanted to apply some additional changes in order to balance out certain Karmas in the new revamped combat system.

We will continue to monitor and reflect your feedback during the Pre-Season so please give us as much feedback as possible.

[h3]Long-Range Karma's Break Damage Decrease[/h3]
In order to make it easier for melee Karmas to have an easier time approaching long-range Karmas, we decreased the break damage of long-range Karma skills.
When you are using a melee Karma, you will be broken less by long-range Karma attacks.

[b]•	Balance Target[/b]
[b]Longbow:[/b] RMB Charge Attack, Siege Mode
[b]Staff:[/b] Ice Wall, Fireball
[b]Elemental Burster:[/b] RMB Attack, Full Burst, Slug Shot
[b]Orb: [/b]Spirit Rain, Star Tempest Launch Attack, Heart Stopper

[h3]Melee Karma's Skill Cooldown Decrease (30 sec. to 25 sec.)[/h3]
We are making it easier for melee Karmas to use skills to approach long-range Karmas and recover faster. The changed cooldown may change again depending on the balance outcome after the weekends.

[b]•	Balance Target[/b]
Great Sword, Dual Sword, Gauntlet, Giant Hammer, Scythe

[h3]Combo Limit Duration Increased (10%)[/h3]
Our goal for the combo limit system was to keep the fun of combos while limiting overly dragged out combos. However, due to the Combo Limit system, Breakers were having a lot of limitations on their combo and we wanted to resolve this issue while bringing the fun of combos back. We applied a quick fix of increasing the duration of combo limit and we will think of additional ways to improve this system.

[h3]Longbow & Staff's Emergency Dodge Distance Increased[/h3]
Old Karmas like Dance of Wind and Diabolic Witch's dodge distance is shorter than newer Karmas, which made it harder for them to be out of reach of certain Karmas. In order to make it safer for these two Karmas to avoid damage, we increased the distance of their Emergency Dodge. Their normal evade distance will remain the same.

[h3]Elemental Burster's RMB Combo Limitation[/h3]
After increasing the maximum ammo capacity of Elemental Burster, it made it easier to repetitively continue their aerial LMB & RMB aerial combo. We made the change so that once RMB is used in the air, LMB won't be usable.

notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) July 8th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f2b05e8cb24c8095d3ee8bc6a4dbfe2e96eb6889.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[b]•	Sword Taliah[/b]
-	Stun Hit's additional attack input timing has been moved to the point the attack finishes hitting
-	Dash Attack's launch angle will now be the same regardless of when the attack registers as a hit

[b]•	Dance of Wind[/b]
-	Fixed the bug with dash automatically activating if you hold down your direction key after evading
-	Dash Attack and LMB + LMB + RMB attack's Chase Attack will now activate at the 1st hit instead of 2nd hit
-	Break Damage for RMB Charge attack decreased

[b]•	Sacred Guardian[/b]
-	Removed auto-targeting from RMB Charge attack's 2nd hit
-	Gigantic Swing's stun duration increased from 1 sec. to 2 sec.

[b]•	Fallen Light[/b]
-	Increased maximum ammo capacity to 9
-	Fallen Light will now start with full ammo at the start of the match
-	Basic Combo and RMB combo can now be used while moving
-	Basic Combo's 3rd hit will now fire rapid shots at all times
-	Increased hit box size and projectile speed of rapid shot

[b]•	Dual Soul[/b]
-	Demon Mode can no longer be used while being attacked
-	Demon Mode can now be detected from 1200 instead of 700

[b]•	Ruler of Darkness[/b]
-	Aerial RMB 1st Hit will now use more stacks from 1 to 3

[b]•	Blazing Fist[/b]
-	Instant Chase will no longer be able to break Crusade & Rising Wings

[b]•	Soul of Magus[/b]
-	Communion's Attack Speed Increase is decreased from 15% to 10%
-	Communion's additional hit attack power decreased

[h3]Revamp[/h3]
[b]•	Basic Control Revamp [/b]

[b]-	Blow System[/b]
o	Sword Taliah, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul, Sacred Guardian, and Ruler of Darkness will now be able to utilize this system.
o	Ground and Aerial LMB combo's last hit will now apply the Blow status to the attacked enemy. This system will make it easier to follow up on your combo after your final LMB hit.

[b]-	Pause Commands Input Method removed[/b]
o	Pause Commands for Sword Taliah, Dance of Wind, Diabolic Witch, Blazing Fist, Dual Soul and Sacred Guardian will no longer require the pause. You can now simply hold down LMB to execute these commands

[b]-	Command Attacks will no longer consume stamina[/b]

[b]-	Combo Limit Gauge function added[/b]
o	When you are attacked continuously in a combo, your combo limit gauge will start to increase and once it fills up 100%, emergency dodge will be activated. Emergency Dodge will let you escape from a combo by knocking you out of it.

[b]-	Accumulated Combo Damage Reduction function added [/b]
o	When the combo damage accumulates to a certain number, damage that is delivered after that point will be decreased.

[b]•	Rage Skill Revamp[/b]
-	Rage Skill's animation is simplified and revamped

<Rage Skill Buff Effect Revamp>
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b7b74261f7e06489be39742278b218f26115ca92.png[/img]

notes.title: [Announcement] Action Combat System Revamp
notes.content:
Hello, Chasers!

Thank you for all your feedback and continued support of KurtzPel.
We are happy to bring you this revamp that will hopefully make the gameplay even more fun and polish up the current combat system.
We read through your feedback and analyzed statistics to bring you this revamp that will take effect in the game during the Pre-Season that will happen after the July 8th 2020 maintenance.
We strongly encourage everyone to give us feedback about this new revamp during the pre-season so we have time to polish it up before Season 5 starts.


[h3]Our goal was to keep the fun of combos while trying to lessen the power gap between new and experienced players as well as making KurtzPel more approachable and easier to play for new players.[/h3]
KurtzPel has been in Early Access for just over a year now and just like other fighting games, we are facing the same problem as them.
That is the huge power gap between new and existing players due to skill and knowledge.
Fighting Games require a good matchmaking system and constant flow of new players but because of this huge power gap, new players are having a difficult time understanding and enjoying KurtzPel.
One of the biggest aspects of KurtzPel is to use a variety of Karma combinations to execute your own unique and stylish combos.
Also, because the combo-based nature of KurtzPel, it is harder to pick up and play like FPS games.


[h3]A New System that will lessen the power gap between new and experienced players[/h3]
New Attacked Status: Blow System
In order to make it easier for new players to execute combos, we've added a new Attacked Status called Blow.
Melee Weapon's Left Mouse Button (LMB) Combo and Aerial LMB combo's last attack will make the enemy enter a Blow Status.
While in this status, you can simply execute the LMB combo to continue your combo.
We are hoping this new Blow System will create a variety of different and unique combos.
Target Karma: Great Sword, Dual Sword, Gauntlet, Giant Hammer, Scythe
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e89b9e4ccd14ee96e242a8726de7c89c117b5a27.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e44e2de030cc7c22cd724e334bfb043413ec3cbe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b1d3e7ff79e34b7d3b3f735aa4e0d78ed67df112.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e23890d30cb0cecf13e2d08afdcdd859f77fdb41.gif[/img]

[b]Stamina Cost removed for Command Attacks[/b]
Managing Stamina was put in place to increase the depth of gameplay but it ended up becoming something that stressed out new players.
Command attacks will no longer consume stamina and because of this change, it will be much easier to create unique combos. We also hope this will lessen the stress of managing a resource.
From this point on, Stamina will be used for players that are constantly dashing or evading to stop them from frequently running from fights and we are also reviewing the possibility of completely removing stamina.
Veteran players might be worried about the possibility of infinite combos due to command attacks no longer requiring stamina but we will be preventing that with our new Combo Limit system.


[b]Combo Limit System[/b]
A new system that puts a limit on the length of your combo.
When you can perform a 100 to 0 combo on an opponent, it can feel awesome and rewarding.
However, when you are on the receiving end, it is very stressful, especially if there is no counter play.
We've determined that being in a helpless position where all you can do is sit and watch your character die is something that brings great fatigue and stress.
We've tried to create an escape for players by providing the Rage Break system.
But the same problem was still there and it actually didn't help much since players had to sacrifice their full rage in order to execute their Rage Break. This in turn made it even harder for a losing team to recover from their position.
This is why we are going to try and remedy this situation with the Combo Limit system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b40328403d6f2b56cabbd3c89375e573e1f1f136.gif[/img]

When you are attacked and stuck in the enemy's combo, your combo gauge will increase and when it hits 100%, your emergency dodge will be activated.
Emergency Dodge is similar to Rage Break but it does not consume your rage and will be activated automatically. 
Emergency Dodge will push you back less than the Season 4 Rage Break and will not knockback your enemies.


[b]Accumulative Combo Damage Reduction System[/b]
When the combo damage accumulates to a certain number, damage that is delivered after that point will be decreased.
The combo limit system is in place to stop the infinite combos but certain Karmas have high enough DPS that can still dish out massive damage without the help of infinite combos. We will try to remedy this with the Accumulative Combo Damage Reduction.
This system will stop players from dying from 1 combo and also lessen the stress for players stuck in helpless situations.
We believe this will make Slayers play more aggressively as they are no longer exposed to being defeated from 1 combo due to their weak defense.


[b]Removal of Pause Commands[/b]
Commands like Great Sword's spinning slash that requires players to pause in between LMB will no longer require pauses and instead, can be activated by simply holding down LMB.
We added the pause commands to encourage skilled gameplay but this was something that was hard to execute reliably for new players. Also, this combo wouldn't activate at times due to network issues even for veterans.
This new Hold LMB method will now make it easier and more reliable for players to activate the commands when they want to.
Target Karma: Great Sword, Longbow, Staff, Dual Sword, Gauntlet, Giant Hammer


[b]Skill Cooldown Increase in order to Adjust the Flow of Combat[/b]
It was easy to be out of mana when using 6 skills as they constantly came off cooldown, which made the combat too fast and hectic and we wanted to improve that.
To make it easier for players to have time to strategize and make meaningful decisions, we needed to decrease the frequency of skill use.
Adjusting the Max mana and Skill Cooldown will make players think more about when to use certain skills and encourage strategic gameplay.
                                       

[h3]Improvement to Delivery of Combat Related Info[/h3]
We believe it is important to deliver combat info in a simple and consistent manner.
In-game system that displayed indefinite or easily mistakable info were improved.


[b]Base Endurance for Same Roles were Unified[/b]
Before, Great Sword and Gauntlet's Base Endurance was different and required different break damage to break them.
From now on, Karmas with the same roles will have the same endurance.
Also, skills with the same endurance rank will require the same amount of break damage to break.


[b]Removal of Normal Passive's RNG[/b]
There were certain passive skills that relied on RNG to activate the effects like skill cooldown reset.
We believe that this cooldown reset effect made the gameplay unstable and hard to predict and wanted to move away from it.
In order to make sure opponents can know exactly when certain skills are on cooldown after use, we decided to change this effect and other passive skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/886e924ec08aa3f0c14ac24fc2aefa6781bcd680.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6c08ad471b5eacb9020b6af8c7c7e7879fad315c.png[/img]


[h3]Stat Improvement to give Freedom of choosing Weapons[/h3]
We will continue to add new weapons and wanted to give players the freedom to choose the weapon of their choice, which will encourage players to try out different weapon combinations.
We didn't want the game's system or stats on a weapon to discourage players from choosing a certain weapon and wanted to improve that.
Our change to Weapon Movement Speed and Evade consuming Stamina instead of mana in Season 4 was part of the reason why.
In season 5, we wanted to discourage players from choosing Magic Karmas because of their high max mana and instead choose the Karma of their choice based on preference.

[b]Max Mana Different Between Karmas Decreased[/b]
-	Highest and Lowest Max Mana Different changed from 125 to 65
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1e42cf9a411dd84df0c906777389d26ce17cefa9.png[/img]

[b]Main Karma Info UI Display Improved[/b]
After the July 8th patch, all Physical and Magic related stats will display the actual stats of your equipped weapon.
We wanted to clear up the confusion some people had on the info that was displayed on the Main Karma Info window and didn't want those confusing stats to deter players from choosing certain weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/064583ea31010354beef636ed0acf0f43fbef51a.png[/img]


[h3]Balance[/h3]
The thing we wanted to address and improve this time was players being forced to run a certain meta and the gameplay becoming stale and boring.
Our goal was to have players explore and discover new combinations of Karma, Stats, and Roles. The current meta of always choosing a certain karma, HP Increase Stats or running Two Breakers or Two Slayers was not our intention.
We felt the balance needed a bit more work.

We expect the newly added Damage Adjustment system should decrease the DPS gap between weapons and have a positive effect on the meta.
We are aware that currently, certain magic stone stats like HP Increase is too efficient and outshines all other stats in comparison. We will be analyzing our data and address this in the future.
We are also planning to balance certain Karmas not being picked due to its high difficulty. We will be addressing Elemental Burster, which has the lowest win & pick rate during Season 4 by decreasing the Karma's difficulty and some of the changes will be applied to the game at the start of the Pre-Season.

We feel it is important to build a long-lasting trust between us and you, the Chasers regarding balance.
We're sure some players felt that certain balance points in the past were kind of off or different from the feedback given by the community.
Balance in KurtzPel is not decided by a few people but rather, we listen to the community's feedback and also balance based on data of win rate, pick rate, individual game modes.
In the near future, we will be communicating with you about how we balance the game and inform on the choices we've made for balance based on analyzed statistics.


[h3]In closing,[/h3]
Optimization and providing better network environment are something an online game must continue to improve upon.
At the start of this Pre-Season, we will be implementing and testing the optimization for the frame rate.
We are continuing to look for the source of issues that cause constant frame drops and lag. We are even looking at the possibility of restructuring the backend system in order to improve this aspect of KurtzPel.
It might take some time but we will continue to make improvements and wanted to share with everyone that we are working on it.

We are also preparing a roadmap that will inform everyone on the future content of KurtzPel and will definitely return to you with updates. We would like to ask for a little more patience from everyone until we can deliver this roadmap.

Thank you.
-Kurtzpel Team

Please note that the item that is closest to the bottom right corner will be used up first. Please make sure you reorganize the order in case you don't want to use the wrong piece for synthesis.

notes.title: May 20th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]EDIT: The maintenance has been extended by 1 more hour. We apologize for the inconvenience[/h3]

Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) May 20th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c76890db386b3ac1b7c617725d5049c5a9f35861.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]Tournament System Beta[/h3]
An all new Tournament System (Beta) will be added to KurtzPel.
Tournament System is a new system where multiple players fight against each other until a winner is born.
Before this becomes an official system / content for KurtzPel, we are releasing it in Beta form first to work out the kinks and polish it.
Do not be afraid to give us your feedback about the Tournament System.

[b]Beta Duration[/b]
UTC+0 2020-05-20 – Until 2020-06-03 Maintenance

[b]Tournament System Testing Time[/b]
At 20:00 for Each Server
America - 20:00 PDT
Europe - 20:00 CEST
Asia - 20:00 JST

[b]How it Works[/b]
When the set time for the Tournament System comes, a notification will go out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/867f44490d9ab225326f7c11f02aa0dafbb6c5e6.jpg[/img]

You can then enter the Tournament UI by accessing the Mission Window (M Key).
You can participate in the tournament by clicking to Register for Tournament.
If you have a partner you want to participate with, make sure to party up with them before you register to participate. You can also choose to do it alone as well.
The tournament registration period will last for 30 min and during that time, you can either enter the Training Grounds or Participate in other missions.
However, please make sure you are inside the Eltheca Lobby before the 30 min is up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/46751e62b828c83ac97ab6750218a023666c4dcb.jpg[/img]

When the registration period runs out, you will be prompted to confirm whether you will participate in the tournament. Press Participate if you are sure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c49042bae36f2d9723d8209f1029bff45226e865.jpg[/img]

Once you are successful in participating, your bracket and success message will pop up.
If you registered alone, you will automatically be matched with a partner that is equal to your skill level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f8499b47817202a11493774565d6001fb44d0c61.jpg[/img]

When your opponent is chosen, best of 16 matches will begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2e77e0c070c0e24503153a7400683eb9f159d729.jpg[/img]

When you are victorious, the matches will begin again with whoever won first.
Best of 8 matches will begin with whoever wins first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f4ee1cdde281502477f9350e4e77931ebff235a4.jpg[/img]

While you wait for your match, you can press on your enemy’s name to check their info.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1524d4bc49c70e036cef254120624b3c83f61778.jpg[/img]

When the winner of the Tournament is decided, a server wide announcement will go out that notifies the winner of the highest tier tournament.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4a1f51a399cfe5ee6299f9f2ddac209225c05d16.jpg[/img]

The winner will have a trophy icon proving their victory beside their name in Eltheca.
This trophy icon will last until the next winner of the Tournament is born.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/134cf38a7ea8ea603ce23229313f8fbb4bc3a411.jpg[/img]

[b]Hall of Fame[/b]
When you click on the Hall of Fame, you can check the most recent winners.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/81c314fe5eb75470b49aa0c111b776becf6a4aa1.jpg[/img]

You can click “View Brackets” to check the bracket status when they won.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/02d1864ab641c1ecca27e0cd069da9d36873e4e6.jpg[/img]

If you want to check your own records, you can click on My Record to view your previous brackets and result.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/99bea820e4e0ef30debf9079dd03cd28d81bc785.jpg[/img]

Click on “Recent Record” to see your previous Tournament Matches, Brackets, and results.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/7511e6c56605a8a222ee6c38ca74738882535300.jpg[/img]

When the match time goes over 10 min, the winner will be decided under the following rule.
-	Death Match: Team with the most HP wins. If HP is equal for both teams, the team with the most accumulated damage dealt will win.
-	Capture the Flag: Team with the most accumulated damage dealt will win. If the dealt damage is the same, the team with the highest HP will win.

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
•	Conquest Score Objective changed from 500 to 300

[h3]Balance[/h3]
•	[b]PVE[/b]
o	Scout Mission Difficulty Adjusted

•	[b]General[/b]
o	Chase Attack Activation Requirement Improved
Bow, Staff, and Orb's Chase Attack will now activate regardless of the distance between you and the enemy.

o	Dash Control Improvement
Fixed an issue with Dash activating even when you didn't press double tap

o	Evade i-frame Improved
All Karmas will now have the same duration of i-frame after evading.
invincibility frame will wear off once you start moving after evading

o	Knockdown Duration
In order to promote more offensive gameplay, knockdown duration has been decreased.
-	Max Knockdown duration decreased from 2.5 sec. to 1 sec.
-	Minimum Knockdown duration decreased from 1.5 sec. to 0.5 sec.

[b]•	Soul of Magus[/b]
o	Dimension Leap
Skill Radius and Damage Increased, Animation Duration Decreased

o	Heart Stopper
Damage Increased

o	Unleash Spirit
Buff Duration will now be refreshed when the skill is used again during its duration
The buff will remain even when you switch your Karma

o	Communion
Buff duration will be refreshed when the skill is used again during the duration

o	Shadow Pull
Break Damage Decreased

o	Spirit Rain
Break Damage Decreased
Flinch Decreased
Being Hit in the air will make the enemy fall to the floor

[b]•	Dance of Wind[/b]
o	Binding Arrow
Skill will now activate even if you quickly press left mouse click in ready stance

[b]•	Dual Soul[/b]
o	Basic Combo
Stability of hitting an enemy that's in the air has been improved
-	Basic Combo 1st & 3rd Hit will hit higher
-	Multi-Stab will now slowly push back enemies
-	Basic Combo's 5th Hit's Hit Stop has been removed

o	Rend
Skill's Vertical Range has been increased

[b]•	Ruler of Darkness[/b]
o	Aerial Right Click
Endurance will be decreased to match the Aerial Left Click

o	Shadow Slash
Endurance Increased by 50%
When you hit an enemy with Shadow Slash, you can move cancel faster to follow up with a combo

o	Soul Taker
Move Cancel timing during Soul Taker will be delayed

o	Rising Wings
You will now charge to the direction of your character facing
In order to increase the risk of missing the skill, if you miss your attack, your endurance will drop back down immediately once the attack motion stops
Aerial Hit Duration Decreased from 1 sec. to 0.7 sec.

o	Death Hold
In order to make it easier to follow up with a combo, once you hit an enemy, you can dash cancel
Activating Resource Cost decreased from 50 to 30
Damage and Break Damage Decreased (You will no longer be able to break attacks with highest endurance)

o	Dark Mist
Damage and Break Damage Decreased (You will no longer be able to break attacks with highest endurance)

o	Demon Rush
Skill will be adjusted to deal damage and continue combos instead of breaking an enemy
Damage Increased by 64%
Break Damage Decreased
Made it easier to follow up with a combo but hard to break enemies with just this skill alone
When using the skill, you will now be able to aim

[h3]Changes[/h3]
•	Skills that is acquired at default will no longer be tradable.

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
•	Fixed an error with Dual Soul’s weapon becoming bigger after using a certain Emote
•	Fixed a visual error after using Spirit Rain, your skills will look like it is available to use when it is not
•	Fixed an error with Orb’s left mouse click command and movement key would randomly trigger a dash
•	Fixed an error with Orb’s Heart Stopper skill not following the intended direction when firing
•	Fixed an error with Diabolic Witch able to become invisible using certain environment

notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

Maintenance will happen during the following times:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f64e33e1e19c97f2fd85ff27cc1e7fa8a122e672.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]New Karma Released[/h3]

Name: Soul of Magus
Weapon: Orb
Type: Long-Range, Slayer

Soul of Magus is a long-range magic slayer that uses an orb as a weapon.
The orb has a power and movement of its own that is separate from the wielder and is very versatile.
Your combat style will change depending on how you want to utilize the orb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/038133f93a15c080e8f1dac6b66ba973aad7e3e6.png[/img]

[h3]PVP Season 4[/h3]
Your Season 4 Rank will be soft reset depending on your rank from Season 3.
All ranks will be decreased by 3.
The highest rank you can acquire after the reset is B1 and the lowest is D1.
For E ranks, you will automatically be set to E1 regardless of which stage you were at.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/496058e9ffde7c7d3a264a6ca81dc7607c4e11c7.png[/img]

Also, starting with Season 4, there will no longer be challenges that requires a Chaser to reach a certain interrupt or damage. In order to implement these, all the daily and weekly challenges that were in progress will be reset.

[b]Consecutive Win Rating Bonus Limit[/b]
When calculating the player's rating, you will no longer receive rating bonus for more than 10 consecutive wins. Originally, our plan for the consecutive win bonus was for the good player to advance their rating fast to fight other players at their skill level but there were cases where the bonus rating was getting out of hand. 

[b]Party Rating Calculation Revamp[/b]
Party Rating calculation will no longer take the individual ranking of the party member. Instead, the rating will solely be calculated by the individual member's rating. We decided to change it this way because starting with Season 3, players were able to reach a certain rank by playing a lot and we didn't want to calculate the wrong skill rating depending on their rank.

[b]Fixed Maximum Match Rating[/b]
When a party or an individual player hits a certain rating, their matchmaking rating will be set to a fixed amount.
This is in order to reduce the matchmaking time for players with too high of a rating.
This maximum rating might change in the future depending on how it works out.

[h3]Revamp[/h3]
[b]•	Tutorial Revamp[/b]
-	A new tutorial has been added to help new players navigate the UI and controls using a Great Sword and Longbow.
-	The tutorial can be repeated at any time in the Mission Map window even after you complete it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/221d156f0873d3464cd477cdba70fd18bca35b69.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e923dcde22efe3230b06619e13e9288f87ae5716.jpg[/img]

[b]•	Beginner Mission Revamp[/b]
-	You will now be able to go through a set of beginner missions in each mode against an AI in order to learn the game. Players who did not complete the initial 3 beginner missions will be able to play it again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/70ded52df801bd9c0a24ccfabe6a51f171f15bb3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/028577823d2477e0b6f03fe6626027d189c56a97.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f4fdf1d5d64b669be3309af00fc445573a0a9f29.jpg[/img]

[b]•	Mission Revamp[/b]

[b]-	PVP[/b]
-	You can now select a PVP mode of your choice. However, you will not be able to choose the map. 
-	There will be 3 Official Modes and only those 3 official modes will impact your rank and rating.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6e6a08bf9937c3d557c8aa63b4719b07b41c60e8.png[/img]

[b]-	PVE[/b]
-	Previous Scout and Annihilation modes will be combined in to one as [Scout] missions. You will now play 1 random mission from the previous 9 missions. 
-	[Raid] missions will stay the same and rotate each day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/222a08e8b86b37adf3948d9b9ec67c1ab6bef20c.png[/img]

[b]-	Beta[/b]
-	In order to polish the two modes, Capture the Crystal and Survival: Kardia Island, they will be entering a beta phase. These two maps in beta phase will not affect your rank or rating and they can be matched separately. These two modes will rotate every 30 min and the rewards for winning will remain the same.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a8a27b4af69233bb4dc33e9854eaa1032b048d27.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f52d84830319b622089ac1925de698390ba17b22.jpg[/img]

[b]-	Mission Rewards Revamp[/b]
-	The mission rewards were changed to the following.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3a8a2e144edc3b5e80d36089ba599af1f7189ec1.png[/img]

[b]•	Command Display Revamp[/b]
-	The way Karma's command info and the way they show up in the Training Ground has been revamped.
-	Categorize commands that can only be executed in certain situations
-	Display Chase / Grab Status Separately
-	Show previously unavailable commands

Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/81691890e94aefefb49c7e064e77709423277ac0.jpg[/img]

After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/15298f088367b72fc780951dfbb84d040648de23.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
[b]•	Camera Zoom distance improved when entering Eltheca[/b]
-	When you first login to the game and enter Eltheca, your camera will be zoomed out to max as default.

Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c3e7482a795aea11c8c2cb2533204e64cf511e1a.jpg[/img]

After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4777a9478ecdc22663309427e509c37c49ee1eef.jpg[/img]

[b]•	Capture the Flag's flag icon and effect will be improved[/b]
-	In order to visually assist players, we have added new icons and effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/28058eb1fd427cdf464d2ea0a87c9334cbb02a81.jpg[/img]

[b]•	Combine Character & Karma UI[/b]
-	Character Window and Karma Window will be combined in to one in order to make it easier for players to navigate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4ae37db4486ba2acc4b0b4c37e07abbc914e4464.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e5590d9c098963f4c46507ac11d294a6ea2bbe1e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e793d599bb58ea5b87ef59e2fd7ac201a9d3ca67.jpg[/img]

[b]•	Switch Channel Window has been moved to System Menu[/b]
-	We removed the hot key for the Switch Channel function and added it to the System Menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0b1143bd3d20091821ddab4f629513dbe1a37279.jpg[/img]

[h3]Event[/h3]
[b]•	Soul of Magus Burning Event[/b] (UTC+0 2020-05-13 07:00 - 2020-05-27 05:00)
-	When playing with Soul of Magus Karma during the event, you will receive 30% Boost to AP, CP, and DP.

notes.title: April 29th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) April 29th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/7f1405c1428f7210547bbc945863600faa04575e.png[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h2]Event[/h2]
[b]1.	1 Year Anniversary Attendance Event (UTC+0 2020-4-29 06:00 – 2020-05-27 05:00)[/b]
-	Login during the Event period to receive a variety of items such as 1 Year Anniversary Hat, Wings, Emote, Gift Box and much more!

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[h3]1.	General[/h3]
[b]-	Rage Gain according to HP Increase Adjusted[/b]
	Due to the HP Increase Option Stat, players were able to use more Rage skills before death. We thought this was too overpowered and decided to decrease its efficiency in order to create diversity in meta.
	You will gain less rage depending on your HP Increase Stats

[b]-	Defense Stats Equation Adjusted[/b]
	We changed up the Defense stats equation in order for Slayers to deal more damage to Breakers but deal less damage to Slayers.
	Breaker's Physical and Magical Defense Decreased
	Slayer's Physical and Magical Defense Increased

[b]-	Movement Speed Difference Between Karmas Adjusted[/b]
	In order to lessen the impact of choosing Karmas based on movement speed, we increased the movement speed for Karmas with slower movement speed.
	Target Karma Movement Speed: Dance of Wind +3%, Diabolic Witch +11%, Sacred Guardian +9%, Fallen Light +9%, Ruler of Darkness +9%
	Certain Karmas had their evade and skills balanced around the slower movement speed, so their function will also be balanced in the future.

[h3]2.	Dance of Wind[/h3]
[b]-	LMB + RMB + RMB Attack[/b]
	In order to lessen the distance of you with the target, you can now use this attack while moving forward
	Evade + RMB + RMB will be changed the same way
	LMB + RMB + RMB charge time decreased from 1.5 sec. to 0.7 sec.
	When you charge up and use your LMB + RMB + RMB attack, it will count as a Chase Attack
	Fixed the LMB + RMB + RMB attack going through the enemy when it is used in a close distance
	LMB + RMB + RMB attack's arrow projectile speed decreased by 50% but will move the same distance as before

[b]-	Siege Mode[/b]
	When taking the Siege Mode stance, increase the attack radius and launch height distance
	When using consecutive Siege Mode attacks, the attack delay will be decreased by 50%
	No charge damage decreased by 17%
	Resource Cost Decreased from 30 to 25

[b]-	Raining Arrows[/b]
	Maintaining the attack duration by holding LMB function will be removed
	After activating Raining Arrows, you will be able to move cancel and the Raining Arrow skill effect will continue to linger, enabling you to follow up with a combo
	Decreased the dropping effect of Raining Arrows when hitting enemies in the air

[b]-	Great Archer's Soul[/b]
	In order to quickly activate the skill and follow up with an attack, removed the dynamic camera effect and decreased the time it takes to activate the first attack from 2.3 sec. to 0.8 sec.
	Attack Speed Increase Effect Decreased 1.5 times to 1.2 times
	Projectile's duration and range increased from 1.8 times to 2.5 times
	Endurance Multiplier Increased from 1.2 times to 1.5 times

[h3]3.	Diabolic Witch[/h3]
[b]-	Meteor[/b]
	The time it takes for stop time effect to kick in has been increased from 0.4 sec. to 0.5 sec.

[h3]4.	Dual Soul[/h3]
[b]-	Hit Stop Removed[/b]
	LMB 1, 2 3, 4 Hit
	Multi-Stab Command
	Dash Attack
	Evade Attack
	Moon Slash, Critical Slash, Spinning Strike

[h3]5.	Blazing Fist[/h3]
[b]-	Reckless Charge[/b]
	You will no longer be able to Evade out while dragging an enemy

[b]-	Whirlwind[/b]
	You will no longer be able to Evade out while spinning an enemy

[b]-	Falling Star[/b]
	The time it takes for stop time effect to kick in has been increased from 0.3 sec. to 0.5 sec.

[b]-	Ultimate Heat[/b]
	Fixed the issue with Ultimate Heat activating the wrong direction when there are no enemies being targeted

[h3]6.	Sacred Guardian[/h3]
[b]-	Dash Jump[/b]
	You can now activate the Hammer Jump command by Dash + RMB instead of activating it with RMB while dash sprinting.

[b]-	Ultimate Hammer[/b]
	The time it takes for stop time effect to kick in has been increased from 0.4 sec. to 0.5 sec.

[h3]7.	Fallen Light[/h3]
[b]-	LMB + LMB + LMB Command[/b]
	This attack will now auto target

[b]-	Rapid Shot Command[/b]
	Adjusted the timing to make it easier to activate

[b]-	Evade Attack[/b]
	Aerial LMB & Aerial RMB will now activate attacks faster in order to make it easier to follow up with combos

[b]-	Aerial LMB + LMB + LMB + LMB[/b]
	When using the final smash attack, the attack will now register in the air as well
	The final smash attack will stun the enemy on the ground for 1.5 sec.
	You will be able to follow up easier with Aerial RMB + RMB + RMB

[b]-	Aerial RMB + RMB[/b]
	You can now follow up with Aerial LMB + LMB combo
	Your Aerial RMB + RMB + RMB will become faster with higher attack speed

[b]-	Lightning Shot[/b]
	Lightning Shot will no longer suck in allies 

[h3]8.	Ruler of Darkness[/h3]
[b]-	Evade Attack & Dark Mist[/b]
	Particle Effect has been added to invisible effect in order to enemies to know the general movement of Ruler of Darkness

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)


[h3]Balance[/h3]
[b]1.	Sword Taliah[/b]
-	Hit Stop Removed
	Left Click Command 1st & 2nd Hit
	Aerial Left Click Command 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Hit
	Spinning Slash Command
	Evade Attack

-	Storm Slash
	In order to stabilize the aerial juggle, the attack motion will no longer have delays in between
	Duration Decrease from 5.7 sec. to 4 sec.
	Evade Window before the Final Attack Increased (You can now Evade Cancel before the actual attack occurs)

-	Leap
	If you hit an enemy, you can cancel faster to continue with a dash attack or with basic combo
	If you miss an enemy, the previous delay will be there

-	Stun Hit
	Stun Duration Increased from 1.5 sec. to 2 sec.
	If you hit with your 1st hit and hit again with the 2nd hit and stuns, the enemy will no longer be able to evade and the stun effect will continue

-	Fragment Strike
	Stun Duration Increased from 1.5 sec. to 2 sec.
	After the attack, you will be able to move quicker allowing you to follow up with your combo.
	If you miss your attack, there will be a delay

-	Raging Strike
	If an enemy is hit by the 1st hit, they won't be able to Rage Break
	In order to stop the enemy from evading during the 2nd hit, delay between 1st and 2nd hit has been decreased
	If your attack misses, there will be a delay and you will not be able to activate the 2nd strike
	Fixed an issue with your character moving forward after Raging Strike

[b]2.	Blazing Fist[/b]

	Left Click Command 1st, 2nd, and 3rd hit
	Left & Right Combo 1st Hit

-	Falling Star

	Left Click Command 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Hit
