	Chain Swing
	Evade Attack

-	Holy Armor
	You can now select an area to use the skill

-	Right Click Command
	Endurance Decreased by 20%

-	Gigantic Swing
	Enemy's Launch Speed Decreased by 30%
	Enemy's Launch Distance Decreased by 50%
	Stun Duration Decreased from 1.5 sec. to 1 sec.
	If you hit an enemy, you can move cancel or evade cancel faster to follow up with a Dash Attack or skills
	If you do not hit an enemy, delay and time it takes to evade will be increased
	While an enemy is being launched, the caster won’t suffer from hit stop.

-	Holy Cross
	Range Decreased by 33%

-	Crusade
	Movement Speed Decreased by 33%
	Movement Speed and Distance when you hit an enemy has been decreased by 33%

-	Sanctuary
	Sanctuary now only heals gray section of HP

-	Faith
	Faith now only heals gray section of HP

-	Ultimate Hammer
	Duration Decreased from 10 sec. to 5 sec.
	Continuous Damage's Break Damage has been removed
	Continuous Damage's damage amount has been increased by 200% but the total damage remains the same

[b]4.	Ruler of Darkness[/b]
-	Rising Wings
	Movement Speed Decreased by 33%
	When used during an Aerial Combo, the enemy hit by the skill remain up in the air in order to follow up with a combo
	You can now use Rising Wings during Aerial Right Click Attack

-	Death Hold
	Range Decreased by 12%

-	Demon Rush
	Duration Decreased from 4 sec. to 2.8 sec.

2.	Fixed the bug with Diabolic Witch's Mana Ray damage being abnormally high.

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]1.	New Karma - Ruler of Darkness[/h3]
[b]Name:[/b] Ruler of Darkness
[b]Weapon:[/b] Soul Scythe
[b]Type:[/b] Close-Range, Breaker

Ruler of Darkness is an INT based breaker that uses a soul scythe.
A tiny ancient demon is sealed within the soul scythe.
When you successfully attack using command attacks, you will gain special resources. Use the special resources with the right-click combo in order summon a demon for special combo attacks.

[h3]2.	New Mode: Capture the Crystal (CTC)[/h3]
A new mode has been added in PvP [Duel] Mode.
Obtain crystals to gain points for the team. The objective of this mode is to collect and steal as many crystals as possible.
The crystals will appear periodically around the map.
The number of crystals you obtain will influence the points you obtain.
When you are knocked out, all the crystals you own will drop and the team will lose points based on the number of crystals you had at the time.
The opponent can take the crystals that are dropped, or your ally can collect them as well.

Once a team reaches the required point to win, a countdown will start until the team’s victory.
The opposing team can prevent the victory by defeating the winning team’s members and cause them to drop the crystals, which will stop the victory countdown.
There’s always a chance to turn the tide by stealing the opponent team’s crystals.

[b]How to Enter: [/b]Have a chance to appear when queueing for PvP Duel Mode. (D rank or higher)
[b]Match Type:[/b] 3 vs 3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/59849b6e2c858c57f9043420ede93a67fa09bcf1.png[/img]

[h3]3.	PvP Season 3[/h3]
Rating: There will be a soft reset based on your last season’s rating.
Rank: All E Ranks will reset to E1, and all other ranks will reset to D1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/21e628c313941399eec8b37a255ba51807e4ebf2.jpg[/img]

[b]Season 3 Rank Reward[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/e14f36050014de1f7097486d58f77cf6085a75c6.jpg[/img]

The rating decay amount when you do not play the game has been decreased.
-	Season 2 : Drop by 250 points when you don’t play for 2 or more days.
-	Season 3 : Drop by 100 points when you don’t play for 3 or more days.
Now, you will be matched with AIs when there are not enough players on queue for Duel Mode as an E Rank.

[h3]4.	Inventory Slot Increase[/h3]
Each inventory category (Weapon, Costume, Accessory, Special) will increase from 168 slots to 210. In addition, you can expand your slots to up to 280 by using KP. 

[h3]5.	Hot Key Added for Ping & Emote[/h3]
Now you can use hot keys for Ping & Emotion (F1~ F10) in addition to the existing keyboard and mouse controls. Furthermore, you can use key binding in order to set them to the key you want.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b73b30f6ea1a64959dba635c672524c1848c22ab.jpg[/img]

[h3]6.	Battle Feedback Improvement[/h3]
The interface for PvP Battle Feedback has improved so that it’s easier to see the score per mode. In addition, an alarm will sound when it approaches time out or end of the match.  

[Effect around the winning team's score]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/2d1d2c75d7c102154813387f95de6f4f58fd642b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/5ab8ee6bdbf7334a14d7647a0db7023f4dd72401.jpg[/img]

[Alarm when approaching match point (1 point left or 5% left for conquest)]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/aec4556645ef50870c6ba8cb25f3f03d1dc49f5f.jpg[/img]

[Show number of zones conquered when there are 2 or more zones in Conquest]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/b33b5a5916b028d9d7a1494e56cf8ae5e9518374.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]

1. Fixed the error with the old Season 2's reward was showing up in the Season 3 Challenge window.

2. Fixed the graphical glitch with the resource gauge when switching Karma.

notes.title: February 13th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]EDIT: Maintenance time has been extended by 1 more hour. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/h3]

Attention, Chasers!

Please check the weekly maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) February 13th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/123f1211f307918c880fb8fd0158ddd8bbeed18c.jpg[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[h3]New Mode: Survival[/h3]
Survival mode is a free for all PVP mode that can only be entered during a specific time and can have up to 10 players at once.
The goal of this mode is to become the last Chaser standing.

There will be 7 different Buff Crystals that appear constantly all around the map in order to help with your survival.
Each time you acquire a buff, you get powerful buffs and recover your health, this will work in your favor in order to survive.
From time to time, a [Special Buff] Crystal will appear and whoever acquires this Special Buff will recover health by finishing off an opponent. This buff will allow the Chaser to have a better chance to be the last Chaser standing!

As time goes by, the area will shrink, making the battle more chaotic as time goes by.

Max Participants: 10 Players (Minimum 8 Players)
Available Time: (First 20 min of Each Hour) XX:00 ~ XX:19 (20 min)
(When the available time passes, your matchmaking will be canceled. However, Chasers who are already in a match will continue on)

[b]<Buff Detail>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/0014523d95cd1962c953d525a218e5e2e6b5e7e3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ea34b4ad363949848b1e86cf3b4a0f4b4b0ebcdc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/ba000372076ff0bd6806de51392ab29c905dc959.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4dad541f2b18b129a2f2a13c66fa1227d071de90.png[/img]

[h3]Trading Post System[/h3]
A trading post system will be added to the game which will allow players to sell and purchase tradable items using CP. 
The trading post will be separated by server and cross server trade won't be possible. 

[h3]Resurrection System[/h3]
New resurrection method will be added to PVE other than manual resurrection from your teammates. Resurrection Stone will allow the user to resurrect instantly by themselves and it can be acquired from PVP or Supply Boxes.

[h3]Item Option Swap System[/h3]
'Item Option Swap Ticket' will allow the player to swap the item option from one item to another. You can swap the 2 options on an equipment to another identical equip slot item. 
-	Ex: 2 Item Option on Shoes < = > 2 Item Option on Another Shoes
Option Swap tickets can be created using the Synthesis System or receive them as a bonus by purchasing packages and the item swap tickets will be included with the same number of items inside the package. 

[h3]Multi-Dye System [/h3]
You can now dye more than 1 area on a costume. However, this is not supported for all costumes and will vary depending on which costume is supported. You can still dye with existing dye items and will also consume the same amount. 

[h3]New Synthesis Items [/h3]
You can synthesize new items using materials acquired from playing the game. 

[h3]New Synthesis Items[/h3]
•	[Eltheca] Item Option Swap Ticket
•	Intermediate Dye
•	Advanced Dye
•	[Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone (Karma)
•	[Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone (Weapon)
•	[Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone (Outfit)
•	[Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone (Accessory)

[h3]KP Shop Purchase Limit [/h3]
Improvements were made on items that shouldn't be purchased more than once. Once you purchase these items, you will no longer be able to purchase these items. 

[h3]CP Display Improvement [/h3]
CP will now have a 1,000 separator to improve readability. 
-	Ex: 000,000,000
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c580d3e70e3ca41214e6873900dea3d9dcf39d04.png[/img]

[h3]PVP Display Improvement[/h3]
The PVP Kill Log has been improved. 
It will be easier to differentiate between your teammate and opponents with Blue (Teammate) and Red (Opponent) outline around each player.
Also, the opponent's skill will be in red as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/6956ee09571ac88275afee906bf7c78b0174ce29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/97fedef9bcf8030b8111f67b397b846457c85bf0.png[/img]

[h3]Inventory Sort Button[/h3]
Auto Sort button has been added to the character inventory. You will now be able to organize your inventory easier than before by using the new sorting button. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/aed8ac640fa003ee890abc213d987c915d5f5b42.png[/img]

[h3]Character Preview Improvement (Zoom/Spin/Move)[/h3]
Character Preview in Character Window, Dye Window, and KP Shop will have its function improved to zoom/spin/move. You will now be able to view your character in more detail. 
-	Zoom: Mouse Wheel
-	Spin: Left Mouse Button
-	Move: Right Mouse Button
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/62338e505f58c97b4ed93da30a5649ae5a144fe2.png[/img]

[h3]Solo Practice Duel PVP added[/h3]
A new practice PVP where you can fight against an AI by yourself has been added.
If your Karma is Lv.1, you can acquire rewards. 

[h3]5 vs 5 Conquest[/h3]
In order to reduce the match duration, points required for victory has been reduced from 800 to 700.

[h3]PVP / PVE Reward Increase[/h3]
The amount of AP/CP/DP that can be acquired from PVP & PVE has been increased. 

[b]<Before>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/8fb0e0de02592e2a9dc38232318069c753ae78fa.jpg[/img]

[b]<After>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/928692997089068a25b32c8ae485c6fdc6ed2707.jpg[/img]

[h3]Karma Level Requirement for Annihilation Decreased[/h3]
You can now enter Annihilation PVE missions with Lv.1 Karma. 

[h3]Chaser Growth Support Attendance Event[/h3]
A new attendance event that supports Chasers will be added. You can acquire rewards such as Radiant Magic Stone, Character Appearance Change Ticket, Advanced Supply Box, Heroic Karma Token, and high option rank accessories.

[h3]Dual Soul & Sacred Guardian – Aerial Combo Improvement[/h3]
You can now use Karma Switch Attack during Dual Soul Aerial Hit 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Hit and Sacred Guardian Aerial 3rd Hit. 

[h3]Dance of Wind - Great Spirit's Ascent Improvement[/h3]
To assist with aiming the Great Spirit's Ascent, dynamic camera has been removed. You can now cancel during the Aiming Stance by using Right-Click and crosshair has been added to assist with aiming the Great Spirit's Ascent. Lastly, in order to properly reflect your intended aim, the Great Spirit's Ascent will be placed lower than previous.

[h3]Blazing Fist – Improvement[/h3]
Multi-Jab has been improved to hit enemies in a different direction. Fixed the graphical glitch with Whirlwind sometimes displaying the walking animation.

[h3]Gameplay Optimization[/h3]
We have optimized the following sections in order to help out with low performance PCs.
•	Karma Switching
•	Using Skills
•	Attacking & Being Attacked
We will continue to optimize the game in the future.

[h3]Extraction Function Halt[/h3]
In order to revamp the current extraction function, this function will be on halt until further notice.

[h3]Decay PVP Rating from S3 - G3 Rank Players Recovered[/h3]
For players who experienced PVP rating decay on Feb 7th 2020 will have their lost rating recovered after this maintenance.

[h3]KP Shop Item Option Stats[/h3]
After the maintenance, whenever you purchase Weapon, Costume, or Accessories from the KP shop, they will come with either Purple or Yellow stats at random.
This option will be applied whenever you move your item from the KP Shop Inventory to your Character Inventory.
However, when you receive a Weapon Select cube from certain packages, each weapon will come with 2 [Eltheca] Radiant Magic Stone (Weapon).

[h3]DP Acquisition Count Improvement[/h3]
When your DP is full, you will no longer use DP acquisition count. DP Acquisition count will only decrease when you actually receive DP.

[h3]Magic Stone & Radiant Magic Stone Selling Price Fix[/h3]
CP selling price for Magic Stone & Radiant Magic Stone has been fixed.

All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: January 15th 2020 Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]EDIT3: The servers are now open, we thank you for your patience[/h1]

Attention, Chasers!

Please check this week’s maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) January 15th,2020 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/24846112ce1a3bd233f52e72af1f365bc2fb174c.jpg[/img]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

Due to the amount of changes being implemented in to the game, our maintenance will start earlier than usual and last for 5 hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/fabc7eaaa77c890ba574905c8c28c529ee16d3a2.png[/img]

[b]1.	New Karma (Fallen Light) [/b]
Name: Fallen Light
Weapon: Elemental Buster
Type: Long-Range Magic Slayer
Unlike previous long-range Karmas, Fallen Light's basic attacks does not have auto aim assistance. Whether or not your basic attack lands on your opponent will solely depend on your aim. 
Fallen Light also utilizes a new resource called "Magic Bullet" and this resource can be used to enhance your skills or deliver a stronger attack.

[b]2.	New 5 vs 5 PVP[/b]
New 5 vs 5 Maps will be added to enjoy PVP with more Chasers at once. 
In order to accommodate the large-scale battle, the 5 vs 5 maps will be bigger and Conquest Mode map will have 2 Capture Points. There will be a total of 2 Deathmatch and 1 Conquest Maps for 5 vs 5.

[b]3.	PVP Season 2 [/b]
In order to make PVP more enjoyable with Season 2, we've made some changes. 

- Matchmaking
We wanted to test various skills of Chasers and reflect that on their PVP rank. Not just their ability to defeat enemies but also strategies and teamwork. To implement this change, Chasers will now be matched to a random mode. However, once Chasers are matched to a mode, they will have the option to change their Karma & skills before the match starts.

- Rewards
In Season 1, many Chasers decided not to play after reaching a certain rank in fear of ranking down at the end of the Season. In order to encourage players to continue and climb their ranks, we are rewarding the Season end reward based on the highest reached by the Chaser during the Season. Also, to commemorate the higher ranked achieved by Chasers, we are improving the visuals of the Symbol of A, S and G Rank.

- PVP Mission
Duel Mission is a 3 vs 3 or 5 vs 5 PVP mission that doesn't have any rank downs and can be used to safely reach A3 rank. Challenge Mission is the classic 2 vs 2 PVP mission that allows Chasers to rank up past A3 and this mode will have rank downs. 

- Rank & Rating 
Increasing your Rank is fun but at the same time, it could be stressful due to ranking down and losing. In order to relieve some of that stress and have many people enjoy ranking up, we are going to change some things. First, we will make ranks up to A3 achievable by anyone as long as they keep playing. Also, we are reducing the number of stages required per rank to rank up from 5 to 3 in order to make the Promo match occur much faster.

[b]4.	Season Pass System[/b]
We are now adding a Season Pass system on top of the existing Season Challenge system. When the Season Pass is activated, players will acquire additional rewards for increasing their Season Levels. The Season Pass will provide rewards that are worth much more than the price of activating the Season Pass.

[b]5.	CP Shop[/b]
A new CP Shop run by Crim inside Eltheca will be added. Chasers will be able to purchase various items using the CP shop. 

[b]6.	KP Shop[/b]
New In-Game KP Shop has been added. KP is a premium currency that can be acquired by using the Steam Wallet and players will be able to purchase the previous DLC products using the in-game UI with ease. 
Chasers will also be able to try out the items before purchasing inside the KP shop.

[b]7.	New Growth System[/b]
Max level of Karmas will be increased and Karmas will now level up in a different way. Each time you level up your Karma, skills locked behind a certain Karma level will be unlocked. Once the skills are unlocked, players will be able to learn those skills using set currencies. Once a Karma reaches a set level, players will be able to apply additional stats to it.

[b]8.	Mail System[/b]
Rewards from various content and events will be now be distributed through the in-game mail system. Players will now be able to check their mailbox inside Eltheca. Mail inside the mailbox will stay inside until a set expiration date is reached and once claimed, the item will be moved to the Chaser's inventory. 

[b]9.	Gender Specific Items[/b]
In order to create various item designs, we are separating the Genders of Items to Male & Female. Already existing items in the game will not be affected. 

[b]10.	Karma Acquisition Method Change[/b]
Karmas that were available to acquire through DLC will now be changed so that players can acquire it with 100 CP. 
From this point on, everyone will be able to acquire all Karmas with ease. 

[b]11.	Inventory Revamp[/b]
From our previous system of using the Equipment Window and Steam Inventory, we are fully converting the Inventory to in-game UI. Chasers will now be able to check and equip items inside the new Inventory and also sell it for CP. 

[b]12.	Extraction System Revamp [/b]
Items acquired from Extraction will be changed. All previously acquired from Extraction will be changed to new items.

New Extraction Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/941406b90f627fefae8b71a90321635c1b3ce373.jpg[/img]

[b]13.	Synthesis Revamp[/b]
Dyes, PVE Accessories and Supply Box contents will be removed from Synthesis. Instead, items that can be synthesized with Probatio Marks will be added. Previously acquired Synthesis items will be exchanged to new items.

Exchanged Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1cccef46de4da4b5ad68291b48b079b47b8f3bd0.jpg[/img]

[b]14.	Categories for Accessory and Outfit Change[/b]
Outfit Category: Top, Bottom, Right Hand, Left Hand, Shoes and Undergarment
Accessory Category: Hair Top, Hair Bottom, Face, Top, Face Bottom, Neck, Back and Belt

[b]15.	Item Option Change System[/b]
Sub Stats from existing Accessories will be removed. Instead, players will be able to change the stat options of Karma, Weapon, Outfit, and Accessories by using Magic Stones or Radiant Magic Stones. Chasers will now be able to customize their characters even more with more option stats to add to different items. 
Existing Weapon and Outfit will have their stats changed to the highest upgrade and Sub Stats from Accessories will be changed to the highest possible option stat for the new system. Lastly, weapon's karma and sub karma slots will be unlocked to full. 

[b]16.	Basic Stat Change & Removal[/b]
Previously, it was difficult to pinpoint bugs and balance based on Stat changes. In order to remedy this, we are removing the basic stat change system. Basic Stat change system that was available through Rebirth & Tome of Knowledge will be removed and every Chaser will now be fixed to 5/5/5/5/5 stats.

[b]17.	Affinity System Removed[/b]
Previous Affinity system where it allowed Chasers to track and raise affinity with an NPC for rewards has been removed. Players who were still trying to acquire the reward for certain NPC affinity will be given all rewards for it as long as they have the corresponding Karma already unlocked. However, this does not apply to Crim & Ensher.

[b]18.	PVE Revamp[/b]
PVE will be separated in to 3 different modes.
Difficulty setting per mission will be removed and each new mode will have a Karma Lv. restriction. Also, new modes will only allow manual resurrection.

-Patrol: You and 2 other allies will fight a random humanoid monster
-Annihilation: You and 3 other allies will fight multiple random monsters
-Raid: You and 5 other allies will fight a designated boss monster.

[b]19.	Eltheca Visual Revamp[/b]
Eltheca has gone through some changes and acquired a new look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/742a470ce0ab1ff68bb714e11e49d6d846b6970b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/90627ed6a6d63332eed86ab1e6727654cd5ffe83.png[/img]

All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: Dev Note: KurtzPel Massive Update & Revamp
notes.content:
Hello Chasers, this is the KurtzPel Team.

The year 2020 is finally upon us and KurtzPel will go through massive changes and have new content. Please check below for the info.

[h3]New Content[/h3]

[b]New Karma - Fallen Light[/b]
This new Karma is a magic cannon named "Elemental Buster" and takes on the role of a long-range magic slayer. Unlike other long-range Karmas, this Karma does not gain any auto-targeting assistance and all shot projectiles will follow the player's aim.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/727bc5e8e7ab52b3e4dc8785252d40a021df5c92.jpg[/img]

[b]PVP Season 2[/b]
In order to judge the Chaser's ability on many different aspects of PVP, Chasers will no longer be able to select certain modes when matchmaking.
However, once you are matched with your opponents, there will be a new system where you will be able to change your weapon and skills before the match starts.

The reward system for PVP Season 2 will also change. Before, players were afraid of their ranks decreasing during the season and stopped to do Official Probatio after reaching a certain rank. From Season 2, players will be rewarded based on the highest ranking achieved during the season, so you no longer have to be afraid of ranking down and continue to try your best to achieve the highest rank.

Lastly, the emblem shown beside the players' name for ranks A, S, and G will be different to highlight the high ranks the players achieved.

[b]PVP Missions[/b]
PVP Missions will no longer be separated by Practice and Official Probatio. Instead, they will now be separated to Duel Mission and Challenge Missions.
Duel Missions will match players with 3 ~ 5 vs PVP and there will be no rank decreases upon losing a match. However, because of that, players will only be able to reach up to Rank A in this mode. There will also be new and bigger maps to accommodate the 5 vs 5. 
2 New Deathmatch Maps and 1 new Conquest Maps will be added.

Challenge Missions will be the classic 2 vs 2 format and you can rank up and rank down just like before. In order for players to reach ranks higher than A, they must play on this mode.

[h3]New System & Existing System Update[/h3]

[b]Acquiring Karma[/b]
New and existing Chasers will now be able to acquire Dual Soul and Sacred Guardian Karma with reduced CP cost.

For players who already purchased the Dual Soul and Sacred Guardian Karma, after the update, you will receive your current Karma's Level + 1.

[b]New Karma Growth System[/b]
The max growth of Karma will be increased from 3 to 5. You will also learn new skills through the new Karma UI instead of from certain Karma NPCs. Chasers will be able to learn new skills and abilities by leveling up their Karma.
For players who already have all the skills unlocked, they will have their skill items removed and have all those removed skills applied to the new Karma Growth System.

[b]Character Inventory[/b]
A new inventory function and UI will be added. Players will now be able to check all their items in a convenient UI.

[b]Mailbox System[/b]
A new mailbox system will be added. This system will be mainly used for sending out Event rewards or compensations for certain inconveniences.

[b]PVP Ranks and Rating[/b]
As fun as it is to rank up to a higher rank, we found that many players felt frustrated whenever they lost. In order to assist with this, we will be decreasing the amount of points upon losing a match and also decreased the number of stages required to rank up to 3 instead of 5.

[b]Season Pass[/b]
We have added a Season Pass to the existing Season Level system.
When your Battle Pass is activated, you will receive additional rewards while also receiving the rewards for Season Level. The Season Pass will provide greater rewards than the purchase price such as Season Pass Exclusive Costumes and Weapons.

[b]New Currency - DP[/b]
A new currency called DP will be added. This currency can be received by clearing missions.

[b]CP Shop[/b]
A new shop that uses CP as currency will be added. Chasers will be able to purchase a variety of items using their CP from this shop.

[b]In-Game Cash Shop (KP Shop)[/b]
A new in-game cash shop will be added that uses a new Cash currency called KP will be added. This new shop will provide players with easy to use UI and also provide the option to try on certain items before purchase.

[b]PVE Mode[/b]
All PVE missions will now be unified to 1 difficulty but will change difficulty depending on the mode being played.

PVE will be separated in to 2 categories: Group Mission and Daily Mission
Group Mission will focus on fighting random enemies with 3 to 4 party members and the Daily Dungeons will have a designated enemy you fight with 6 player teams on each day.

[b]Item Modification[/b]
The item modification system will be removed. All weapon, costume and accessories will now have their Sub Stats removed due to this change and a new 'Ability Slot' will be added.

All Weapon and Costume will now have their stats to the max upgrade performance amount.
Weapons will now have all slots such as Karma Crystal and Sub Karma Crystal unlocked.

For items that already has its sub stats allocated, it will be changed to the highest stat in the new system.
Karma, Weapon and Outfits will also have the new stats applied to it after the update.

[h3]New Items[/h3]

[b]Magic Stone[/b]
A new item called Magic Stone will be added. This item will allow players to apply stats to Weapon and Costumes.

[b]Settia Costume[/b]
Settia Costume will now be released for top and bottom pieces.

[b]Gender Costumes[/b]
From now on, all costumes released for KurtzPel will be released for a set gender. All existing costumes can be worn regardless of gender.

[b]Character Name Change Ticket[/b]
A new item that will allow players to change their character's name will be added.

[b]Character Appearance Change Ticket[/b]
A new item that only changes your character's appearance will be added. This ticket cannot change the character's gender.

[b]Basic Motion Change Item[/b]
LUA selection step will be removed from Character Creation and all characters will now have default motion set to the "JUDGE" LUA. Also, after the update, everyone will receive a cube item that will allow you to pick 1 basic motion of your choice.
This basic motion items will change your character's idle pose, idle motion, and also jump animation.

[b]Extraction[/b]
You will now acquire different items from extracting your items. All existing Essence items will be removed and automatically exchanged to the new items.

[b]New Extraction Items[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/941406b90f627fefae8b71a90321635c1b3ce373.jpg[/img]

[b]Exchanged Items[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1cccef46de4da4b5ad68291b48b079b47b8f3bd0.jpg[/img]

[b]Synthesis[/b]
More synthesis options using the PVP "Probatio Mark" material will be added.
Monster Accessory, Dye, and Settia Accessories will be removed from Synthesis.
Items such as Lost Piece and Energy will be exchanged to CP.

[b]Emote Items[/b]
All emotes will now bind to a specific character upon use. (Cannot be reversed)
All free emotes will automatically be bound to your characters and certain emotes acquired from Events, Purchase and etc. will need to be consumed and bound to a character before it can be used.

[h3]Removed System[/h3]

[b]Steam Inventory[/b]
Steam inventory will be no longer used. However, players will still be able to withdraw the remaining items inside their Steam Inventory.

[b]Basic Stat Redistribution[/b]
In order to aid with balance, we will be removing the Basic Stat Redistribution function from the game. All Chasers will now be fixed to the 5/5/5/5/5 stats.

[b]NPC Affinity System[/b]
The NPC tracking Affinity system will be removed. All affinity rewards will be sent to Chasers whoever unlocked the Karmas during the January 15th Maintenance. However, common affinity NPC items such as Ensher and Crim will not be given.

[b]Supply Box[/b]
All existing Supply Box items will no longer be sold in the game. You can still use the remaining Supply Boxes.

[b]Rebirth Ticket[/b]
The rebirth ticket will no longer be sold and basic stat redistribution function from rebirth will be removed. Chasers will still be able to use the remaining Rebirth Ticket.

[b][i]All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.[/i][/b]

notes.title: November 13th Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

Please check this week’s maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) November 13th,2019 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/07c0fd4d5330c8673404d27b8e54b0582ee849a8.png[/img]
(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[b]Additional Content and System Update[/b]
1. You can now adjust cursor speed when using controllers.
2. You will be blocked from mission matches if you cancel 3 PVP missions within 10 minutes time frame as opposed to canceling any PvP / PvE missions. As such, if players are matched to a difficulty level they don’t want, they can cancel the match, and will not be penalized. 
However, penalty for canceling PvP missions will also affect PvE missions.
3. PvP / PvE Frame drop has been improved. However, key-guide will no longer show on multiplayer missions. 
4. 3 vs 3 Official Probatio has been added.
- In order to find out your favorite gameplay mode, we are going to use the Pre-Season period to test out different options. 3 vs 3 Official Probatio will be one of them. We believe providing the option of 3 vs 3 Official Probatio will be a new fun way to experience KurtzPel.
- Just like the 2 vs 2 Official Probatio, 3 vs 3 Official Probatio will have the option to choose the map of your choice to queue up.
- 3 vs 3 Practice Probatio will continue to stay despite the addition of 3 vs 3 Official Probatio.
5. Additional 20,000 CP will be given to players that reached Rank A - G in Season 1.
- We wanted to give everyone a special gift for acquiring the A - G rank but we realized that many of you felt like your efforts weren't compensated enough with just the Elaum Ores. This is why we decided to give out the additional 20,000 CP to players that reached Rank A - G in Season 1.

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
1. Fixed visual bug of other player’s costumes looking stretched.
2. Fixed shadow option not applying when selecting simplified appearance option.
3. Fixed not being able to use emotes when interacting with Mission Maps or NPCs.
4. Fixed being able to use skills immediately without being exhausted in certain situations.
5. Fixed error of increasing rank through re-match.
6. Fixed sound randomly becoming louder when attacked.
7. Fixed not being able to cast Diabolic Witch's Ice Wall in a desired direction.
8. Fixed an error where skills won't be activated at random moments.

All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: November 6th Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]The Maintenance completed earlier than expected and KurtzPel is now available to play.[/h1]

Attention, Chasers!

Please check this week’s maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) November 6th,2019 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c8f430897a231204371cd588fdc878dd851e9e51.png[/img]
(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[b][h1]Additional Content and System Update[/h1][/b]
1. Probation Season 1 has come to an end. Probatio Pre-Season 2 will start.
- Probatio Pre-Season is a season in-between official PvP seasons.
- There will be a [b]soft rank reset[/b] with the start of Pre-Season. 
- If there are any challenges you haven’t completed, you can continue to clear the challenges during Pre-Season to receive the rewards.
- Probatio Season 1 PvP Rank Rewards will be distributed with the Maintenance. You must login during the Pre-Season to receive Season 1 rewards. [b](You will not be able to receive any rewards once Season 2 starts)[/b]
- Pre-Season rank will not apply in Probatio Season 2. All ranks will be reset before Season 2 starts. 

[b][Soft Reset][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/f6f814aacb89f28a90383b4669047ac3cb155101.png[/img]

[b][Pre-Season Rank CP Rewards][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/441c849ac96c87e7a0318bb913fb614b2d572640.png[/img]

2. The early-game progress has been adjusted to allow faster game-play.
- When you create new characters, you can use pre-made characters to start the game quicker.
- You will start the game with both Great Sword and Longbow Karma.
- Tutorial will now be in a 1vs1 PvP format.
- After the tutorial, check the Mission Map to complete 3 new Chaser Missions about PvP/Dungeons.
- After completing the new Chaser Missions, you can go on 6 PvP missions and 18 PvE missions.

3. The Mission Matching by Mode/Map that was used during the PvP Burning Event will continue.
- Mission map will be divided to Battle Tab and Monster Tab, and you will not be able to request for them simultaneously.
- You can obtain Energy of Chaos and Lost Piece Pouch through 6 Battle Missions.
- 3vs3 Practice Probatio will be added, but you will not be able to choose Mode/Map. The Practice Probatio games will not drop Energy of Chaos nor the Lost Piece Pouch.

4. Convenience Update has been added.
- Key binding for Jump/Interaction has been added.  
- Mouse Cursor has changed.
- You can open the Mission Map anywhere with the Hot Key(M). The players that were using ‘M’ for custom keys have their custom key reset to default.
- All mission maps other than the main mission map beside Ensher will be removed from Eltheca.
- You can close all reward windows without having to confirm one by one. 
- You can cancel all missions from Mission Maps.
- Eltheca max capacity increased.
- A new feature ‘Simplify Appearance of Other Players’ will be added. When this option is turned on, while you are in Eltheca, everyone but yourself and your party members will have the same simplified clothing.
- Rematch Hot Key for your Mission will be changed. (Right Click  R Key)


[b][h1]Common, Karma, Mode Balance[/h1][/b]
[b][Common][/b]
1. Rage Evade will be activated after a certain duration when getting attacked. This will prevent players accidentally using Rage Evade, because they were attacked when pressing the Q key because they were preparing to use a rage skill.

[b][Dance of Wind][/b]
1. Siege Mode
- Knockback is removed. 
- Flinch duration of attacked target will be decreased by half. 
2. RMB Hold Shot
- Knockback is removed. 
- Flinch duration of attacked target will be decreased by half.

[b][Diabolic Witch][/b]
1. RMB Hold Attacks
- Stamina Cost will be decreased by 33%.
[Sacred Guardian]
1. Crusade
- When you use in the air, you will not drop. Instead, the skill will activate at jump location.
- You can use Crusade in the middle of an air combo.
2. Gigantic Swing
- Attack hit box has been improved. 

[b][h1]Event[/h1][/b]
1. Halloween Event will end, and Eltheca will return to its previous state.
2. Halloween Candy and Cookie that you own will be deleted. 

[b][h1]Shop Update[/h1][/b]
1. New Premium Items added on November 6th will be notified with a separate announcement.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/844870/partnerevents/view/1619534614716296681

[b][h1]Bug Fix[/h1][/b]
1. Fixed an error with Gauntlet of Hellisia not showing its proper appearance.
2. Fixed an error with Golem Necklace showing the effect at a wrong location.
3. Fixed an error with Blazing Fist’s Whirlwind skill grappling the monsters regardless of their status.
4. Fixed an error when the Flag Capture area effect won’t show at a certain location.
5. Fixed an error with Apostle of Greed Halo having Stamina Recovery as the item stats. (Items with the Stamina Recovery option will be changed to Rage Recovery.)
6. Fixed an error of Screenshot Mode not disengaging when R key is pressed to enter the main menu.
7. Fixed an error with Great Sword of Frost Giant showing at a weird location when using Dash Jump.
8. Fixed an error with Diabolic Witch’s Evade would remove the aggro on a monster.
9. Fixed an error with Mission Clear date showing on a mission that was never cleared at certain situations.
10. Fixed an error with Sacred Guardian – Ruminate & Dance of Wind – Concentration having its effect even when a targeting skill is canceled.
11. Fixed an error with Blazing Fist’s Instant Chase shooting 2 Spheres sometimes in the air.

All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

[b][h1]Additional Content and System Update[/h1][/b]
1. If you cancel your matchmaking 3 times within 10 minutes, you won't be able to match for 10 minutes.

Affected Commands
- Great Sword Spinning Attack
- Staff Muti-Fireball, Aerial Multi-Fireball
- Bow Ground & Air Multi-Shot
- Gauntlet Multi Jab
- Giant Hammer Chain Swing

2. While equipping Diabolic Witch and Sacred Guardian, Magic Endurance will apply even when you’re not attacking. Moving and standing motion endurance will increase.

3. Character who used the Rage Break will be invincible for a short duration after using Rage Break.
After Rage Break, character who used the Rage Break will be invincible for a short duration, allowing to dodge more safely.

4. RMB Hold Lightning Break damage is removed, and flinch duration is slightly decreased. 

[b][Sacred Guardian][/b]
1. Crusade skill can now be used midair.

notes.content:
[h1]In order to investigate abnormal dungeon clear issues, we will temporarily be putting a 20 min cooldown for all 2 & 4 Player PVE missions. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.[/h1]

(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[b]Additional Content and System Update[/b]
1. Eltheca will be decorated in Halloween theme! 
- Halloween has arrived even in the world of KurtzPel! Look around to see how Eltheca is decorated in the new Halloween theme! 
- Keep your eyes open for our Halloween event next week!

[b]Common, Karma, Mode Balance
[Common][/b]
1. Max stun duration for all stun skills have decreased. (2.5 sec. > 1.5 sec.)
- Full charge command combos will no longer be possible even with Debuff Duration Increase Sub Karma Crystals equipped.
- Great Sword: Stun Hit, Fragment Strike
- Staff: Lightning
- Gauntlet: Ultimate Heat
- Dual Sword: Spinning Strike
- Giant Hammer: Hammer Smash, Gigantic Swing 

[strike]2. Rage Break cannot be used against Rage Skills.
- This is to make multi hit rage skills as appealing as one-hit rage skills.[/strike]
> this would be postponed on 10/23

[b][Dance of Wind][/b]
1. Required time to reach max charge for Siege Mode increased.
- Charging for a short duration will receive little to no damage increase effect from charging.

[b][Diabolic Witch][/b]
1. When stamina reaches 0 or lower during right-click charge, there will be no additional hits. 
2. RMB Charge Attack's Break Damage decreased.
3. Black Hole Duration Decreased.

[b][Blazing Fist][/b]
1. The issue of changing direction after activating Ultimate Heat to also hit the opponent on the other side has been fixed.
2. Ultimate Heat hit box duration has decreased by 50%.
3. Ultimate Heat hit box size has decreased by 20%.

notes.title: October 10th Balance Revamp Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/JU-tpUyswvg
Attention, Chasers!

KurtzPel's Biggest Balance Revamp Ever! Check it out!


[b]Common, Karma, Mode Balance[/b]

[b][Common][/b]
[olist]
[*]Rage Break system will be added.
You can use while in Rage. You can escape from attacks by using all your rage gauge.
[*]Anti-Chase system will be added.
If you are hit through Chase 3 times or more within a certain duration, you will be dropped immediately in invincible state.
It will count chase attacks that happen in a short span (one attack) as 1 Chase attack.
[*]Fixed hit box remaining sometimes after a loop state. (Blazing Fist’s LMB→ LMB→LMB→. →LMB~ etc.).
[*]INT will affect max Mana less.
In relation, at All Stat=5 basic Mana for Sword Taliah/Dance of Wind/Blazing Fist/Dual Soul will increase while basic Mana for Diabolic Witch will decrease 
Detailed stats are as follows:

[b]Balanced Stat Example (All Stat = 5)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/c870dc05d23b349b48536bee1c6587fcdd494f4e.png[/img]
[b]Changed Stat Example[/b] (Sword Taliah/ Dance of Wind/Blazing Fist/ Dual Soul = STR & AGI 6/ INT 3, Diabolic Witch / Sacred Guardian= STR & AGI 4/ INT & WIS 6)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/d16460454d74656913549f1e000fb9effc1ceeee.png[/img]
[/olist]

[b][Sword Taliah][/b][olist]
[*]Overall, weapon range (not length, but width) has been slightly increased for a more stable combo.
[*]Spin Attack (LMB→LMB→. →LMB~) is now easier to use (Start timing adjusted) and the enemy will be launched in the air at first hit.
During a loop, target hit will be stunned longer for a more stable combo.
Attack distance has been decreased to fit FX.
[*]During RMB~, the time required to increase to max endurance has been decreased to 2/3.
[*]You can continue the combo longer, as you can execute the basic 2 hit combo faster after Evade LMB preventing your target from Evading.
[*]Storm Slash
- Attack Range is decreased. (-10%)
[*]Fragment Strike
- No longer knockdown your target. Will stun for 1.5 sec. instead.
- Casting speed (duration from start to first hit) is decreased.
[*]Stun Hit
- Endurance state is increased (+25%) and Endurance Break (+60%).
- Stun duration is increased to 2.4 sec. at Max level.
[*]Land Demolisher
- Less likely to accidently activate additional attack after first hit due to button mashing.
[*]Fortitude
- At Level 3, Damage and Endurance Break will decrease. (-50%, Like basic 1 hit combo)
[/olist]

[b][Dance of Wind][/b][olist]
[*]Bow flinch duration during RMB+LMB~ is decreased. (-50%)
[*]Now Evade→LMB will not knockdown enemy. Instead, it will slightly launch them in the air so you can continue the combo.
[*]Siege Mode
- Preparation stance will hit nearby opponent and launch them in the air. As such, preparation stance will now have Mana cost and cooldown.
- Auto target range is increased to make it easier to use in a combo.
- Charging duration decreased to allow bigger damage in the same amount of time.
- Push back the target further upon hit, and projectile size and flinch increase.
- You can Evade cancel quicker after firing.
- You can transition to standby motion quicker after last hit.
[*]Salvo Arrows
- Max arrows number increased. (3 → 5)
- You can transition to standby motion quicker after last hit.
[*]Raining Arrows
- Max duration increased, as such, total damage is also increased.
- Damage will increase up to stage 3 depending on the duration. The higher the level, the faster you reach stage 3 damage.
- The combo is less stable, as the target flinch duration is decreased.
[/olist]

[b][Diabolic Witch][/b]
[olist]
[*]Now all commands will be considered ‘Spells’
As such, ‘INT’ and Accessories ‘casting speed’ effects will also affect commands.
This also applies to the new Karma, ‘Sacred Guardian’.
[*]Casting speed for Multi-Fireball combo in Midair + LMB→,→LMB~ is decreased. (this is connected to change #1 at standard stat = ALL 5, it will be the same as before.)
[*]After midair combo, you can no longer use Meditation in the air when your ‘stamina<0’.
[*]RMB+LMB~ fire ball size is increased.
[*]Delay from ready stance to fire is decreased for Special Attack (RMB+LMB~Dash).
[*]After RMB+LMB Hold Command Attacks, if you still hold RMB+LMB~, you can transition back to ready stance to use the Hold commands consecutively.
[*]Among RMB+LMB Hold Command Attacks, lightning (RMB+LMB~Dash) will have a slow homing function for a short duration.
[*]Among RMB+LMB Hold Command Attacks, Flame Wheel (back dash) damage is decreased. (-15%)
When it disappears after max hit, it will explode. Total damage is the same when you include the explosion damage.
[*]Lightning
- Stun duration is adjusted. (1,2 hits =1 sec., 3 hits=2 sec.)
- Interval between 2nd and 3rd attack is longer.
[*]Black Hole
- After casting, even when the castor cancels the spell with Evade, you can hold the target for the duration of the skill. (It doesn’t explode, but it will hold the target in place.)
- Castor can Evade cancel quicker after explosion.
- The higher the level, the longer the target is held by the black hole, but the casting speed will remain the same. (It will not become faster based on ‘INT’ or ‘casting speed’)
These changes have been made to focus and enhance on Black Hole’s crowd control function.
[*]Mana Ray
- You can now change the up and down direction of the Mana Ray as well.
- You can enhance the ray effect to 3 even as a level 1,2 skill.
There will be a difference in the amount of time it requires to reach to Stage 3 effect.
- Mana cost increased.
[*]Demonic Awakening
- Now Endurance Break increased for all attacks upon cast. (2.5 times)
- Skill Cooldown decrease effect increased. (Level 1 =2 times, Level 2=3 times, Level 3=4 times)
- Casting Speed decrease effect will increase for skills with a casting bar. (Level 1=2 times, Level 2=2.5 times, Level 3=3 times)
[/olist]

[b][Blazing Fist][/b][olist]
[*]During RMB~, the time required to increase to max endurance has been decreased to 2/3.
[*]It is now less likely for the attack to hit random directions as the target range after Evade has increased.
[*]You can no longer jump in certain areas while in RMB~ state.
[*]Whirlwind
- You can no longer Evade.
- Max whirlwind duration decreased. (-1.5 sec)
- Whirlwind attack range increased.
- While it’s still short, the duration from cast to hit has slightly increased.
- Fixed error where grab doesn’t work upon hit at max range.
[*]Reckless Charge
- Duration decreased.
- When charging towards the target, max strike range decreased.
- Fixed some of the cause of the error where the skill transitions to special state even upon hit instead of changing to grab.
[*]Wild Flurry
- Low Kick that knockdown target, now has increased range.
[*]Ultimate Heat
- It was redesigned to become an instant cast skill, instead of being a charging skill.
- Endurance and Endurance Break increased.
- It is now a 1 hit skill and will stun upon breaking Endurance.
- Stun duration is 2.5 sec. at max level.
[*]Instant Chase
- Projectile range decreased. (-7%)
- Projectile speed increased. (+7%)
[*]Devoted Awakening
- Moving Speed and Endurance increased. (+50%)
- While in Devoted Awakening state, activate chain lift attack immediately by entering dash, right after ‘Evade Attack’, ‘Grab Fail’ ‘Last attack of Basic Combo’ and ‘Basic Multi-Hit combo’. 
[/olist]

[b][Dual Soul][/b]
[olist]
[*]Improved situation where evade attack doesn’t work when pressing directional key with LMB, by increasing the transition time to moving immediately after Evade.
[*]The height in which the target is launched with Evade attack is slightly increased. Afterwards, you can transition to a basic 2 hit combo faster.
[*]Evade Moon Slash damage has overall decreased. (-50%)
[*]Pre-input timing is improved and starting timing is decreased to using Moon Slash more smoothly with Dash after successful attack with Flash Cut with 1 Charging or more.
[*]During RMB~, the time required to increase to max endurance has been decreased to 2/3.
[*]No charge Flash Cut damage decreased. (-50%)
[*]Midair attack stamina cost increased. (It will be at a similar rate to Dance of Wind)
[*]Fixed where Moon Slash will occasionally fly abnormally high. The motion stopping after a certain duration when using Moon Slash from a high location has been fixed.
[*]Height and distance of the target launched by the dash attack is decreased. Due to this, the interval in which you can input the Chase attack has also decreased.
[*]Spinning Strike
- Hit range decreased.
- Stun duration increased. (Level 2=2 sec., Level 3=2.4 sec.)
[*]Critical Slash
- Hit range decreased.
- 2nd moving hit will no longer launch or knockdown.
[*]Destiny’s Restraints
- Combo is now more stable as the initial hit will not always continue to the later attacks, or when the later attacks hit, it will hit until the end of the skill. 
[/olist]

[b][Sacred Guardian][/b]
Thank you everyone for your valuable feedback for our October 5th 3rd Eltheca Proving Ground.
Your feedback will be implemented for the October 10th Update.
Just to discuss a few, we will be removing the stun function from the basic combo and tweaking the damage and hit box of Command and Skills, as well as decreasing the heal amount.

Find out more on the Sacred Guardian Karma on the Live Server on October 10th 2019!


All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

Stun duration is 2.5 sec. at max level.

Instant Chase
- Projectile range decreased. (-7%)
Projectile speed increased. (+7%)

Devoted Awakening
- Moving Speed and Endurance increased. (+50%)
While in Devoted Awakening state, activate chain lift attack immediately by entering dash, right after ‘Evade Attack’, ‘Grab Fail’ ‘Last attack of Basic Combo’ and ‘Basic Multi-Hit combo’.
Improved situation where evade attack doesn’t work when pressing directional key with LMB, by increasing the transition time to moving immediately after Evade.
The height in which the target is launched with Evade attack is slightly increased. Afterwards, you can transition to a basic 2 hit combo faster.
Evade Moon Slash damage has overall decreased. (-50%)
Pre-input timing is improved and starting timing is decreased to using Moon Slash more smoothly with Dash after successful attack with Flash Cut with 1 Charging or more.
During RMB~, the time required to increase to max endurance has been decreased to 2/3.
No charge Flash Cut damage decreased. (-50%)
Midair attack stamina cost increased. (It will be at a similar rate to Dance of Wind)

tags.bug: Fixed where Moon Slash will occasionally fly abnormally high. The motion stopping after a certain duration when using Moon Slash from a high location has been fixed.

tags.balance_change: Height and distance of the target launched by the dash attack is decreased. Due to this, the interval in which you can input the Chase attack has also decreased.

Spinning Strike
- Hit range decreased.
Stun duration increased. (Level 2=2 sec., Level 3=2.4 sec.)

Critical Slash
- Hit range decreased.
2nd moving hit will no longer launch or knockdown.

Destiny’s Restraints
- Combo is now more stable as the initial hit will not always continue to the later attacks, or when the later attacks hit, it will hit until the end of the skill.
we will be removing the stun function from the basic combo and tweaking the damage and hit box of Command and Skills, as well as decreasing the heal amount.

[*] You can purchase through the Steam Shop or by collecting enough CP and AP to purchase in the game.
[*] (※ AP for Sacred Guardian will start to be collected starting from the release of Sacred Guardian.)
[*] When you purchase the ‘Sacred Guardian’ DLC, you will be provided with 3 missions related to ‘Lime’ in the Mission Map.
※ Epic Mission List
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/658bacfebdbd6818fbfcbeff238fe3979d473c12.png[/img]
[*] When you complete each epic mission, you will receive ‘Sacred Guardian’ Karma weapon and other skills related to Sacred Guardian. You will also meet the NPC.
※ Karma Crystal List
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/1b7a8cf146bbc077f614594e404baa01b1eea5d8.png[/img]
[*] After you finish the 3 epic missions, you can receive additional rewards depending on your affinity with ‘Lime’. (Costumes, Karma Crystals, and etc.)
※ Hero NPC Lime Affinity Reward List
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/191b4946a55b66f7c36669b69560f6418cfcbd62.png[/img][/list]

2. New 2 Player PVE (Real Time Mission) will be added and each boss will drop new items.
※ Real Time Mission List
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/37314d1cb94696ccd6f11279118dd78db19ab72d.png[/img]

3. Rematch system is added.[list]
[*]Losing team in PvP can request for a rematch once per match. It will proceed when everyone agrees to a rematch. (Ex, you can have a total of 3 matches, if each team loses once.)
[*]With Rematch, you can play the same mode with the same members again. You will receive the total rewards for all the matches.
[*]When you fail in PvE, you can Retry 1 time in the same difficulty. Everyone must agree to Retry to start.[/list]

4. A new drop item is added for each mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3ed78ea1d58bcd6dc52d62f98b4738bae00df027.png[/img]

5. You can now sell items from the character inventory.

6. Now you can adjust the number of items you resell.

7. Daily/Weekly Challenge UI will now show the reset time.

8. A new option to adjust FOV has been added.[list]
[*] Standard will be the same as before, and it’s minimal setting. If you widen the view point, you will be able to see more, but the image could be distorted more, leading to dizziness. [/list]

9. There’s a new on/off function to command guides.

10. The starting location of Kalien Cave will be lowered, so anyone (any Karma) can climb up.

11. In all maps, if there’s an obstacle in between the camera and the character, the obstacle will become invisible.

12. ‘Probatio’ will be added as part of the ‘region’ list in the Mission UI to be separated from rest of the maps.

13. The server will no longer be affected by the Client Frame.[list]
[*] This will allow certain functions that were limited in its use to come back.
[*] You can use window key on Fullscreen.
[*] You can change screen with Alt Tab on Fullscreen.
[*] You can toggle between Fullscreen and Window screen with Alt Enter.
[*] You can grab the title bar again in Window mode.[/list]

14. Debuff duration increase sub karma stat will be adjusted from 24% → 20% at max level.

15. 3 new Sub Karma crystals will be given as rewards for Crim’s affinity. (Players who’ve already achieved the required affinity level will receive the rewards at MA) As such, Karma Essence will no longer dropped in PvE missions.

16. You can now obtain ‘Probatio Mark’ through PvP Missions. ‘Probatio Mark’ is used to synthesize Intermediate Chaser Symbol. You can synthesize the accessory through PvP mission and you can extract Essence.

17. Items obtained through PvP Missions (Energy of Harmony etc.) can now be obtained only by the winning team. Item Drop Rate will be higher than before. AP/CP will be obtained even after losing (amount adjusted) just like before.

18. Accessory modify option basic stats have been adjusted.[list]
[*]Rage Generation: Decreased from 10% → 4% at max enhancement
[*]Mana Recovery : Increased from 2% → 4% at max enhancement[/list]

19. Max Friend limit will be increased to 50.

[b]Common, Karma, Mode Balance[/b]
1. Balance Revamp Patch Note on October 10th will be notified with a separate announcement.
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463844945/announcements/detail/1607147723152136941

[b]Shop Update[/b]
1. New Premium Items added on October 10th will be notified with a separate announcement.
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791463844945/announcements/detail/1607147723152380783

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
1.	Fixed the issue where Moon Slash was rising abnormally high when used at the edge of a platform.
2.	Fixed the issue where jumping at the time of stamina running out would make the character move fast while being exhausted.
3.	Fixed the issue where character would get stuck in the Eltheca swinging bench.
4.	Fixed the issue where if your primary Karma is Blazing Fist and you equip the Long-Sleeve Knight Top Piece, it would make the sleeve look torn.
5.	Fixed the issue where you are matched in a lower difficulty than you originally requested and it would show the wrong rewards when it is checked in the ESC menu.
6.	Fixed the issue where sound effects weren't properly being played to the character's armor material and the enemy's armor material.
7.	Fixed the issue where if you check the Character Info inside the Guild Window, the mouse cursor would disappear.
8.	Fixed the issue where next page wouldn't work inside the Guild Inbox using the mouse cursor.
9.	Fixed the issue where Guild is switched from Public to Private, the auto accept feature would still be enabled.
10.	Fixed the issue where Calamity's tentacle attack would only sometimes show up.
11.	Fixed the issue where Loot tooltip wouldn't show up inside the Mission Detail.
12.	Fixed the issue where playing a Custom Mission would trigger the cooldown for the Real-Time Missions.
13.	Fixed the issue where if there is an empty slot inside the spectator in Custom Mission, when the mission starts, it would show "Entering"


All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: September 10th Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GXioQJUoNEU;full][/previewyoutube]
Attention, Chasers!

Please check this week’s maintenance schedule below.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) September 10th,2019 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/3b6d550e3704723322351c26a90ffbf01a90b1fd.png[/img]
(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[b]Additional Content and System Update[/b]
1. Synthesis System will be added.
[list]
[*]‘Hildad’s Cube’ placed inside Eltheca Library will allow you to synthesize items and extract ingredients from existing items.
[*]While playing PVE missions, you will have a chance to acquire Energy of Chaos and Lost Pieces that can be used to synthesize boss items.
[*]While playing PVP missions, you will have a chance to acquire Energy of Harmony and you can use Essence items that you acquire from extraction to craft Supply Box items and Karma Crystals.
[*]Essence item type will depend on the item you are extracting from. (Example: If you extract an accessory, you will acquire Accessory Essence)
[*]The number of energy and essence for synthesis will depend on the number & type of item.
[*]You can craft either Energy of Harmony or Chaos by using a 2: 1 Ratio, 2 being the ingredient and 1 being the target energy you are trying to synthesize.
[*]You will be able to synthesize Basic Dye to create Intermediate Dye and you will be able to use Intermediate Dye to create Advanced Dye.
[*][b](※ We implemented the Synthesis System in order for players to depend less on RNG to acquire the item they want from a certain boss. With the new system, players will be able to make sure they acquire the item they need while not heavily depending on RNG.)[/b]
[/list]
2. Sub Karma Crystal System will be changed.
[list]
[*]From now on, Sub Karma Crystal will no longer depend on which slot it is equipped on and will apply its effect on the Karma (Weapon). With this change, the existing Sub Karma Crystal has been changed.
[*]You will no longer be able to equip the same Sub Karma Crystal on the same Karma (Weapon).
[*]New Sub Karma Crystals has been added.
[*]Weapon’s Modification count will be increased by 1.
[*]You can now acquire new Sub Karma Crystals from the Synthesis System.
[/list]
3. Phase 1 of Guild System has been updated. You will now be able to create and join guilds.
[list]
[*]Guild Menu can be accessed by pressing the R button and pressing the button beside the Friend Icon.
[*]Guild Names can only consist of Alphabet and Numbers. The length can be from 4 to 16 characters.
[*]You require 10,000 CP in order to create a guild.
[*]Your guild can have up to 50 members.
[*]When you are in a guild, you will be able to chat with your members by using the Guild Chat function.
[*]You can also join a guild from the Recommended Guild list.
[*]10% of AP earned by your guild members will be added to the Guild’s GAP.
(This will not decrease the amount of AP earned by guild members.)
[*]Depending on the earned GAP, the guild ranking will be set and depending on the ranking, this guild will be placed on the top of the recommended guild list.
[*]GAP will reset on the 1st of Each Month @ 06:00 (Server Time).
[*]Guild Master and Guild Members who hasn’t logged in for 30 days will be kicked from the guild.
[*]If the Guild Master disbands the guild or guild member quits the guild or gets kicked from a guild, all character in that account won’t be able to join another guild for 24 hours.
[*]Phase 2 of Guild System Update will include Guild Only Eltheca Channel and content that can use the GAP.[/list]
4. 6 Player PVE Mission, “Blazing Blade of Calamity” will be added.
[list]
[*]One day, a Knight of Calamity appeared who wielded the power of Calamity at his will. 
The Chase dispatched their members to investigate this issue but due to losing so many of their members, they decided to only allow Chasers with D Rank or higher in order to minimize casualties.
[*]Blazing Blade of Calamity will not only depend on each individual Chaser’s abilities but also team work.
Knight of Calamity has a total of 4 phases and each phase has a time limit. 
If you are not able to pass each Phase within a set time limit, you will fail the mission. You will also acquire rewards depending on the number of phases you were able to clear.
※	Reward Per Phase
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a81824c625e2db238c760f8aeccded3e71cbeb15.png[/img]
[*]Acquired item can be extracted and synthesized to a different item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/a4c38dc2f34565685f95d938a1b6cdd22ce336a8.png[/img]
[/list]
5. Max number of party member has been increased to 6.
[list]
[*]Depending on the number of members in your party, missions you can request for will be limited.
[*]When there are 3 members in your party, you will be able to queue up for Practice Probatio.
[*]When there are 4 members in your party, you will be able to queue up 4 Player PVE Missions.
[*]When there are 6 members in your party, you will be able to queue up 6 Player PVE Missions.
[*][b](※ We have heard your complaints about the limitations of current party system and with the addition of the 6 Player PVE mission ‘Blazing Blade of Calamity’, we realized that it could be too difficult for randomly matched players to clear. This is why we decided to increase the current party size to 6. Also, with the addition of the guild system, we hope many guild members play together.)[/b]
[/list]
6. You will now be able to choose 2 maps you do not prefer for Official and Practice Probatio.
[list]
[*] When you select 2 maps that you display, it won’t be matched in your matchmaking queue. However, depending on the players you are matched with, if there aren’t enough players, you may be matched to a map you disliked. (While in a party, only the map preference of the party leader will be in effect.)
[*] Characters that has less than 5 total matches from Probatio (Official & Practice) won’t be able to use this function.
[/list]
7. Survival Mode can now start with fewer players (9 Players).
[list]
[*] The max members are still 18 players but while matchmaking, if 9 or more players agree to start the match, the match will start regardless if the 10th member accepts or declines.
Also, if a certain duration passes for matchmaking, the match will start with 9 or more players.
[/list]

8. Localization for French has been improved.

9. Trickster Elemental, Settia's Invisible Accessories will be added.
[list]
[*]Settia's blesses the accessories with her power and make the accessories invisible.
[*]You can craft these accessories from Hildad's Cube by using Essence and Energy.
[/list]
10. Matchmaking Change
[list]
[*] When matchmaking for Survival Mode, accounts that are E Rank and have less than 5 match history will be put in a separate queue. Other players will have the same matchmaking process.
[*] When you are in a party, if your party member’s rank is higher than you by 5 or higher, the matchmaking will be made according to the higher-ranking character’s bracket. (If the difference is less than 5, party rating will take effect.)
[*] We are reducing the max rank difference to 15 ranks. (Example: Depending on the matchmaking time, D1 rank can meet up to B5 rank.)
[/list]
11. PVE Mission cooldowns will be removed.

12. Prerequisite Missions will be added in order to access ‘Illusion Device Overload’ & ‘Chase: Illusion Core’.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/4456a6c80fb366082b43357edc69ab50ff840219.jpg[/img]

[b]Shop Update[/b]
1. Karma Crystal and Sub Karma Crystals will be removed from Supply Boxes.
Due to the above change, the drop rates have been changed like following.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34323537/245a85326d6acbc773ef16a71798b6472cd379be.png[/img]

2. The ‘Gold Lion Cape’ will now drop from Supply Box (Karma) instead of Supply Box (Costume)

3. New Premium Items added on September 10th will be notified with a separate announcement. 

4. Blazing Fist & Diabolic Witch DLC compensation will end on UTC+0 Sep 10th 00:00.


[b]Event[/b]
1. Hildad's Earring can be crafted  starts
[list]
[*] Duration: 2019.09.10 After Maintenance ~ 2019.09.25 Before Maintenance
[*] Remain Hildad's lost pieces will be deleted on 2019.09.25 during Maintenance
[*] Hildad's Earring cannot be trade
[/list]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
1. When your character falls or leaves the map area, you will be returned to the game instead of being stuck there.

2. When you are attacked server side, you will no longer see the hit effect displayed through your client.

3. Fixed an issue where one of the challenges to acquire a certain percentage of interruptions while winning was match was counting the damage amount.

4. Fixed an issue where having a character with high maturity would make the character’s nose and chin clip through the Chaser Mask.

5. Fixed an issue where being hit by Moon Slash would leave the sound effect to linger for a set duration.

6. Fixed an issue where equipping compression bandage and Butler Top would make the arm model look compressed.

7. Fixed an issue where the in-game zoom amount would change the sensitivity of spinning your character around in the character window.

8. Fixed an issue where Damage Numbers wouldn't show up during Tutorial & inside Training Grounds after a character was just made.

9. Fixed an issue where players won’t receiving the rewards for reaching Season Lv.45 and also not displaying the Season Lv.45 properly.


All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.content:

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) August 28th,2019 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/e49c82cd18f305ce63c9cc2d22b5ed0b0c54c57c.png[/img]

notes.title: August 21st Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) August 21st,2019 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/e9b59f3d296afecda67fe238bc6677447b4423ed.png[/img]
(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will update this announcement.)

[b][System & Contents][/b]
1. A New PVP Mode ‘Kardia Island Shore’ will be added.
[list] 
[*]A new Probatio category that can be found in the Mission Map. The last surviving player wins.
[*]‘Kardia Island Shore’ is a Free For All Survival PVP mode.
[*]Your ranking will not be affected but the longer you survive, your reward will increase and when you are eliminated, you can either choose to spectate or leave and still receive your reward.
[*]If your deliver the killing blow to your enemies, your HP will be recovered and you will receive a buff that increases your attack power.
[*]The attack power buff can stack up to 10 times and if you eliminate a player with the attack power buff, you will steal it from them.[/list]
2. We are currently discussing ways to improve the daily challenge. We will temporarily remove daily challenges that is currently a problem.

3. New Survival Mode challenges will be added.

[b][Event][/b]
In order to celebrate the release of Survival Mode, we are hosting a variety of events. 
[b]Event Name: Let’s get it![/b]
*Duration: 2019.08.21 After Maintenance ~ 2019.09.04 Before Maintenance

1.Challenge: Survival Challenge!
---Condition: Play Survival Mission 35 Times and Reach 5th Place or Higher in Survival Mission One Time 
---Reward: Dark Meditation (Emote)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/8371027f933e60723076bbbe2178e217bb5240ed.png[/img]

2.Challenge: Battle Chaser
---Condition: Play Official Probatio 50 Times
---Reward: Lit (Emote)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/3f1fe56356d9379ecc495b65dc45c5787234db4a.png[/img]

3.Challenge: Passionate Chaser
---Condition: Clear Monster Mission Difficulty Normal or Higher 75 Times 
---Reward: Head Piercing Sword (Accessory, Bottom Head)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/7ee78b97d018e62e9867e6cf4e3016a4b541860a.png[/img]

This is your chance to try out the CP & AP Boost. 
[b]Event Name: Daily Boost![/b]
*Duration: 2019.08.21 After Maintenance ~ 2019.09.04 Before Maintenance, Daily
---Condition : Stay Logged In for 30 Min and receive
---Reward 1 : AP +100% Boost (1 Hour)
---Reward 2 : CP +100% Boost (1 Hour)

[b]*Boost Items will be sent every day at UTC +0 00:00.
-Americas Server: Every day at 17:00 PDT
-Europe Server: Every day at 02:00 CEST
-Asia Server: Every day at 09:00 JST[/b]

[b][Karma][/b]
[b]General[/b]
1. Whenever you use Quick Stand (Mouse Button when Knocked Down), it will cost resources and you will become immune to attacks. 
We are trying make it difficult to use easy combos to continue a combo against other players.
With this change, we are hoping it makes it easier for players to get out of combos that they couldn’t before. There will still be some methods that allows players to do a long flashy combo. 
As long as you find creative ways to combo backed up with skill and also using the environment, the possibilities will be endless.
2. The amount of stat adjusted when changing HP stat is now different.
There’s no difference for basic stat (HP 5), but there’s less HP for 4 and 3, while there’s more HP for 6.

[b][Bug Fix][/b]
1. Fixed a bug where players who are entering a channel won’t see players that were already using the loop emote before their entrance.
2. Fixed a bug where scroll control wasn’t working in the settings window with controllers.
3. Fixed a bug where Background changing key binding wasn’t working in customization.
4. Fixed a bug where the ‘Hawaiian Scarf’ didn’t look natural on muscular characters.
