notes.title: August 7th Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

The following patch note pertains to content that will be updated during the (UTC+0) August 7th Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/65c0d18a3df1e2d189a2defc0c27165c3ea0d711.png[/img]
(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will follow up with another announcement.)

[b]Additional Content and System Update[/b]
1. First Official Probatio Season has commenced. [list]
    [*]Season 1 will start 08/07 After Maintenance ~ 11/06 Before Maintenance.
    [*]During the season, you can increase Season Level.
    [*]Season Level can be increased by completing the new ‘Challenge’ system. You will be able to receive rewards every time you reach a certain level.
※ Season 1 Level Achievement Reward List
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/edb775236524acdb9c8d419c6707174dc588ae15.png[/img]
[b](*The Season 1 Level Rewards, El Knight Set and Emotes will not be tradeable)[/b]
    [*]Every time a new season starts, the previous PvP rank will be soft reset. The new season rank will be as follows:
※ PVP Rank Soft Reset
    [*]Regardless of your Chaser Rank, ratings used for matchmaking will reflect on the stats from the previous season.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/5c7e8b72721323c9902b078aa86ced4942222abf.png[/img]
    [*]At the basis, PvP rank will decrease by 15 stages.
    [*]G rank will be decreased to C5 rank, just like S5 rank.
    [*]The lowest rank after reset is D1 rank (excluding E ranks).
    [*]All E will be reset to E1 rank
    [*]Once the season is complete, the rewards will be given according to PvP rank. The rewards are as follows:[/list]
※ Season 1 PvP Rank PVP Reward – Distributed after Season 1, 05/11/19 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/d0d5d7bf81554abb3b4a53eeacef906e92a8ccff.png[/img]
[b](*Elaum Ore and other Golden Chase Weapons will not be tradeable.)[/b]

2. A new challenge system is added. [list]
    [*]Daily Challenge is added.
    [*]Weekly Challenge is added.
    [*]Season Challenge is added. [/list]
> Completing the challenges will allow you to increase season level. 

3. Newly improved Conquest mode will be added to the Official/Practice Probatio and Custom Missions.

4. New Conquest Map, ” Regenie Monastery Dungeons” has been added.

5. New Boss Rush map, ” Chase: Illusion Core” has been added.
---New Accessories will be dropped at a set rate.
※ New Dropped Item List
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/6b9ea5c205948990891bd3197697ae130310c4f4.png[/img]

6. Key customization function for keyboards has been added.

7. You can now adjust different options (Time, Kill, etc.) for Custom Missions.

8. Main Menu UI and maneuvering through the menu has been improved.

9. Basic Emote “Kneel” has been added.
---All characters will be able to receive this new Emote. This emote can be equipped through Emote tab.

10. Dye information will be shown above the item icon.

11. From now on, upgrading ‘One Piece’ items will give these items stats equivalent to upgrade stats of top and bottom piece combined. However, this will also increase the cost of upgrading ‘One Piece’ items.

12. When using dual monitors, KurtzPel will always run on the primary monitor. Once the game is running, you can move the window to the other monitor if you wish. 

13. Item Part name has changed. The equipment slot name and location will also change following this update. [list]
    [*]Hair – Front → Head - Bottom
    [*]Hair – Side → Head - Top [/list]
14. Appropriate Difficulty (Player) Gap reward adjustment amount has decreased.
(Reward Adjustment affects AP, CP gain and drop rate)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/d4c489efd63814f3a1f557d1bd6ee084e056c891.png[/img]


[b]Common, Karma, Mode Balance[/b]
[b][Common][/b]
1. Endurance increase effect through stat adjustment has decreased.
---The amount of Action Endurance adjusted when changing STR and WIS stat has decreased.
---The amount of Spell Endurance adjusted when changing INT and WIS stat has decreased.
---Ex) Based on All Stat 5 as a standard, Great Sword Action Endurance will decrease by app. 15%. 
---(Gauntlet will stay the same, Bow Staff and Dual Sword will increase slightly)
--- Based on All Stat 5 as a standard, Staff Spell Endurance will decrease by app. 15%.

2. AGI will now affect Magic Defense.
---The amount of Magic Defense adjusted when changing INT and WIS stat has decreased.
---Now changing AGI stat will affect Magic Defense.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/1eb146a1e5084cff19d09f1d2e3635d38248e7a4.png[/img]

3. You will no longer be able to equip the same type, different level Karma Crystals on the same weapon. (Sub Karma is not related to this update.)

4. The bug where you can cancel delay by disabling Priority Target Direction from Game Options and entering dash has been fixed.
---This bug was fixed because the players could have an unfair advantage over other players in PvP by exploiting the bug.

5. Switching Combo attack will not use any resources.
---We hope to see more combo variation by removing the resource cost.


[b][Sword Taliah][/b]
1. Entering the jump key after Evade Attack will no longer cancel the Evade Attack.

2. Great Sword hit box range and priority has been decreased while attacking midair.
---Sword Taliah will no longer able to disrupt the target that is obtaining the flag from beneath the bridge.
---Capture the Flag Bridge and Cave ground had become thicker, allowing less room for jump attack.

[b][Dance of Wind][/b]
1. During Charge (Right-click hold), you will not be able to use other skills except Salvo Arrows and Spirit Arrow.
---Dance of Wind will no longer be able to use skills during Right-click hold charge like other weapons. 

2. Spirit Arrow and Salvo Arrows icons will no longer activate when there isn’t enough Mana.

[b][Diabolic Witch][/b]
1. Ice Wall: If you successfully hit your target with a Lv 2, Lv 3 Ice Wall, you will be able to push back your target.
---Fixed an issue where the Ice Wall changes didn't allow combo follow up after the cast.
---The target will fall near the Ice wall allowing you to continue your combo with a dash attack.

[b][Blazing Fist][/b]
1.  Entering the jump key after Evade Attack will no longer cancel the Evade Attack.

2. Reckless Charge: If you end up in midair, while you have your target on hold and running, you will immediately throw your target.

3. Passive skill, ‘Fortitude’ will only be activated when the HP is 10% or lower. Once the HP is recovered, the buff will reset.

[b][Dual Soul][/b]
1. Passive skill, ‘Persistent Chase’ will only be activated when the HP is 10% or lower. Once the HP is recovered, the buff will reset. 

2. During Evade attack Moon Slash, your endurance will be decreased by 50%, making it easier for you to flinch or be interrupted during the skill animation. (This change will not affect Right Mouse Hold Moon Slash.)
---Since it’s easy to use and too useful as a dodge skill, this change was made to prevent skill spamming.


[b]Shop Update[/b]
1. The information on the 08/07 new items will be revealed at a later date.


[b]Event[/b]
1. Probatio Pre-Season PVP rank rewards will be distributed.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/844870/announcements/detail/1619525098765207128
2. Blazing Summer Login Event rewards will be distributed.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/844870/announcements/detail/1618398566701055017

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
1. The players who stored their Dual Soul Karma Crystals in their steam inventory and had the skill levels reset before the 07/31 bug fix will receive their compensation. 
---Compensation: “AP +100% Boost (5 Hours)”

2. Fixed a bug when a player dies while being dragged by Reckless Charge, the resurrect timer would be longer.

3. Fixed a bug where the enemy caught by Reckless Charge would float in the air or be stuck on the ground.

4. Fixed an error where Blazing Fist could jump an abnormal distance by using Evade > LMB -> Space x 2.

5. Fixed an issue where Lightning Skill would not damage depending on its rank.
---Rank 1 – Was only hitting the 1st hit.
---Rank 2 – Was only hitting the 3rd hit.
---Rank 3 – All hits were working normally.

6. Fixed an error where Rage skills (Mostly Meteor) were indicating a certain area before cast and landing on a different area after cast.

7. Fixed an error where you were being pushed to the dash direction when you Dual Soul > Switch to Different Karma > Switch Back to Dual Soul and Dash.

8. Fixed an error where you can cancel the animation of being attacked when you switch your Karma.

9. Fixed an error where attack wouldn’t occur if you Attack > Wait > Attack Again but would still consume the stamina.

10. Fixed an issue where certain body types weren’t being resurrected.

11.Fixed an issue where custom mission spectators weren’t able to see the Flag Capture stats in the result screen.

12. Fixed an issue where the effect and sound weren’t properly working when you switched your Karma in the Game Menu (R).

13. Fixed an issue where Karma Equip sound effect would play when you equip emotes or gears in the info screen.

14. Fixed an issue where players were able to target an enemy while dead and cast a skill from an abnormal distance.

15. Fixed an issue where you weren’t able to see your character’s model in the Game Menu(R) after talking with an NPC in Eltheca.

16. Fixed an issue where pressing Ctrl + Enter would make the Emote UI disappear.

17. Fixed an issue where you were able to float in the air using the Ice Wall skill at a certain location in the Cave map.

18. Fixed an issue where equipping Silver Wing Knights Undergarment and certain Bottom Piece (Official Chaser Bottom Piece, Ethan’s Tunic Bottom Piece) would make the wait area look empty.

19. Fixed an issue where using a Controller, your character would constantly try to dash even though no input was made.

20. Fixed an issue where Lire’s Shoes weren’t integrating properly with certain costumes (Jin’s Fighter Bottom Piece, Kien’s Bottom Piece, Jin’s Rookie Fighter Bottom Piece, Gothic Punk Shorts, Silver Wing Knights Bottom Piece, Guardian Yaksha Outfit, and Infiltrator Combat Suit)

notes.title: Dev Note: New Season Updates and Rewards
notes.content:
Hello Chasers,
This is the KurtzPel Team.

KurtzPel’s first ever PVP season will be heading this way on the August 7th Maintenance.
In preparation for this, we would like to explain the all new ‘Achievement System (Name TBD)’ that will be directly impacting Season 1. 

[b]The most important thing about the Season Update is the implementation of ‘Season Level’.
A Season Level is a separate leveling/Ranking gauge that will correspond to individual Seasons.    
This ‘Season Level’ will be increased using the ‘Achievement System (Name TBD)’.[/b]
(From this point on, all names related to the Achievement System are TBD.)

Achievements will consist of 3, separate categories: ‘Daily Achievement’, ‘Weekly Achievement’, and ‘Seasonal Achievement’.

‘Daily Achievement’ and ‘Weekly Achievement’ will be designed to be fairly easy to complete, but will require the Chaser to contribute towards the respective categories frequently.
‘Seasonal Achievements’ will be difficult to acquire and challenging in nature.

As you complete the aforementioned Achievements, you will acquire EXP that will increase your ‘Season Level’.
You will need to complete a variety of Achievements in order to increase, or eventually, top-out your ‘Season Level.’


[b]The ‘Season Level’ will remain throughout the season and will reset when that Season comes to an end.
When you reach a certain ‘Season Level’, you will acquire rewards for reaching those set levels.
The ‘Season Level’ rewards will be announced at a later date.

Also, with the start of a new Season, your ‘PVP Rank’ will be reset.
Your existing PVP rank will be reset and when the Season comes to an end, you will receive rewards depending on your PVP Rank.[/b]


On August 7th, our first ever official Season will start, and we strongly encourage every Chaser to strive for the top, increase your desired ‘Season Level’, fight for the highest ‘PVP Rank’ possible, and take on any who stand in your way to keep it there.
(We expect each season to last around 3 ~ 4 months but this also could change depending on development schedule.)


In order to thank every Chaser that has enjoyed KurtzPel since the launch of Early Access, we would like to reward you. To show our gratitude for all the time and dedication that you guys and girls have shown us, we have prepared a reward for all Pre-Season ranked Chasers.

[b]You still have around 3 weeks until the Pre-Season comes to an end, and we hope this motivates some of you to climb the PVP ranks in order to receive better rewards.[/b]

We will continue our best to make KurtzPel fun for you all.
See you in Eltheca!

Thank you.


[b]* Pre-Season (Current) PVP Rank Reward[/b]
- You will only receive the rewards for your respective rank.
Example: If you are A4, you will receive the A Rank reward (Rebirth Ticket X 1
Supply Box (Costume) x 6, Basic Chaser Symbol (Gold ver.) (Belt)) and A 4Stage reward 1 (Gold Ring x 3) and A 4Stage reward 2(Advanced Dye x 1)
- The following rewards will be given to Chasers at the start of Season 1 during the August 7th Maintenance.
- All ranking will be based on the ranking board at the time of Server Close on August 7th.
- All rewards will be received by the first character that logs in and all items cannot be sold on the Steam Market. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/07a18658556e0f0ca8994f2bf1e62cbdbefd731c.png[/img]

notes.title: July 17th Weekly Maintenance Schedule & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Chasers, Thanks for your patience! The KurtzPel Maintenance is now completed and the servers are live!
[b]The 30% CP & AP Bonus Event will be held from now to 07:00 (UTC) as compensation (4 Hours from now[/b])[/h1]
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Our original, intended design for the items being dropped from PVE missions were to provide something that’s rare and of high value. 
Understandably, and because of the rarity involved, we expected that these items would be traded at a higher value as well.
However, because of the low CP exchange rate that these items currently represent, these items weren’t utilized as intended… In short, they flooded the market.  Which in turn, lowered the perceived value of these items. In order to instill a better sense of value upon these items, we will be making a series of changes. 

Please bear with us on this:
Firstly, we have made the decision to make them untradable on the Steam Market. Being Chasers ourselves, we understand why this action alone may upset some of you.
However (and secondly), we’re going to be integrating these items into the brand new, upcoming Crafting System. This is the same Crafting System that we’d previously revealed on our Roadmap; a feature that will be extremely beneficial to all KurtzPel players.   
However, we still need some time to finish developing the Crafting System (CS). We do realize that many of you may acquire more, duplicate items prior to the new feature being updated. To offset this, we decided to increase the CP exchange value of these items in-game.
This way, it ensures all Chasers, whether you have these items or not, would achieve better results from holding onto these items. 
On the day of the Crafting System update, all existing PVE mission items will become of significant use. So, unless you’re hurting for CP, we strongly suggest that you hold onto these to use when the Crafting System comes to KurtzPel.
[/h1]
Attention, Chasers!

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) July 17th,2019 Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/f3055926950c8c57fd18065f454c7347d363064f.png[/img]

3. Improved the texture quality of Dark Flames Dual Sword.


[b]Common, Karma, Mode Balance[/b]

1. When using a switch attack, evasion and skill cancelling will no longer occur.

1. Infinite Blade: Physical damage increase rate is decreased. (2 times ->1.5 times)

[Dance of Wind]
1. Fixed a bug where Storming Arrow was being applied to Charged Attacks
2. Charged Shot: Skill cancel time after the charged shot motion delay has been increased.

[Blazing Fist]
1. Instant Chase: Improved Chase sequence on certain environments (Chase Angle Improved)
2. Reckless Charge: Fixed an issue where the skill wasn’t grabbing players even though their endurance was at 0

[Dual Soul]
1. Wolf Fang: Reduces the push back distance upon being hit
2. Demon Mode: The distance before you are detected by the enemy is decreased. However, Demon Mode will be deactivated once you start healing.
3. Massacre: Endurance damage increased
4. Aerial Attack (4 Hits): Attacker’s push back distance decreased
5. Aerial Attack (4 Hits):  Decreased camera shake from camera zoom
6. Evade and Moon Slash: In order to make it easier to combo after, activation time is decreased slightly


[b]Shop update[/b]
1. Essential Summer Pack DLC is added
- Contents: Rebirth Ticket, Oversized Short-Sleeve T-shirt, Stretch Pants, Strap Sandals
2. 3 Emotes added to Advanced and Basic Supply Box
- T Pose, Meditate, Mime
3. Ancient KurtzPel Costumes (Lire, Jin, Amy) Package Sale comes to an end
- Individual products will still be available in the shop. 


[b]Event[/b]

- 2019-07-17 After Maintenance ~ 2019-08-07 Before Maintenance
https://steamcommunity.com/games/844870/announcements/detail/1618398566701055017

[b]Bug Fix[/b]

All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: July.10th Emergency Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Chasers!

In order to fix some critical issues and karma balance that affecting your gameplay, we will have an emergency maintenance.

Please take note, the emergency maintenance will be held from @ July 10th (UTC+0 00:00 ~ 01:00)

You will not be able to login or play during this maintenance. Please understand that the duration of the maintenance may be adjusted.

Here is the list of issues that will be fixed in the coming, emergency maintenance:

[b]Karma(Dual Soul) Balance[/b]
[Air Combo]
- 4th attack will be a 1 hit attack instead of being multi-hit.
- 4th attack will launch the enemy further away.
- The backwards rebound distance after the 4th attack will increase, while the upward rebound distance will decrease.
- There will be no stamina recovery until after landing from the air combo.
- When using the combo closest to the ground, you will not land until after the combo is complete.

[Moon Slash]
- When you end up in midair while charging, the skill will be canceled immediately
- Damage of Moon Slash after evade(dodge) will decrease by half
- Moon Slash used after evade(dodge) can be moved depending on the direction key input

[Spinning Strike]
- Spinning Strike Lv. 3 second hit stun duration decrease (3 sec.>1.5 sec.)

[Demon Mode]
- The range in which the enemy registers the presence of a character in Demon Mode will increase (2 times)

[Wolf Fang]
- You will not be able to move immediately after using Wolf Fang
- The enemy hit will be launched further away

[Massacre]
- Multi Attack intervals increase 
- Attack range of Lv. 2, 3 Massacre decrease
- Damage and Endurance Damage decrease
- Max Moving Speed and Homing function decrease

[Critical Slash]
- First Attack, attack range decrease

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
- Europe Server Optimized
- Dark Flames Dual Sword texture bug fixed
- When using Gauntlet Grab skills, the monsters will not be buried in the ground
- When matched for ‘Illusion Device Overload’ in a party of 2 players, the difficulty level will be set to the lowest difficulty level.
- Checking the information of your friend that never played PvP will no longer cause an error. 
- You will no longer able to use a normal attack without consuming stamina while running
- Dual Sword Basic Karma Skills can no longer be traded for CP.
- The method that intentionally caused frame drops to get out of combos has been removed

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the Emergency Maintenance.

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: July.4th Emergency Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Chasers!

In order to fix some critical issues and karma balance that affecting your gameplay, we will have an emergency maintenance.

Please take note, the emergency maintenance will be held from [b]@ July 4th (UTC+0 07:00 ~ 08:00)[/b]

You will not be able to login or play during this maintenance. Please understand that the duration of the maintenance may be adjusted.

Here is the list of issues that will be fixed in the coming, emergency maintenance:

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
1. Dual Soul’s Aerial Attacks will no longer go through walls. The Wind Blades created from the air attack will disappear when it hits a wall.
2. Issue with Dual Soul’s ‘Massacre’ skill summoning too many Wind Orbs and lasting too long has been fixed.
3. Fixed an issue where equipping certain Gauntlets will make the player’s hand disappear.
4. Fixed an issue where ‘Apostle of Greed’ wasn’t landing properly and being moved to an unexpected spot.
5. Fixed an issue when you are inspecting another player in Eltheca, it would show the wrong ranking.
6. Fixed an issue when playing Dual Soul, the blur effect would last longer than expected.
7. Fixed an issue when you click on an empty spot in the Request Box, a pop-up would appear that asks if you are going to accept or decline.
8. Fixed an issue where it showed an NPC you have reached Affinity Lv.1 with wasn’t showing up properly in the Affinity Manager.
9. Fixed an issue where the Grand Chase difficulty of ‘Apostle of Greed’s Reappearance’ was giving the wrong reward, Calamity’s Cape. The reward will now properly give ‘Apostle of Greed Wing Ornament’.
[list]
[*] For players who received the Calamity’s Cape from ‘Apostle of Greed’s Reappearance’, we will be replacing the Calamity’s Cape with Apostle of Greed Wing Ornament.
[/list]
10. Fixed an issue where Silver Wing Knights Undergarment was clipping through certain body types in the Rebirth screen.
11. Fixed an issue where certain new items weren’t being transferred to the Steam Inventory.
12. Fixed an issue where certain new items couldn’t be dyed.


[b]Karma(Dual Soul) Balance[/b]
[Air Dash]
1. Air Dash usage duration has been decreased after an aerial attack.
2. You cannot air dash after using 4 Aerial Attacks.
3. You can no longer adjust the distance of Air Dashes with Aerial Attacks.

[Massacre]
1. When you hit an enemy with Massacre in the air, the enemy slowly fall towards the ground instead of staying suspended in the air.
2. Massacre’s duration is decreased.
[list][*]Lv. 1 & 2: 15 sec. to 10 sec.
    [*]Lv.3: 20 sec. to 15 sec.[/list]
3. Massacre’s movement speed is decreased by 15%.

[Destiny’s Restraints]
1. The final projectile attack will now shoot where you press your movement (WASD) key.

[Soul Blade]
1.  When Soul Blade is activated and Right-click skill is charging, the rate of Summoned Blade will increase. (0.1 sec. → 0.3 sec.)


We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the Emergency Maintenance.

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: July 3rd Weekly Maintenance Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Chasers, we added more patch note No.13 ~ 19. please check in detail[/h1]
Attention, Chasers!

The following patch note pertains to content that will be updated during the (UTC+0) July 3rd Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/d81bf2ab58c9cb5a70616c27cd7e58c0b758d821.png[/img]
(*Above time periods are subject to change. In case of schedule change, we will follow up with another announcement.)

[b]Additional Content and System Update[/b]
1. New Karma ‘Dual Soul’ will be added.
[list]
    [*]You can purchase through the Steam Shop or by collecting enough CP and AP to purchase in the game.
[b](※ AP for Dual Soul will start to be collected starting from the release of Dual Soul.)[/b]
    [*]When you purchase the ‘Dual Soul’ DLC, you will be provided with 3 missions related to Kien in the Mission Map.
※ Epic Mission List
       [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/cbfe22b4478e667f68c1640e92586c1c7a130895.png[/img]
    [*]When you complete each epic mission, you will receive ‘Dual Soul’ Karma weapon and other skills related to Dual Soul. You will also meet the NPC ‘Kien’
※ Karma Crystal List
       [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/de1ab9f12e62e907f1b10bb06da83318759802fc.png[/img]
    [*]After you finish the 3 epic missions, you can receive additional rewards depending on your affinity with ‘Kien’. (Costumes, Karma Crystals, and etc.)
※ Hero NPC Kien Affinity Reward List
       [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/c34c97e52327dbd81877b0bbf437e08276d85f5f.png[/img]
[/list]

2. New 2 Player PVE (Real Time Mission) will be added and each boss will drop new items.
※ Real Time Mission List
    [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/854521c0f2419ee5381cf683ffb94c0ad02f98c2.png[/img]

3. Starting from now, 2 Player PVE missions will be provided to everyone regardless of the Karma you own and the initial 12 PVE missions will now be provided to everyone regardless of your progression on Epic Missions.
※ New Default Real Time Mission List
    [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/30f30ff1e9ed51ab31b9ab3ee041e6cb64613a1a.png[/img]
   (※ In order to raise your affinity with Hero NPCs, you must complete the 3 Epic Missions for that particular NPC’s Karma.)

4. New 4 Player PVE Mission ‘Illusion Device Overload’ will be added.
[list]
    [*]A new PVE mode that requires 4 players to cooperate and fight bosses that randomly spawn at a set time.
    [*]New Accessories will be dropped at a set rate.
※ New Dropped Item List
       [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/27fe30acebbb0c1a91168cc1652cdeb4e8f26c30.png[/img]
[/list]

5. New Deathmatch map, ‘Regenie Monastery’ is added. You can enjoy this map in both Official and Practice Probatio.

6. Emote & Ping system will be added.
We added Emotes & Ping system to allow players to communicate with each other during gameplay.
[list]
    [*]For strategic communication purposes, each mode will have its own ping system.
    [*]For Emotes, it will be provided in a form of items and basic emotes will be provided.
※ Basic Emote List
       [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/d9d70df86a27a62c8000d8962fffc30ce0de7ddf.png[/img]
[/list]

7. Friend system will be added.
Friend System will be set for each character and not account wide. You can access the Friend System menu by pressing the G button.
[list]
    [*]Friend List: Check Friend’s status, info, and invite to party
    [*]Suggested Friend: Provide a list of players you played in the same mission, can request as friend
    [*]Friend Request Box: Check received friend request and accept or decline the request.
[/list]
You can also send a friend request directly in Eltheca by approaching them.

8. You can now enter the Training Grounds while in queue for missions and matches. You can also accept the queue from the Training Grounds.

9. Chat Bubbles are added.

10. Notification Window will be added in the System Menu.
You can check events and other useful information and you may click the ‘Do not show this again’ box. If you check the box, you may not see this feature again until you restart KurtzPel.

11. The visuals effects for gems on the Silver Wings Knight Weapons will be improved.

12. There will be additional changes to Capture the Flag mode.
[list]
    [*]Every time you obtain the flag, you will obtain 1 point. The team that first obtains 3 points, or the team with the higher score when time runs out.
    [*]The flag will disappear for a short duration when you obtain the flag.
    [*]After 10 sec. the flag will appear in one of the locations set in the map. The location of the flag will be marked 10 sec. before it appears, and will appear after the 10 sec. countdown.
    [*]The game will be extended if the game is tied when time runs out.
    [*]Flag Obtain Gauge (Time) will be affected by global time stop (when using Rage Skill).
[/list]
    In previous version of Capture the Flag, the battle to obtain the flag may have been fierce and competitive, but the playstyle after the flag was obtained was very slow, which was not the direction the Dev team intended.
In order to keep Capture the Flag more exciting, we have changed the scoring format from ‘Keep the Flag’ → ‘Obtain the Flag’.
As such, there will no longer be need for teams to protect the flag bearer but instead the point of the combat will be to cap the flag in a dynamic environment that will constantly be switching with each flag captures.

13. Diabolic Witch’s ‘Ice Wall’ skill’s duration will decrease by 20% (Approx. 1.1 sec).

14. Diabolic Witch’s ‘Meteor’ skill’s hit duration will decrease by 30% (Approx. 0.8 sec). However, each hit’s damage will increase to keep the same overall damage.

15. [b]Poland, Hungary, Thailand and Japan localization will be added.[/b]

16. A new ‘Auto Graphic Setting’ option has been added. This option will be enabled as default.
[list]
    [*]This option will activate at the start of each mission (PVP & PVE). Based on the player’s graphic settings, if the FPS doesn’t reach 40 FPS within a certain duration, the graphic quality will be lowered until it reaches a stable frame rate.
    [*]This will not affect Player Graphic Settings. Once the mission is complete, the graphic settings will return to normal.
    [*]This function will not activate in Eltheca as it’s a function to help with smooth gameplay.
    [*]You can go into Settings > Screen/Graphics > High Setting to disable this option.
[/list]
17. Sword Taliah’s Storm Slash Skill effects are adjusted.
[list]
    [*]Storm Slash’s skill effects were smaller than its actual range and we have corrected the skill effects to correctly display the skill’s attack range. 
[/list]
18. Diabolic Witch’s Lightning Skill is adjusted.  
[list]
    [*]Lightning’s Skill was occurring slower than expected and also lasted longer than expected.
    [*]Lightning’s Skill will now hit 0.1 sec. faster to match the skill effect and the duration will last 0.1 sec less.
    [*]This change is to improve the players being attacked by Lightning even though they weren’t hit by the skill effect.
[/list]
19. Affinity Management System is added.
[list]
    [*]Affinity Management function will allow you to select which NPCs you will want to increase affinity with.
Only NPCs that are registered from the Affinity Management window will be trackable from Ensher. This will also allow the NPCs to appear randomly.
This system is enabled when you have 7 or more NPCs that are Affinity Lv.1 or higher. You can check this function from Game Menu(R) - Player Info - Affinity Info - Press R
You can register up to 6 NPCs on the Affinity Management window and you can swap out different NPCs depending on your preference.
    [*][b]You must have exactly 6 NPCs registered on the Affinity Manager, it cannot be less or more.[/b]
    [*]Tip) For those of you planning to acquire Dual Soul, please note that if you already have 6 NPCs that are all Lv.1 or higher Affinity,
    You will need to remove an NPC after acquiring Kien’s Affinity after the 3rd Mission.
    Once you complete this task, you will be able to track Kien from Ensher.
[/list]

[b]Shop Update[/b]
1. New Karma ‘Dual Soul’ will be added.

2.‘Dual Soul Starter Pack’ will be added.
[list]
    [*]A Bundle that contains the Dual Soul Karma DLC and the Vanguard Dual Sword DLC.
[/list]
3. New Costume Set ‘Guardian Yaksha’ DLC will be added.
[list]
    [*]Guardian Yaksha Costume Set (DLC)
    [*]Guardian Yaksha Weapon Set (Great Sword, Bow, Staff, Gauntlet) (DLC)
    [*]Guardian Yaksha Undergarment (DLC)
    [*]Guardian Yaksha Pack Tier1 (Bundle)
    [*]Guardian Yaksha Pack Tier2 (Bundle)
[/list]
4. Dual Sword Costume Pieces will be added as DLC.
[list]
    [*]Vanguard Dual Sword (DLC)
    [*]Silver Wings Knight Dual Sword (DLC)
    [*]Guardian Yaksha Dual Sword (DLC)
[/list]
5. Dual Sword Advanced and Basic Supply Boxes will be added.

6. You can now obtain Emotes from supply boxes.
As such, the rates of the supply box will be changed as the following.
  ※ Changed Rates for Supply Box (Karma)
    [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/3f6764049db048c614ade932ec3caacd41f50a0b.png[/img]
    ※ Changed Rates for Supply Box (Costume)
    [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/e1bfba6a42f38fba0559b5a72bf9500cbc987539.png[/img]
[b](※ This rates will apply to all supply boxes, so if you wish to use the supply boxes without the changed rates, please use the supply boxes before the update.)

7. There will be change in Item Price.
[list]
    [*]Since Steam Prices are set with additional tax included, we will be removing the tax rates from the items for certain countries without additional tax to lower the overall item price for these countries.
    [*]The current pricing for all countries will be changed to meet the USD average exchange rate for the last 3 months. This may increase or decrease the prices of items in your region.
    [*]Also, we will be changing the prices every 3 months to meet the average USD exchange for the prior 3 months.
    [*]While the prices may vary due to the exchange rate, we believe this will make all regions experience similar pricing.
[/list][/b]

[b]Event[/b]
1. ‘[Event] Weekend CP & AP Bonus Event’ will start.
[list]
    [*]2019-07-06 00:00 ~ 2019-07-07 23:59
    [*]2019-07-13 00:00 ~ 2019-07-14 23:59
[/list]
[b]Bug Fix[/b]
1. The minimum required contribution rates will be fixed to be higher. (Contribution rate will be based on number of party members (allies), not number of all participating members (allies & enemies)).

notes.title: June.20th Emergency Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Chasers!

The change that was made yesterday regarding the endurance being set to 0 while capturing the flag will be reverted. We realize this was a mistake and had unintended balance changes.

This change was done in order to balance out the advantages different Karma has over the other in certain modes, but this had the opposite effect.

Also, because of the game’s current mechanics, Slayers were at an advantage since they could deal more damage and this change gave Slayers a bigger advantage. We felt it was best to revert this change as soon as possible. 
(Dance of Wind having a big advantage in this mode due to its long range was something that we never intended to have)

Please take note, the emergency maintenance will be held @ June 20th (UTC+0 07:30 ~ 08:30)

You will not be able to login or play during this maintenance. Please understand that the duration of the maintenance may be adjusted.

Here is the list of issues that will be fixed in the coming, emergency maintenance:
- The endurance being set to 0 while capturing the flag will be reverted.

As compensation for the emergency maintenance, we will be holding a 2 hour long event that boosts AP/CP by 30%.

Date: June.20th UTC+0 08:30 ~ 10:30 (2 hours)
Detail: CP/AP Bonus 30%

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the Emergency Maintenance.
Thank you for your patience.

The following patch note pertains to contents that will be updated during the (UTC+0) June.19th Weekly Maintenance.
Maintenance will happen during the following times:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/373333e13b0146ee0563cd308bc322ecf3c01fb2.png[/img]

There’s a recommended server based on the country code provided by Steam. Once you login, any future logins will select the last selected server as your default server.

    [*]Default Camera Zoon Value in Eltheca and in Missions have been adjusted.
While Eltheca, the camera zoom will remain the same. However, during missions, your camera will be zoomed out to the max. You will still be able to adjust your camera zoon rate during gameplay.
    [*]Loading Tip will be added for various tips to play the game.
[/olist]

[b]Common, Karma, Mode Balance[/b]
[olist]
    [*]Resurrection time will be adjusted again.
Max duration after 6 K.O will still be 10 sec., [b]but the duration for 1~3 K.O will be adjusted to be longer, to match with the duration before.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/4c62dcd44ac539a0bb64e4cda929d45f18716f5c.png[/img]
    [*]Default Endurance when you are in the process of capturing the flag will be 0. There will be no difference between different Karma (Stat) or Endurance Buffs (Fortitude), so any attack that decrease endurance will affect the player attempting to capture the flag.
    [*]Default Endurance when you are exhausted (Stamina <0) will also be 0.
There will be no difference between Karma (Stat) or Endurance Buffs (Fortitude), so any attack that decrease endurance will cause the flag bearer to be easily caught in a combo.
    [*]Max HP recovery after taking damage will decrease.
This is to encourage active engagement in PvP and discourage passive static play.
    [*]Sword Taliah’s WW+MLB (L-stick push+RB) attack range will decrease by app. 8~9%.
The attack range has been adjusted so that Sword Taliah’s concept as a close-range Karma with longer reach is still realized, but without the command having the significant advantage of being the most stable, long range breaker command.
    [*]Sword Taliah’s ‘Raging Strike’ Damage will be decreased by 30%.
We have adjusted the damage, as it was confirmed that Sword Taliah’s ‘Raging Strike’ dealt more damage than other damage-type Rage Skills.
    [*]Dance of Wind ‘Salvo Arrow’ Basic Damage (No Charge) will decrease by 50%.
However, full charge damage will remain the same, with the damage increase rate when charging also increased. Additionally, full charge duration will decrease from 2 sec. -> 1 sec.
    [*]Jump (in-air) while dashing will no longer recover stamina.
[/olist]

[b]Event[/b]
[olist]
    [*]‘[Event] Outstanding Chaser’s Token’ will start.
[list]
    [*]2019-06-19 After Maintenance ~ 2019-07-03 Before Maintenance
[/list]
[/olist]

[b]Item Shop Update[/b]
[olist]
    [*]Advanced Supply Box Packages will be sold for limited time only
[list]
    [*]2019-06-19 After Maintenance ~ 2019-07-03 Before Maintenance
       [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/86a177bd87a6b25d12ea7f667920a9a5ae9d1e9e.png[/img]
[/list]
[/olist]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
[olist]
    [*]NPC events that happen after completing missions, will no longer forcibly assign a different channel.
    [*]The issue of Players’ nickname occasionally not showing in spectator mode has been fixed.
    [*]During the rebirth process, changing gender will no longer allow you to create unintended eye shapes.
    [*]CP used for Accepting DLC Reward Procedure (6/4, 6/7) will be compensated.
    [*]Other minor issues related to translations have been fixed.
    [*]Hero NPC Tracking System will now operate properly in Official Probatio. From now on, when you are on Official Probatio, the NPC Tracking system will work properly.
[/olist]

All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

tags.feature:
From this maintenance, you will be able to select the server when you login. Character and account information will not be shared across servers.
There’s a recommended server based on the country code provided by Steam. Once you login, any future logins will select the last selected server as your default server.
※ We have decided on this update because players, often times, do not have a country code from Steam, and/or their actual designated server (region) might not reflect the server they have the best connection. As such, this update will allow you to select your own server that will be “best for your gaming environment”.
Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Portuguese are now available.

notes.content:
Hello Chasers,

In order to fix some issues, we had a client update @ 2:00PM.
If you are experiencing any of the below issues, please update to the most recent client.
[list]

[olist]

    [*]Go to the Library Section

    [*]Click the ‘Properties’ option

    [*]If you do not see the Current Content BuildID: 3590123, please uninstall your current client and reinstall.
[/list]
[/olist]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/c70adda61b6321b16bd8745018489ff4c4c21095.png[/img]

notes.title: [Update] Global Launch Maintenance Patch notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Europe/Asia servers will open together on June 5th @ 9AM PDT[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/e8129dc6f0f901c8372e3677c6e58fddcb3cafb1.jpg[/img][/h1]
Attention, Chasers!

This is what’s being updated on June 4th 00:00AM ~ 02:00AM PDT for our Global Launch Maintenance.


[u][b]1. Europe/Asia servers will open together on June 5th @ 9AM PDT.[/b][/u]
[list]
 [*]Europe server covers Europe/Africa/Middle East, and Asia server covers China, Japan, South East Asia, and Oceania.
 [*]Chaser’s Servers will be selected automatically based on individual Chaser’s Country Info.
 [*]You can check your current server by logging into the game, then pressing ESC (System Menu). The server name will be at the right side.
 [*]It’s not possible to play, move, or migrate between servers. The account in different servers will count as completely separate accounts.
[/list]

2. [b]The function to redistribute Character’s base stat with CP[/b] is added.
[list]
 [*]The function to redistribute Character’s base stats which was previously only available through Rebirth can now be done using CP using the Tome of Knowledge at the Library.
[/list]

3. Method of opening Supply Boxes will change.
[list]
 [*][b]After the update, all Supply Boxes will be opened through the new Supply Box UI instead of Steam Inventory.[/b]
 [*]You will be able to check the contents of the supply box with the in-game UI.
 [*][b]The items you’ve obtained through the supply box will be distributed to the Character Inventory directly.[/b] Of course, you can move them to the Steam Inventory if you wish. 
[/list]

4. [b]When you gather a certain amount of AP, you will be able to purchase Supply Boxes with CP[/b], and new Supply Boxes will be added.
[list]
 [*]Advanced Supply Box will be available in the in-game shop just like before. Every time you reach a certain AP amount, you will be able to use CP to purchase these boxes. 
 [*]These supply boxes (one from in-game shop and one purchased using CP) will have the same contents and rates. 
 [*][b]New 'Basic Supply Boxes' will be added.[/b]
 [*]Basic Supply Boxes will be available to purchase using CP when you reach a certain of AP. (Not Available in in-game shop) 
 [*]Basic Supply Boxes have the same contents as Advanced Supply Boxes, but have different rates. 
 [*]All items obtained through any supply boxes are tradeable 
 [*][b]You’ll be able to purchase Supply Boxes with CP every time you achieve a certain amount of AP.[/b]
    [list]
    [*][b]Once you gain the required amount of AP, the Supply Boxes will become available for purchase with CP.[/b]
    [*][b]Your ability to purchase boxes with CP will be reset once you purchase a box. You will have to obtain the required AP again to purchase again.[/b]
    [/list]
 [*][b]The AP requirements are counted separately per Supply Box grade.[/b]
    [list]
    [*][b]Advanced Supply Box and Basic Supply Box AP requirements to purchase with CP are counted separately.[/b]
    [*][b]For example, once you’ve acquired enough AP to purchase both Basic and Advanced boxes with CP, you’ll be able to purchase the Basic Supply Box with CP even after purchasing the Advanced Supply Box with CP.[/b]
    [/list]
[/list]

5. [b]Advanced Supply Box Rates per category and contents will be adjusted.[/b]
[list]
 [*]Each Weapon Advanced Supply Boxes will have 4 new weapons added. 
 [*]To keep the rates of each weapon constant even with the new weapons added, the rates for weapons category will be increased. 
 [*]Rates for All Dyes will decrease for Advanced Supply Boxes.
 [*]You will be able to acquire 1 Dye ~ 5Dyes randomly at a time from Supply Boxes.
 [*]Adjusted rates for Supply Boxes are as follows.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/0ba9aa99ec197c9cd7ef4b0c85a2aebddea46f41.png[/img]
[/list]

6. [b]‘Practice Probatio’ will be added, allowing players to play PvP without affecting their rank.[/b]
[list]
 [*]Practice Probatio can be played from the Real Time Mission Tab. 
 [*]There will be no change in rank for Practice Probatio. All games will be 3 vs 3.
[/list]

7. You can request 2 types of PvP Missions: ‘Practice Probatio’ and ‘Official Probatio’.
[list]
 [*]PvP Modes will be selected randomly and will not be revealed until start of the match. 
 [*]Practice Probatio will include 2 types of Death Match maps, 2 types of Capture the Flag maps, and 1 type of Conquest map. All matches will be 3 vs 3. 
 [*]Official Probatio will include 2 types of Death Match maps and 2 types of Capture the Flag maps. All matches will be 2 vs 2. 
 [*][b]Conquest mode will be revamped in the future.[/b] Once Conquest mode is revamped, it will be added to Official Probatio.
[/list]

8. There will be changes to the PvP mode.
[list]
 [*]The function of the losing team gaining points faster in Capture the Flag will be removed. 
 [*]The amount of time increased until resurrection after each death will be less, and will not exceed maximum of 10 sec.
 [*]Conquest gauge moving speed will be slower, and neutral zone will be decreased (Only for Practice Probatio) 
[/list]

9. [b]View Player Info function[/b], which allows you to check information of other players you meet in Eltheca, will be added.

10. [b]‘Kill Log’[/b] will be added to inform players when they slay the opponent.

11. [b]‘Screenshot Mode’[/b] will be added to allow you to hide UI to take better screenshots.

12. [b]New DLC Costume set, ’Silver Wing Knights set’ [/b]will be added.
[list]
 [*]As we’ve announced before, this costume set will be distributed accordingly to the amount of Karmas purchased as compensation. 
[list]
 [*]When purchased 1 Karma – ‘Silver Wing Knights’ costume set 
 [*]When purchased 2 Karma – ‘Silver Wing Knights’ costume set + ‘Silver Wing Knights’ weapon set 
[/list]
 [*][b]‘Silver Wing Knights’ DLC will be available to purchase only from 06/05 After Maintenance ~ 07/31 before Maintenance.[/b]
[/list]

13. "Korean" will be removed from the Text Language in Settings. Don't worry, the Korean voice option will stay.

14. "South Korea, Isle of Man, Netherland, and Belgium" will be restricted from accessing the game.(South Korea will be serviced outside the Steam Platform) Also, when the South Korea service begins, you will not be able to migrate your progress made on the Steam version.

15. Item tooltip design and how AP, CP is displayed in UI (icon) has changed.

16. Now ‘Settings > Max Frame Rate’ category will have a ‘Primary Monitor Refresh Rate’ setting.
When you set this option, your Max Frame Rate will be identical to your primary monitor’s refresh rate.

17. Eltheca Channels will be selected based on Steam Client Language Settings. Players will still be able to freely move between channels.

18. Stamina Recovery speed will be increased when you are exhausted.

19. Weapons max modification count will increase by 1.

20. AP boosting category from weapon modification will be removed.
Weapons that’s been modified for AP Boosting will have the modification removed and the modification count will be reset.

21. From now on, Karma (and weapon) will be obtained on the first Epic Mission (per NPC). Players will be able to obtain Karma Crystals (Skills) as reward for second and third Epic Missions.

22. Players will no longer be able to gain AP through Flashback Missions.

23. There will now be a limit to character deletion. Once a character is deleted, players will not be able to delete another character for 6 hours. The number of character slots is irrelevant. There will be no restriction to character creation.

24. Unexpected Memory (*Obsidian Fist Master) Mission Difficulty will become easier.

25. CP exchange cost for items acquired through PVE missions and Affinity rewards will decrease.

26. CP exchange cost for items obtained through DLC, In-game shop, and Supply Boxes will increase.

27. CP cost for Dye will decrease. 

28. Now Dye will also exist as an item in character inventory.
Now Dye in steam inventory must be moved to the character inventory to be used. 
It will also be possible to move Dye in character inventory to steam inventory

29. Flashback Mission’s resurrect limit increased from 2 times to 10 times in order to assist players who want to practice.

30. Bugs Fixed
[list]
    [*]The issue of characters stop moving in Eltheca will be fixed.
    [*]Undergarment Stats Upgrade (Uses CP without actually enhancing stats) that was available while using the controller will no longer be available as intended.
    [*]Occasional problem of hair or equipment looking different from how it is set will be fixed.
    [*]Translations fixes and related UI will be fixed.
    [*]Costume related graphic will be fixed.
    [*]The issue of dye applying to main Karma when applying it to a Secondary Karma is fixed.
    [*]The issue of Item Stats not updating after modifying equipped accessory is fixed.
    [*]The issue of two same Karmas showing on the ranking board is fixed.
    [*]The issue of being able to leave the map in Intrusion of the Dark Elves using Leap skill has been fixed.
    [*]The issue of being able to target far locations using the error that happens when selecting the target multiple times in skills such as Leap has been fixed.
    [*]The issue of costumes changing to the inspecting player costume when you’re viewing them from the leaderboard while the missions start has been fixed.
    [*]The issues in difficulty settings display while in party has been fixed.
    [*]The issue of ‘Fix Character Location’ in options resetting to ‘Don’t Use’ has been fixed.
    [*]The target location will no longer remain when you cancel targeting skills immediately after setting target location.
    [*]Camera will no longer be moved when using Staff Dash Attack (Will work similarly to other Karma)
    [*]Sub Karma Crystal (Cooldown Decrease) effects will work as intended.
[list]
    [*]Before:    Level 1: 3%  /   Level 2: 4%   /  Level 3: 5%
    [*]After:       Level 1: 5%  /   Level 2: 10% /  Level 3: 15%
[/list]
[/list]
All above changes can change due to development complications and when there is a change, we will notify you on the changes.

notes.title: [Update] May 22nd Emergency Maintenance Announcement (00:00AM ~ 02:00AM PDT)
notes.content:
[h1]The New DLC, 'Essential pack' is now available in the Store!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/h1]
Hello Chasers!

In order to fix some critical issues that affecting your gameplay, we will have an emergency maintenance.

Please take note,[b] the emergency maintenance will be held from May.22nd 00:00 AM ~ 02:00AM PDT.[/b]

You will not be able to login or play during this maintenance. Please understand that the duration of the maintenance may be adjusted.

Here is the list of issues that will be fixed in the coming, emergency maintenance:
[olist]
    [*][b]Nickname Filter function has improved.[/b]
[list]
    [*]Instead of banning any nicknames that included ban words, new nicknames will be banned only if it matches the ban words exactly.
[/list]
    [*][b]Some Portuguese and Spanish translations are revised.[/b]
[list]
    [*]Translations will be fixed continuously. If there are any parts of the translations that seems odd or needs to be fixed, please report them via the CS ticket.
[/list]
    [*][b]Stamina will no longer be recovered when falling (without attacking) after Chasing with Great Sword/Gauntlet.[/b]
   [*][b]Staff Left-Right (Hold) combo can be canceled after the explosion motion.[/b]
[list]
    [*]First Hit stamina cost will be adjusted with balance between Karmas in mind.
    [*]2nd Explosion Projectile initial damage and Endurance damage will decrease.
    [*]Max Charge damage and Endurance damage will increase.
[/list]
    [*][b]New DLC, ‘Essential Pack’ has been added to the Store Page.
       The price will be $5.99 and the contents will be as follows:[/b]
[list]

notes.title: DLC Karmas (Blazing Fist & Diabolic Witch) Are Now FREE!
notes.content:
[h1]DLC Karmas, Blazing Fist and Diabolic Witch are now free in the game.
Enter the game and complete 3 missions each for Jin and Marian in order to claim your new Karmas.
[/h1]
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hello Chasers!

As we announced during our May 3rd Livestream, [b]the two DLC Karmas, Blazing Fist and Diabolic Witch are now free for all players.[/b]

Once you are in the game, you will find the Karma quests are available in your Mission Map. Make sure to complete all 3 missions for both Jin and Marian, and you’ll be awarded with the Karma, Weapon, and basic Skills.

For new players who haven’t played KurtzPel yet, you will need to complete the preliminary, first 3 missions before you are able to play the missions needed to unlock the DLC Karmas.

As mentioned in the previous announcements, for any players who have already purchased or acquired the DLC Karmas (Blazing Fist & Diabolic Witch) prior to the DLC packages being removed for the KurtzPel Steam Storefront, we have prepared some fantastic compensation packages:
[b][list]
    [*]For Chasers who acquired both Blazing Fist AND Diabolic Witch, you will receive a special costume set and weapon set
    [*]For Chasers who acquired only one (1) Karma, either the Blazing Fist or Diabolic Witch, you will receive a special costume set
[/list][/b]
These rewards apply to anyone who either purchased one or both of the Karma DLC packages, purchased a founder’s pack, or unlocked in the game using CP & AP before the DLC packages have been removed from the KurtzPel Steam Store Page.

[b]Update: We have started development of the new costume-and-weapon set as this announcement is posted. Our goal is to have the sets ready by early June, in time for European launch. Further details will be shared during next week’s livestream.[/b]

Additionally, we are looking for Chasers who would like to participate in the KurtzPel Partner program to help improve KurtzPel. From Translation, Moderation, Streamer and more, for anyone who would like to participate, please click the below link. We are looking to fill a variety of roles so make sure to check this link out: https://www.kurtzpel.com/partners/

We would like to thank everyone for their patience, understanding and dedication for KurtzPel.
As always, please send us your valuable feedback, and we look forward to making KurtzPel the best game that we can. 

Thank you.

notes.title: Addressing Current Issues and a Letter from the Dev Team
notes.content:
[h1]We would like to apologize for all the issues that has been happening in the game. 
Here are our plans to address the on-going issues.[/h1]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hello Chasers, this is the KurtzPel Team.

It’s been 3 days since we’ve launched our game.
Since the launch of both Alpha tests, Beta, and now in Early Access, we wanted to let you all know that we’ve been listening to your feedback and criticism, and we hear you loud and clear. 
And, after some in-depth internal discussion and careful consideration, we’ve decided to change certain aspects of the game to make the overall KurtzPel gaming experience better for everyone.

Before anything else, [b]we would like to sincerely apologize for the trouble and controversy caused regarding certain game design decisions that were implemented early on.[/b]


[b]First, we will turn the Blazing Fist and Diabolic Witch Karmas into completely F2P, core content. Completely free content, and we’ll be removing the DLC packages from the shop.[/b]

KurtzPel was initially developed to be a Buy to Play game.
But, after we launched the initial Alpha Test, and then Global CBT, we decided to provide a gaming environment that was more ideal and accessible for everyone to enjoy. We believed that the best method of doing so would be to have KurtzPel as a Free to Play game. As F2P games go, content has to be released in waves. With Karma being the core/character content, we’d thought (mistakenly) that Sword Taliah and Dance of Wind would be the best weapon choices to make available for all Chasers; with the other 2 Karmas being unlockable.  
However, the realization that this would be perceived (understandably) as pay-to-win didn’t dawn on us until it was way too late. We were still stuck in the Buy-To-Play design mode, and this was something we should have seen.  
The main reason for our oversight is because, on paper, ‘Blazing Fist’ and ‘Diabolic Witch’ are not stronger than Sword Taliah and Dance of Wind. We believed that all Karma should operate accordingly to their roles of ‘Breaker’ and ‘Slayer’, and thought that we’d taken the game-balance of Karmas seriously enough to warrant the grind. We did not realize that for Chasers who could not play with these Karmas, that the lack of selection itself was a hard pill to swallow. It felt like it was P2W, expensive, too grindy… etc. Again, understandably so.

This goes against our core belief that KurtzPel should not be Pay-to-Win, and it was apparent that we’ve failed to demonstrate this belief. Furthermore, in order for everyone to actually enjoy our current content as intended, we’ve concluded that the best way to demonstrate this intended design, our belief and goal is to make all content that was available our previous test launches available to our players (not including the maxed out characters from Alpha, that’s silly).  

As such, we will remove the Blazing Fist and Diabolic Witch Karmas/DLC from our Steam Storefront, and provide all 4 Karmas as free, core game content. 
It will take some time to apply these changes, as this requires a large game update. As well, we’ll be consulting with Steam, but we will do our best to have these changes applied for our next major update.

[b]For those of you who were just excited to get right into the game and have already purchased the Karma(s), we are preparing some pretty solid compensation.[/b]
[list]
    [*]For those who’ve purchased 1 Karma DLC, we will be providing a new, never before seen costume set of respectable value, for free
    [*]For those who’ve purchased 2 Karma DLCs, we will be giving the aforementioned costume set, and 4 costume weapons, for free
    [*]This offer is for all Chasers who’ve purchased Karma. This doesn’t only apply to the Karma and Founder’s Pack DLCs purchased on Steam, but this compensation also applies to those who purchased the items via AP/CP
    [*]The only limitation to the compensation being offered: We will provide comp to all Chasers who’ve purchased the Karmas from the start of Early Access, up until the point that the content becomes free, and we remove the DLC packages from our Storefront
[/list]
[b]We have started development of the new costume-and-weapon set as this announcement is posted. Our goal is to have the sets ready by early June, in time for European launch.[/b] Further details will be shared during next week’s livestream.


[b]Second, we will be creating a feature that allows players to redistribute Stats via in-game currency: CP 
(Currently, this feature is only available via Rebirth Ticket).[/b]

When players use a Rebirth Ticket, they do not gain extra stats. However, they are able to redistribute the existing Stats as they see fit. 
In order to increase any Stat by 1, another has to be decreased by 1. Hence, there’s an inherent disadvantage that comes with gaining an advantage. We did not initially think that this would provide an unfair advantage. However, it was still a feature that allowed a certain level of customization, only for those who paid.   
However, taking into consideration that each Karma is optimized to utilize specific Stats, and each Karma plays to different skill types, we fully understand the desire to attempt many different types of Karma combinations. That said, you Chasers get to maximize that outcome with Stat redistribution. To achieve that goal, and make it so that everyone gets the opportunity to do so, we felt that it’s only fair to provide this opportunity without the need for Rebirth Tickets.
While this was a decision not to be taken lightly, it was a sudden one, and something that’s going to take some time to develop. [b]We will begin developing the new Stat Redistribution feature immediately, we hope to complete development in time for the Europe launch.[/b]


[b]Third, we will be developing a system that allows the Chasers to purchase Advanced Supply Boxes and Basic Supply Boxes with AP and CP.
This is currently in development.
[/b]
Having the reward boxes available as Free-to-Play content was always part of our content release plan. However, for the sake of transparency, we wanted to share this information with everybody as soon as possible.
Actually, the reason why the reward boxes are called ‘Supply Boxes’ is because it will be available to purchase with AP and CP. As indicated by name, ‘Basic Supply Boxes’ will require less AP and CP to open than ‘Advanced Supply Boxes’.


[b]Fourth, Here are the answers to some of the questions Chasers had during our 5/03 Live Stream.[/b]
[b][list]
    [*]The European server is slated to launch on June 5th 2019
    [*]The Asian server is slated to launch on July 3rd 2019
[/list][/b]
Any updates to the dates and/or content listed above, will be shared at a later date, via announcements. Those of you who are in Europe and Asia, please wait just a little while more.

As well, we just wanted to make you all aware that we are investigating some in-game issues that have been brought to our attention. We will have the following issues resolved as soon as possible.
[olist]
    [*]Issue with Chasers constantly/automatically being moved to Single Channels
    [*]Channel information not being accurate, as well as the arrival point being different from the target point when moving between channels
    [*]Mission cooldowns being longer than intended
    [*]CBT rewards not being sent as intended 
    [*]Clients crashing when attempting to participate in Custom Missions
[/olist]
Again, if you Chasers find any in-game issues and/or bugs, please bring them to our attention and report via CS ticketing(HELP button in the game or our website) as soon as possible. 


[b]Lastly…[/b]
From the moment our KurtzPel team came together… 3 years ago,
we were determined to develop a game that was neither Pay to Win, nor Grind to Win.
This belief has not changed. 
However, when developing a Free-to-Play game like KurtzPel, that’s one hell of a challenge. It’s a challenge that we’ve accepted. 

From now on, we hope to provide services that demonstrate our conviction to this design philosophy. In order to do so, we will continue to communicate with everyone and be receptive to your feedback. 

Please support us, bear with us, and share your constructive feedback. This helps us stay focused. And though we know that not every decision can make everybody happy, all the time, we will do our absolute best to make the best game that we can. 

Thank you, Chasers.

-KurtzPel Team

(Currently, this feature is only available via Rebirth Ticket).

Third, we will be developing a system that allows the Chasers to purchase Advanced Supply Boxes and Basic Supply Boxes with AP and CP.

notes.title: KurtzPel Early Access Patch Notes
notes.content:
Attention, Chasers!

The following is the Spec for Early Access.


[b]1. Character[/b]
1) You can only select Human as a race
2) You can select from both male and female gender.
3) There are 8 kinds of Idle Motions and 8 kinds of Voice. Based on the 16 Lua types, you will have a set of Idle Motion and Voice chosen for you
(Idle Motion and Voice Set will be different depending on the gender.)
4) Voices are then separated into 3 different types based on the age group. 


[b]2. Karma[/b]
1) There are 4 available Karmas: Sword Taliah (Great Sword), Dance of Wind (Longbow), Diabolic Witch (Staff), and Blazing Fist (Gauntlet)
2) The standard 2 Karmas given to all Chasers is Sword Taliah (Great Sword) and Dance of Wind (Longbow).
 You can select which Karma to receive first during character creation. 
No matter which one you select, you will be able to receive the other one.
3) Other Karmas can be obtained with in-game currency (AP/CP) or through DLC packages.
 Once you purchase the items, a series of epic quests will unlock, allowing you to obtain the selected Karmas   
4) Each Karma has 6 Karma Crystals (Normal Skills), 2 Unique Karma Crystals (Rage Skills), and 9~11 basic commands.
5) When you first acquire your Karma, you will receive 3 Karma Crystals (Normal Skills), and 1 Unique Karma Crystal (Rage Skill) as Default.
6) Other Karma Crystals can be obtained via rewards by increasing Affinity with NPCs.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/6389f569bc348043ef0410de168d39b50b68e2ba.png[/img]


[b]3. Mission (PvP, PVE)[/b]
1) System
- The mission order will be sorted daily. 2 types of PvP missions and a select number of PvE missions will be shown.
- The number of PvE missions shown will depend on how many missions you’ve already unlocked.  
- Completed missions won’t be visible for a set duration and the next mission in order become visible. 
- You can queue up to 5 missions at once.
- Real Time (PVP & Repeatable PVE) missions will reward CP (In-Game Currency), AP (Mastery), and various items
- Flashback Missions (Epic Single Mission) does not have any additional rewards other than AP.
- Custom Missions have been added.
- You can create Custom Missions by using CP. 1:1. 2:2. 3:3 PvP options are available.
- Custom Missions will have spectator mode, allowing other chasers to spectate the match.
2) Mission List
- There are 3 different PvP Modes and 5 different maps.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/bf7722176d10e6d9e9b2c8292ed8c6247fcdc3ad.png[/img]
- Epic Missions that allows you to obtain Karma (PvE)/ Flashback Mission (Single PvE) is as follows:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/9f73233ed626d9bbc2dca693d71577d8ab5b33e2.png[/img]
- Repeat Missions available after Epic Mission (Multi-Player PvE) is as follows:
(You may have a chance to obtain special items in Repeat Missions)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/4501d97cec675b9d7f3b11acbdddf3f1c58fcb2d.png[/img]


[b]4. NPC Affinity System[/b]
1) Each time you complete a Real Time Mission, there’s a set chance to meet an NPC. (Appears in mission map or in Eltheca).
You can seek out certain NPCs to meet them more often.
2) You can gain affinity through chatting with NPCs. 
Selecting a different topic of discussion will allow you to get important key words which leads to greatly increasing with that particular NPC.
3) Reaching a certain milestone of affinity with an NPC will reward you with a gift.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/2d42f92d58094f7ca7d844a1df0726199298bffd.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/f7eb3b6fe901552872396919f50c537d55cc81ef.png[/img]


[b]5. Rank System (PVP) and PVE Difficulty System[/b]
1) Chaser PvP rank starts from Rank E. depending on the result of a PvP match, your ranking will go up or down from E < D < B < A < S < G
2) Your rank increasing or decreasing will be notified at the start of a match.
3) In PVE, Epic Missions that haven’t been cleared before will always start at the Beginner difficulty. 
After that, Repeat Mission (Multiplayer) or Flashback Mission (Single)’s difficulty will change depending on the result of your missions. 
(Difficulty: Easy < Normal < Hard < Veryhard < Grandchase).
4) Your reward will depend on the mission’s difficulty. 
You may be matched in a lower difficulty than your recommended skill level when playing in a multiplayer mode, in which case your reward may be lower than expected.


[b]6. Equipment Modification System[/b]
1) Equipment (Weapon, Outfit, and Accessories) can be modified using the ‘Tome of Knowledge’ at the Library. 
There is a set number of times you can modify an equipment.
2) The following can be modified. Each Modification will cost CP (In-game currency).
- Stat Increase (Weapon, Outfit, and Accessories)
- Unlock Karma Crystal Slot (Weapon)
- Unlock Sub Karma Crystal Slot (Weapon)
- Increase AP Gain (Weapon)
- Dye (Weapon, Outfit, and Accessories, not limited to modification limit, and depends on the number of dyes you possess)


[b]7. In-game Shop [/b]
    1) Now you may purchase various items via In-game shop.
    2) The items you can buy at the shop is as follows:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/528cae75f3ea84235ac134260fe2f965320407f9.png[/img]
   3) Advanced Supply Box Rates are as follows:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/db06c81a3003277886e36b963e61efa907c0c48e.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/ba37cf41c613a9bb558ce84a70b6cd76666e8f95.png[/img]


[b]8. Founder’s Pack[/b]
1) Purchasing the items as a Founder’s Pack will allow you to get the items cheaper than if you purchase them individually at the shop.
2) There is ‘Tier 1’ and ‘Tier 2’ Founder’s Pack. The contents of the packages and sales amount is as follows:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34323537/5e855a86028d6ac48b6467614addbf034c6ad61f.png[/img]


[b]9. Other Changes[/b]
    1) Bug found in CBT has been fixed.
    2) Balance between Karma has been modified. 
    3) There are multiple mission maps throughout Eltheca.
    4) Steam Achievement, Trading Card System has been updated.
    5) Back Attack is removed. Slayers’ Critical damage has been modified.
    6) There’s now a difference between Manual Resurrection and Auto Resurrection.
    7) English V.O. added.
    8) Portuguese, Spanish in-game text is now supported.

notes.title: Dev Note: Early Access Release Information
notes.content:
Hello Chasers, this is the KurtzPel Team.


We have an exciting announcement to make.
Something all of you have been waiting for, the release date of Early Access!
 

On [b]April 30th 2019 at 09:00 PDT (April 30th 2019 16:00 UTC+0), Early Access will be available for Americas (North/South)[/b].
After that, [b]Europe will become available early June[/b] and [b]Asia will be available early July[/b].


As you all know well, KurtzPel is a fast-paced, online multiplayer game with a strong emphasis on PvP. That being said,[b] a stable, strong connection between players is very important, and in order to provide Chasers the best service possible, we have to prioritize each region separately, and in order to do that, we have to open access region by region.[/b]

Physical server locations for a PvP game are extremely important. Based on the CBT data we’ve collected, for North America, we will have server locations on both the West & East coasts. 
Brazil will host the server for South America, and act as the central hub.

The location and size of each of these servers will be tweaked as Early Access progresses. 
Our prime goal will be to make the KurtzPel play experience be as smooth as possible, for all our players. 
In order to provide the best experience, we will not be allowing cross region play and also transferring of data from one region to another. 

Though North and South America will be launching first, players from Europe and Asia need not fret! 
For players in Europe (June 2019) and Asia (July 2019), [b]we would like to apologize for the delay, but we will do our best to bring you KurtzPel as soon as possible.[/b]
We will be consistently and constantly updating KurtzPel after the Early Access release, and we will continue to improve the content and playability of the game.

With the upcoming release of Europe and Asia, we will be localizing the game for players in those regions.
For South America, we will be adding[b] ‘Brazil – Portuguese’[/b] and[b] ‘LATAM – Spanish’[/b] for our localization line-up.


We want to also discuss the payment model of KurtzPel.
In order to allow everyone to be able to experience KurtzPel, the core content of the game will be[b] Free to Play! [/b]
In the spirit and history of the quality games we produce at KOG, all players will be able to enjoy the core content of KurtzPel PVE & PVP for free.
 
In future updates, addtional Karma and Costumes will be available for purchase in the form of DLC on the Steam Store Page, or they’ll be added to the in-game Item Shop to be purchased directly. 
These will be cash purchase options. The price and content of these will be revealed in the future.


 Lastly, Founder’s Packs for KurtzPel are currently in the works, and they will mainly consist of ‘Additional’ Karmas’ and[b] ‘Exclusive Costumes set’ [/b]that can only be acquired by purchasing the Founder’s Pack. The details of the Founder’s Packs will be available at a later date.


It has already been a year and a half since we showcased KurtzPel to the World, and we would like to thank each and every one of you for taking this journey with us. 
We’re ecstatic to have you all here with us, being as excited about the official launch of KurtzPel as we are. 
We owe all of this to each of you, and we promise to improve and polish KurtzPel as we move forward. With your love of the game and constant feedback, we will achieve great things! 
 
Thank you.

     - KurtzPel Team

notes.title: Dev Note : About Early Access
notes.content:
Hello Chasers, this is the KurtzPel Team.

We would like to thank each and every one of you for following KurtzPel.

We have notified everyone that KurtzPel’s early access will be launching in the 1st Quarter of 2019 on Steam and through our Livestream. 
However, as you may have already guessed, we will have to delay the launch date by a little longer.

We originally planned to fix major bugs from CBT and release Early Access sometime in March, but once we received everyone’s feedback, we realized that we had more work to do than we initially anticipated.

We are currently polishing the good and removing the bad from KurtzPel while adding new functions in the game based on your feedback.

There will also be some features that won’t make it to the Early Access version but we will be sure to keep everyone looped in on the development progress and possible target launch dates.

Even though we cannot give you an exact date of the Early Access, [b]we promise to release KurtzPel in the first half of Q2 [/b]and will be sharing more details on the early access, such as exact date, price model, and regions, in the near future. 

We are very sorry for the inconvenience and would like to thank everyone for showing their support for KurtzPel.

- KurtzPel Team
